verses.kjv: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river of Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
verses.modern: In the thirtieth year, on the fifth day of the fourth month, I was among the exiles by the river Chebar. The heavens opened, and I saw visions of God.

verses.kjv: In the fifth day of the month, which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin's captivity,
verses.modern: It was the fifth day of the month — the fifth year of King Jehoiachin's exile.

verses.kjv: The word of the LORD came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the LORD was there upon him.
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came clearly to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar. The hand of the LORD was on Him there.

verses.kjv: And I looked, and, behold, a whirlwind came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire infolding itself, and a brightness was about it, and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber, out of the midst of the fire.
verses.modern: I looked and saw a windstorm coming from the north — a great cloud with fire flashing from within it and brilliant light surrounding it. The center glowed like glowing metal from within the fire.

verses.kjv: Also out of the midst thereof came the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance; they had the likeness of a man.
verses.modern: From within it came the likeness of four living creatures. This was their appearance: they had the form of a human being.

verses.kjv: And every one had four faces, and every one had four wings.
verses.modern: Each had four faces and four wings.

verses.kjv: And their feet were straight feet; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf's foot: and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass.
verses.modern: Their legs were straight. Their feet were like the hooves of a calf, gleaming like polished bronze.

verses.kjv: And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and they four had their faces and their wings.
verses.modern: Under their wings on each of their four sides they had human hands. All four of them had faces and wings.

verses.kjv: Their wings were joined one to another; they turned not when they went; every one went straight forward.
verses.modern: Their wings touched one another. They did not turn when they moved. Each one went straight forward.

verses.kjv: As for the likeness of their faces, they four had the face of a man, and the face of a lion, on the right side: and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four also had the face of an eagle.
verses.modern: As for the form of their faces: each had a human face on the front, a lion's face on the right side, an ox's face on the left side, and an eagle's face on the back.

verses.kjv: Thus were their faces: and their wings were stretched upward; two wings of every one were joined one to another, and two covered their bodies.
verses.modern: Such were their faces. Their wings were spread upward. Two wings of each creature touched the wings of the creatures on either side, and two wings covered their bodies.

verses.kjv: And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went; and they turned not when they went.
verses.modern: Each one moved straight forward. Wherever the Spirit would go, they went. They did not turn when they moved.

verses.kjv: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, and like the appearance of lamps: it went up and down among the living creatures; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.
verses.modern: The appearance of the living creatures was like burning coals of fire or like torches. Fire moved back and forth among them. The fire was bright, and lightning flashed from the fire.

verses.kjv: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.
verses.modern: The living creatures moved back and forth like flashes of lightning.

verses.kjv: Now as I beheld the living creatures, behold one wheel upon the earth by the living creatures, with his four faces.
verses.modern: As I looked at the living creatures, I saw a wheel on the ground beside each of the four-faced creatures.

verses.kjv: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like unto the colour of a beryl: and they four had one likeness: and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel.
verses.modern: The wheels and their construction gleamed like topaz. All four wheels looked the same. Each wheel appeared to be a wheel intersecting a wheel.

verses.kjv: When they went, they went upon their four sides: and they turned not when they went.
verses.modern: When they moved, they moved in any of the four directions without turning.

verses.kjv: As for their rings, they were so high that they were dreadful; and their rings were full of eyes round about them four.
verses.modern: Their rims were high and awesome. All four rims were full of eyes all around.

verses.kjv: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went by them: and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
verses.modern: When the living creatures moved, the wheels moved beside them. When the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels rose with them.

verses.kjv: Whithersoever the spirit was to go, they went, thither was their spirit to go; and the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
verses.modern: Wherever the Spirit would go, the creatures went, and the wheels rose alongside them — for the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.

verses.kjv: When those went, these went; and when those stood, these stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
verses.modern: When the creatures moved, the wheels moved. When the creatures stood still, the wheels stood still. When the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels rose with them — for the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.

verses.kjv: And the likeness of the firmament upon the heads of the living creature was as the colour of the terrible crystal, stretched forth over their heads above.
verses.modern: Spread out above the heads of the living creatures was something like a firmament, dazzling like crystal, stretched out overhead.

verses.kjv: And under the firmament were their wings straight, the one toward the other: every one had two, which covered on this side, and every one had two, which covered on that side, their bodies.
verses.modern: Under the firmament their wings were stretched out straight, one toward another. Each creature had two wings covering its body on each side.

verses.kjv: And when they went, I heard the noise of their wings, like the noise of great waters, as the voice of the Almighty, the voice of speech, as the noise of an host: when they stood, they let down their wings.
verses.modern: When they moved, I heard the sound of their wings like the roar of rushing waters, like the voice of the Almighty — a tumult like the noise of an army. When they stood still, they lowered their wings.

verses.kjv: And there was a voice from the firmament that was over their heads, when they stood, and had let down their wings.
verses.modern: There came a voice from above the firmament over their heads. When they stood still, they lowered their wings.

verses.kjv: And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone: and upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it.
verses.modern: Above the firmament over their heads was something like a throne — it looked like sapphire. On the likeness of the throne above was a figure that looked like a man.

verses.kjv: And I saw as the colour of amber, as the appearance of fire round about within it, from the appearance of his loins even upward, and from the appearance of his loins even downward, I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and it had brightness round about.
verses.modern: I saw that from what appeared to be His waist up, He looked like glowing metal, as if full of fire. From His waist down He looked like fire, and brilliant light surrounded Him.

verses.kjv: As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness round about. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. And when I saw it, I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice of one that spake.
verses.modern: Like the appearance of a rainbow in the clouds on a rainy day — that was how the brilliant light around Him looked. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. When I saw it, I fell on my face, and I heard the voice of someone speaking.

chapters.summary: Ezekiel sees a vision of four living creatures and the glory of the LORD above them. The wheels within wheels move wherever the Spirit directs, and above the firmament sits a throne of sapphire with a figure like fire surrounded by brightness like a rainbow.

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, Son of man, stand upon thy feet, and I will speak unto thee.
verses.modern: He said to me, "Son of man, stand on Your feet, and I will speak with You."

verses.kjv: And the spirit entered into me when he spake unto me, and set me upon my feet, that I heard him that spake unto me.
verses.modern: As He spoke to me, the Spirit entered me and set me on my feet. I heard Him speaking to me.

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, Son of man, I send thee to the children of Israel, to a rebellious nation that hath rebelled against me: they and their fathers have transgressed against me, even unto this very day.
verses.modern: He said to me, "Son of man, I am sending You to the children of Israel — to a rebellious nation that has rebelled against Me. They and their fathers have transgressed against Me to this very day."

verses.kjv: For they are impudent children and stiffhearted. I do send thee unto them; and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "They are stubborn and hard-hearted children. I am sending You to them, and You shall say to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says.'"

verses.kjv: And they, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear, (for they are a rebellious house,) yet shall know that there hath been a prophet among them.
verses.modern: "Whether they listen or refuse — for they are a rebellious house — they will know that a prophet has been among them."

verses.kjv: And thou, son of man, be not afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns be with thee, and thou dost dwell among scorpions: be not afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious house.
verses.modern: "And You, Son of man, do not be afraid of them. Do not be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns surround You and You live among scorpions. Do not be afraid of their words or troubled by their looks, even though they are a rebellious house."

verses.kjv: And thou shalt speak my words unto them, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear: for they are most rebellious.
verses.modern: "You shall speak My words to them, whether they listen or refuse — for they are most rebellious."

verses.kjv: But thou, son of man, hear what I say unto thee; Be not thou rebellious like that rebellious house: open thy mouth, and eat that I give thee.
verses.modern: "But You, Son of man — listen to what I say to You. Do not be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open Your mouth and eat what I give You."

verses.kjv: And when I looked, behold, an hand was sent unto me; and, lo, a roll of a book was therein:
verses.modern: I looked and saw a hand stretched out to me. In it was a scroll.

verses.kjv: And he spread it before me; and it was written within and without: and there was written therein lamentations, and mourning, and woe.
verses.modern: He unrolled it before me. It was written on both sides — front and back — with words of lamentation, mourning, and grief.

chapters.summary: The LORD commissions Ezekiel to speak to a rebellious Israel, whether they listen or refuse. He is given a scroll written on both sides with words of lamentation, mourning, and grief.

verses.kjv: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, eat that thou findest; eat this roll, and go speak unto the house of Israel.
verses.modern: He said to me, "Son of man, eat what is in front of You. Eat this scroll, and then go speak to the house of Israel."

verses.kjv: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat that roll.
verses.modern: So I opened my mouth, and He fed me the scroll.

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, Son of man, cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee. Then did I eat it; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.
verses.modern: He said to me, "Son of man, fill Your stomach and Your insides with this scroll I am giving You." I ate it, and it tasted as sweet as honey in my mouth.

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, Son of man, go, get thee unto the house of Israel, and speak with my words unto them.
verses.modern: He said to me, "Son of man, go now to the house of Israel and speak My words to them."

verses.kjv: For thou art not sent to a people of a strange speech and of an hard language, but to the house of Israel;
verses.modern: "You are not being sent to a people with a foreign language that is hard to understand, but to the house of Israel."

verses.kjv: Not to many people of a strange speech and of an hard language, whose words thou canst not understand. Surely, had I sent thee to them, they would have hearkened unto thee.
verses.modern: "Not to many peoples of strange speech and difficult language whose words You cannot understand. Surely, if I had sent You to them, they would have listened to You."

verses.kjv: But the house of Israel will not hearken unto thee; for they will not hearken unto me: for all the house of Israel are impudent and hardhearted.
verses.modern: "But the house of Israel will not listen to You, because they will not listen to Me. The whole house of Israel is stubborn and hard-hearted."

verses.kjv: Behold, I have made thy face strong against their faces, and thy forehead strong against their foreheads.
verses.modern: "I have made Your face as firm as their faces, and Your forehead as hard as their foreheads."

verses.kjv: As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead: fear them not, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious house.
verses.modern: "I have made Your forehead like the hardest stone — harder than flint. Do not be afraid of them or troubled by their looks, even though they are a rebellious house."

verses.kjv: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, all my words that I shall speak unto thee receive in thine heart, and hear with thine ears.
verses.modern: He said to me, "Son of man, take all My words that I speak to You into Your heart. Listen carefully with Your ears."

verses.kjv: And go, get thee to them of the captivity, unto the children of thy people, and speak unto them, and tell them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.
verses.modern: "Go to the exiles, to the children of Your people. Speak to them and tell them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says' — whether they listen or refuse."

verses.kjv: Then the spirit took me up, and I heard behind me a voice of a great rushing, saying, Blessed be the glory of the LORD from his place.
verses.modern: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me a loud rumbling sound: "Blessed be the glory of the LORD from His place!"

verses.kjv: I heard also the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched one another, and the noise of the wheels over against them, and a noise of a great rushing.
verses.modern: I heard the sound of the wings of the living creatures touching one another, and the sound of the wheels beside them — a great rumbling sound.

verses.kjv: So the spirit lifted me up, and took me away, and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; but the hand of the LORD was strong upon me.
verses.modern: The Spirit lifted me up and carried me away. I went in bitterness and anguish of spirit, but the hand of the LORD was strong upon me.

verses.kjv: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel-abib, that dwelt by the river of Chebar, and I sat where they sat, and remained there astonished among them seven days.
verses.modern: I came to the exiles at Tel-abib, who lived by the river Chebar. I sat among them, overwhelmed, for seven days.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of seven days, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: At the end of seven days the word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.
verses.modern: "Son of man, I have made You a watchman for the house of Israel. Hear the word from My mouth and warn them on My behalf."

verses.kjv: When I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; and thou givest him not warning, nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
verses.modern: "When I say to the wicked, 'You will certainly die,' and you do not warn him or speak to warn him from his wicked ways to save his life — that wicked man will die in his iniquity. But I will hold you responsible for his blood."

verses.kjv: Yet if thou warn the wicked, and he turn not from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.
verses.modern: "But if you warn the wicked man and he does not turn from his wickedness or his wicked ways, he will die in his iniquity. But you will have saved yourself."

verses.kjv: Again, When a righteous man doth turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity, and I lay a stumblingblock before him, he shall die: because thou hast not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he hath done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
verses.modern: "Again, when a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, and I put a stumbling block before him, he will die. Because you did not warn him, he will die in his sin. His righteous deeds will not be remembered, and I will hold you responsible for his blood."

verses.kjv: Nevertheless if thou warn the righteous man, that the righteous sin not, and he doth not sin, he shall surely live, because he is warned; also thou hast delivered thy soul.
verses.modern: "But if you warn the righteous man not to sin, and he does not sin, he will surely live because he took the warning. And you will have saved yourself."

verses.kjv: And the hand of the LORD was there upon me; and he said unto me, Arise, go forth into the plain, and I will there talk with thee.
verses.modern: The hand of the LORD came on me there, and He said to me, "Get up and go out to the plain. I will speak with You there."

verses.kjv: Then I arose, and went forth into the plain: and, behold, the glory of the LORD stood there, as the glory which I saw by the river of Chebar: and I fell on my face.
verses.modern: I got up and went out to the plain. The glory of the LORD was standing there — like the glory I had seen by the river Chebar. I fell on my face.

verses.kjv: Then the spirit entered into me, and set me upon my feet, and spake with me, and said unto me, Go, shut thyself within thine house.
verses.modern: The Spirit entered me and set me on my feet. He spoke to me and said, "Go, shut Yourself inside Your house."

verses.kjv: But thou, O son of man, behold, they shall put bands upon thee, and shall bind thee with them, and thou shalt not go out among them:
verses.modern: "As for You, Son of man, they will put ropes on You and bind You, and You will not go out among the people."

verses.kjv: And I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth, that thou shalt be dumb, and shalt not be to them a reprover: for they are a rebellious house.
verses.modern: "I will make Your tongue stick to the roof of Your mouth so that You will be silent and unable to rebuke them, for they are a rebellious house."

verses.kjv: But when I speak with thee, I will open thy mouth, and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; He that heareth, let him hear; and he that forbeareth, let him forbear: for they are a rebellious house.
verses.modern: "But when I speak with You, I will open Your mouth and You shall say to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says.' Whoever will listen, let them listen. Whoever will refuse, let them refuse — for they are a rebellious house."

chapters.summary: Ezekiel eats the scroll and finds it sweet as honey. The LORD appoints him a watchman over Israel — if he fails to warn the wicked, their blood will be on his hands.

verses.kjv: Thou also, son of man, take thee a tile, and lay it before thee, and pourtray upon it the city, even Jerusalem:
verses.modern: "You, Son of man — take a clay tablet and set it in front of You. Draw the city of Jerusalem on it."

verses.kjv: And lay siege against it, and build a fort against it, and cast a mount against it; set the camp also against it, and set battering rams against it round about.
verses.modern: "Then put siege works against it. Build a siege wall. Raise up a ramp against it. Set up camps around it and put battering rams against it on every side."

verses.kjv: Moreover take thou unto thee an iron pan, and set it for a wall of iron between thee and the city: and set thy face against it, and it shall be besieged, and thou shalt lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.
verses.modern: "Then take an iron plate and set it up as an iron wall between You and the city. Turn Your face toward it, and it will be under siege. Press the siege against it. This will be a sign to the house of Israel."

verses.kjv: Lie thou also upon thy left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel upon it: according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon it thou shalt bear their iniquity.
verses.modern: "Then lie on Your left side and put the iniquity of the house of Israel on Yourself. For the number of days You lie on it, You will bear their iniquity."

verses.kjv: For I have laid upon thee the years of their iniquity, according to the number of the days, three hundred and ninety days: so shalt thou bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
verses.modern: "I have assigned You one day for each year of their iniquity — 390 days. That is how long You will bear the iniquity of the house of Israel."

verses.kjv: And when thou hast accomplished them, lie again on thy right side, and thou shalt bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days: I have appointed thee each day for a year.
verses.modern: "When You have finished that, lie down again on Your right side and bear the iniquity of the house of Judah for forty days. I have assigned You one day for each year."

verses.kjv: Therefore thou shalt set thy face toward the siege of Jerusalem, and thine arm shall be uncovered, and thou shalt prophesy against it.
verses.modern: "Turn Your face toward the siege of Jerusalem with Your arm bared, and prophesy against it."

verses.kjv: And, behold, I will lay bands upon thee, and thou shalt not turn thee from one side to another, till thou hast ended the days of thy siege.
verses.modern: "I will tie You with ropes so You cannot turn from one side to the other until You have finished the days of Your siege."

verses.kjv: Take thou also unto thee wheat, and barley, and beans, and lentiles, and millet, and fitches, and put them in one vessel, and make thee bread thereof, according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon thy side, three hundred and ninety days shalt thou eat thereof.
verses.modern: "Take wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt. Put them in one container and make bread for Yourself. Eat it during the 390 days You lie on Your side."

verses.kjv: And thy meat which thou shalt eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day: from time to time shalt thou eat it.
verses.modern: "Eat it by weight — twenty shekels a day — measuring it out at set times."

verses.kjv: Thou shalt drink also water by measure, the sixth part of an hin: from time to time shalt thou drink.
verses.modern: "You will also drink water by measure — one sixth of a hin — drinking it at set times."

verses.kjv: And thou shalt eat it as barley cakes, and thou shalt bake it with dung that cometh out of man, in their sight.
verses.modern: "Eat it like a barley cake and bake it over human dung in their sight."

verses.kjv: And the LORD said, Even thus shall the children of Israel eat their defiled bread among the Gentiles, whither I will drive them.
verses.modern: The LORD said, "This is how the children of Israel will eat their defiled bread among the nations where I will drive them."

verses.kjv: Then said I, Ah Lord GOD! behold, I have never been polluted: for from my youth up even till now have I not eaten of that which dieth of itself, or is torn in pieces; neither came there abominable flesh into my mouth.
verses.modern: Then I said, "Ah, Lord GOD! I have never defiled myself. From my youth until now I have never eaten anything that died on its own or was torn by wild animals. No unclean meat has ever entered my mouth."

verses.kjv: Then he said unto me, Lo, I have given thee cow's dung for man's dung, and thou shalt prepare thy bread therewith.
verses.modern: He said to me, "Very well. I will let You use cow's dung instead of human dung. Prepare Your bread over that."

verses.kjv: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem: and they shall eat bread by weight, and with care; and they shall drink water by measure, and with astonishment:
verses.modern: He said to me, "Son of man, I am going to cut off the food supply in Jerusalem. They will eat bread by weight and in anxiety. They will drink water by measure and in despair."

verses.kjv: That they may want bread and water, and be astonied one with another, and consume away for their iniquity.
verses.modern: "This is so they will lack bread and water. They will be appalled at one another and waste away because of their iniquity."

chapters.summary: The LORD commands Ezekiel to act out the siege of Jerusalem on a clay tablet. He is to lie on his left side 390 days for Israel's iniquity and 40 days on his right side for Judah's, eating rationed bread baked over dung as a sign of the famine to come.

verses.kjv: And thou, son of man, take thee a sharp knife, take thee a barber's razor, and cause it to pass upon thine head and upon thy beard: then take thee balances to weigh, and divide the hair.
verses.modern: "You, Son of man — take a sharp sword. Use it as a barber's razor and shave Your head and Your beard. Then take a scale and divide the hair into three parts."

verses.kjv: Thou shalt burn with fire a third part in the midst of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled: and thou shalt take a third part, and smite about it with a knife: and a third part thou shalt scatter in the wind; and I will draw out a sword after them.
verses.modern: "When the days of the siege are over, burn one third of the hair in the middle of the city. Take another third and strike it with the sword all around the city. Scatter the last third to the wind, and I will pursue them with a drawn sword."

verses.kjv: Thou shalt also take thereof a few in number, and bind them in thy skirts.
verses.modern: "Take a few strands of hair and tuck them in the folds of Your robe."

verses.kjv: Then take of them again, and cast them into the midst of the fire, and burn them in the fire; for thereof shall a fire come forth into all the house of Israel.
verses.modern: "Then take some of these and throw them into the fire and burn them. From there fire will spread to all the house of Israel."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; This is Jerusalem: I have set it in the midst of the nations and countries that are round about her.
verses.modern: This is what the Lord GOD says: "This is Jerusalem. I placed her at the center of the nations, with lands all around her."

verses.kjv: And she hath changed my judgments into wickedness more than the nations, and my statutes more than the countries that are round about her: for they have refused my judgments and my statutes, they have not walked in them.
verses.modern: "She has rebelled against My laws and decrees more wickedly than the nations around her. She has rejected My laws and has not lived by My decrees."

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye multiplied more than the nations that are round about you, and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my judgments, neither have done according to the judgments of the nations that are round about you;
verses.modern: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: "Because You have been more unruly than the nations around you, not living by My decrees or following My laws — not even following the practices of the surrounding nations —"

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I, even I, am against thee, and will execute judgments in the midst of thee in the sight of the nations.
verses.modern: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: "I Myself am against You, and I will execute judgment in Your midst in the sight of the nations."

verses.kjv: And I will do in thee that which I have not done, and whereunto I will not do any more the like, because of all thine abominations.
verses.modern: "Because of all Your abominations, I will do to You what I have never done before and will never do again."

verses.kjv: Therefore the fathers shall eat the sons in the midst of thee, and the sons shall eat their fathers; and I will execute judgments in thee, and the whole remnant of thee will I scatter into all the winds.
verses.modern: "In Your midst, fathers will eat their children and children will eat their fathers. I will execute judgment on You and scatter all Your survivors to every direction."

verses.kjv: Wherefore, as I live, saith the Lord GOD; Surely, because thou hast defiled my sanctuary with all thy detestable things, and with all thine abominations, therefore will I also diminish thee; neither shall mine eye spare, neither will I have any pity.
verses.modern: "Therefore, as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, because You have defiled My sanctuary with all Your vile images and detestable practices, I will cut You down. My eye will not spare, and I will have no pity."

verses.kjv: A third part of thee shall die with the pestilence, and with famine shall they be consumed in the midst of thee: and a third part shall fall by the sword round about thee; and I will scatter a third part into all the winds, and I will draw out a sword after them.
verses.modern: "A third of Your people will die of plague and famine inside the city. A third will fall by the sword outside the walls. A third I will scatter to every direction and pursue with a drawn sword."

verses.kjv: Thus shall mine anger be accomplished, and I will cause my fury to rest upon them, and I will be comforted: and they shall know that I the LORD have spoken it in my zeal, when I have accomplished my fury in them.
verses.modern: "So My anger will be spent and My wrath against them satisfied. When I have vented My fury on them, they will know that I the LORD have spoken in My zeal."

verses.kjv: Moreover I will make thee waste, and a reproach among the nations that are round about thee, in the sight of all that pass by.
verses.modern: "I will make You a ruin and a disgrace among the nations around you, in the sight of all who pass by."

verses.kjv: So it shall be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment unto the nations that are round about thee, when I shall execute judgments in thee in anger and in fury and in furious rebukes. I the LORD have spoken it.
verses.modern: "You will be a reproach and a mockery, a warning and a horror to the nations around you when I execute judgment on you in anger and fury and with stinging rebukes. I the LORD have spoken."

verses.kjv: When I shall send upon them the evil arrows of famine, which shall be for their destruction, and which I will send to destroy you: and I will increase the famine upon you, and will break your staff of bread:
verses.modern: "I will send against You famine — deadly arrows of famine — sent to destroy You. I will increase the famine and cut off Your food supply."

verses.kjv: So will I send upon you famine and evil beasts, and they shall bereave thee; and pestilence and blood shall pass through thee; and I will bring the sword upon thee. I the LORD have spoken it.
verses.modern: "I will send famine and wild animals against You, and they will leave You childless. Plague and bloodshed will sweep through You, and I will bring a sword against You. I the LORD have spoken."

chapters.summary: Ezekiel shaves his head and divides the hair into three parts — one burned, one struck with a sword, one scattered to the wind — picturing how Jerusalem's people will perish by famine, sword, and exile. The LORD declares He will execute unprecedented judgment because the city has defiled His sanctuary.

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, set thy face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy against them,
verses.modern: "Son of man, turn Your face toward the mountains of Israel and prophesy against them."

verses.kjv: And say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys; Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword upon you, and I will destroy your high places.
verses.modern: Say: "Mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD. This is what the Lord GOD says to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys: I am bringing a sword against You, and I will destroy Your high places."

verses.kjv: And your altars shall be desolate, and your images shall be broken: and I will cast down your slain men before your idols.
verses.modern: "Your altars will be laid waste and Your incense altars will be broken. I will throw down Your slain before Your idols."

verses.kjv: And I will lay the dead carcases of the children of Israel before their idols; and I will scatter your bones round about your altars.
verses.modern: "I will lay the dead bodies of the people of Israel before their idols and scatter Your bones around Your altars."

verses.kjv: In all your dwellingplaces the cities shall be laid waste, and the high places shall be desolate; that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your images may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.
verses.modern: "In all Your settlements, the cities will be in ruins and the high places will be laid waste, so that Your altars will be ruined and desolate, Your idols smashed and abolished, Your incense altars cut down, and everything You have made wiped out."

verses.kjv: And the slain shall fall in the midst of you, and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "The slain will fall among You, and You will know that I am the LORD."

verses.kjv: Yet will I leave a remnant, that ye may have some that shall escape the sword among the nations, when ye shall be scattered through the countries.
verses.modern: "But I will spare some — survivors of the sword among the nations when you are scattered through the lands."

verses.kjv: And they that escape of you shall remember me among the nations whither they shall be carried captives, because I am broken with their whorish heart, which hath departed from me, and with their eyes, which go a whoring after their idols: and they shall lothe themselves for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.
verses.modern: "Then Your survivors will remember Me among the heathen where they are taken captive. I was broken by their whorish hearts that turned from Me, and by their eyes that went after their idols. They will despise themselves for the evil they have done and for all their abominations."

verses.kjv: And they shall know that I am the LORD, and that I have not said in vain that I would do this evil unto them.
verses.modern: "They will know that I am the LORD. I did not threaten in vain to bring this disaster on them."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Smite with thine hand, and stamp with thy foot, and say, Alas for all the evil abominations of the house of Israel! for they shall fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.
verses.modern: This is what the Lord GOD says: "Clap Your hands and stamp Your foot and cry out, 'Alas!' over all the evil abominations of the house of Israel, for they will fall by sword, famine, and plague."

verses.kjv: He that is far off shall die of the pestilence; and he that is near shall fall by the sword; and he that remaineth and is besieged shall die by the famine: thus will I accomplish my fury upon them.
verses.modern: "Those far away will die of plague. Those nearby will fall by the sword. Those who survive and are spared will die of famine. I will spend My fury on them."

verses.kjv: Then shall ye know that I am the LORD, when their slain men shall be among their idols round about their altars, upon every high hill, in all the tops of the mountains, and under every green tree, and under every thick oak, the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols.
verses.modern: "You will know that I am the LORD when their dead lie among their idols — around their altars, on every high hill, on every mountaintop, under every green tree and every leafy oak — the places where they offered fragrant incense to all their idols."

verses.kjv: So will I stretch out my hand upon them, and make the land desolate, yea, more desolate than the wilderness toward Diblath, in all their habitations: and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "I will stretch out My hand against them and make the land a desolate waste from the desert to Diblah — throughout all the places they live. Then they will know that I am the LORD."

chapters.summary: The LORD pronounces judgment against the mountains of Israel and their high places. The altars and idols will be destroyed and the slain will fall among them, but a remnant will survive among the nations and remember the LORD.

verses.kjv: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Also, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD unto the land of Israel; An end, the end is come upon the four corners of the land.
verses.modern: "Son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says to the land of Israel: The end! The end has come on the four corners of the land."

verses.kjv: Now is the end come upon thee, and I will send mine anger upon thee, and will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense upon thee all thine abominations.
verses.modern: "The end is now on You. I will unleash My anger against You and judge You according to Your ways. I will punish You for all Your abominations."

verses.kjv: And mine eye shall not spare thee, neither will I have pity: but I will recompense thy ways upon thee, and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "My eye will not spare You. I will have no pity. I will repay You for Your ways, and Your abominations will be among You. You will know that I am the LORD."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; An evil, an only evil, behold, is come.
verses.modern: This is what the Lord GOD says: "Disaster! An unheard-of disaster — it is coming!"

verses.kjv: An end is come, the end is come: it watcheth for thee; behold, it is come.
verses.modern: "The end has come. The end has come. It has roused itself against You — it is here!"

verses.kjv: The morning is come unto thee, O thou that dwellest in the land: the time is come, the day of trouble is near, and not the sounding again of the mountains.
verses.modern: "Doom has come on You, You who live in the land. The time has come. The day is near. There is confusion, not joy, on the mountains."

verses.kjv: Now will I shortly pour out my fury upon thee, and accomplish mine anger upon thee: and I will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense thee for all thine abominations.
verses.modern: "Soon I will pour out My wrath on You and spend My anger against You. I will judge You according to Your ways and punish You for all Your abominations."

verses.kjv: And mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will recompense thee according to thy ways and thine abominations that are in the midst of thee; and ye shall know that I am the LORD that smiteth.
verses.modern: "My eye will not spare, and I will have no pity. I will repay You according to Your ways and the abominations among You. Then You will know that it is I the LORD Who strikes."

verses.kjv: Behold the day, behold, it is come: the morning is gone forth; the rod hath blossomed, pride hath budded.
verses.modern: "The day is here. It has come. Doom has burst forth. The rod has budded. Arrogance has blossomed."

verses.kjv: Violence is risen up into a rod of wickedness: none of them shall remain, nor of their multitude, nor of any of theirs: neither shall there be wailing for them.
verses.modern: "Violence has grown into a rod of wickedness. None of the people will remain — not their wealth or anything of theirs. No one will mourn for them."

verses.kjv: The time is come, the day draweth near: let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn: for wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.
verses.modern: "The time has come. The day has arrived. Let not the buyer rejoice or the seller mourn, for wrath is on the whole crowd."

verses.kjv: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold, although they were yet alive: for the vision is touching the whole multitude thereof, which shall not return; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.
verses.modern: "The seller will not recover what was sold even if He lives, for the vision concerns all the people. No one will turn back. Because of their iniquity, no one will be able to sustain their lives."

verses.kjv: They have blown the trumpet, even to make all ready; but none goeth to the battle: for my wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.
verses.modern: "They sound the trumpet and make everything ready, but no one goes into battle — for My wrath is on all of them."

verses.kjv: The sword is without, and the pestilence and the famine within: he that is in the field shall die with the sword; and he that is in the city, famine and pestilence shall devour him.
verses.modern: "The sword is outside. Plague and famine are inside. Those in the countryside will die by the sword. Those in the city will be consumed by famine and plague."

verses.kjv: But they that escape of them shall escape, and shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them mourning, every one for his iniquity.
verses.modern: "Those who survive and escape will flee to the mountains. They will be like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning — each one over their own iniquity."

verses.kjv: All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall be weak as water.
verses.modern: "Every hand will go limp. Every knee will be weak as water."

verses.kjv: They shall also gird themselves with sackcloth, and horror shall cover them; and shame shall be upon all faces, and baldness upon all their heads.
verses.modern: "They will put on sackcloth. Terror will cover them. Shame will be on every face and every head will be shaved."

verses.kjv: They shall cast their silver in the streets, and their gold shall be removed: their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the LORD: they shall not satisfy their souls, neither fill their bowels: because it is the stumblingblock of their iniquity.
verses.modern: "They will throw their silver into the streets, and their gold will be discarded. Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to save them in the day of the LORD's wrath. They cannot satisfy their hunger or fill their stomachs with it — for it became the stumbling block of their iniquity."

verses.kjv: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty: but they made the images of their abominations and of their detestable things therein: therefore have I set it far from them.
verses.modern: "They took pride in their beautiful jewelry and used it to make their vile idols and detestable images. Therefore I will make it an unclean thing to them."

verses.kjv: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil; and they shall pollute it.
verses.modern: "I will give it as plunder to foreigners and as loot to the wicked of the earth, and they will defile it."

verses.kjv: My face will I turn also from them, and they shall pollute my secret place: for the robbers shall enter into it, and defile it.
verses.modern: "I will turn My face away from them, and they will desecrate My treasured place. Robbers will break into it and defile it."

verses.kjv: Make a chain: for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.
verses.modern: "Prepare chains, for the land is full of bloody crimes and the city is full of violence."

verses.kjv: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen, and they shall possess their houses: I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be defiled.
verses.modern: "I will bring the most ruthless of heathen to take possession of their houses. I will put an end to the pride of the powerful, and their sanctuaries will be defiled."

verses.kjv: Destruction cometh; and they shall seek peace, and there shall be none.
verses.modern: "Anguish is coming. They will seek peace but there will be none."

verses.kjv: Mischief shall come upon mischief, and rumour shall be upon rumour; then shall they seek a vision of the prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the ancients.
verses.modern: "Disaster will come on disaster, and rumor will follow rumor. They will seek a vision from the prophet, but the law will perish from the priest and counsel from the elders."

verses.kjv: The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled: I will do unto them after their way, and according to their deserts will I judge them; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "The king will mourn. The prince will be wrapped in despair. The hands of the people of the land will tremble. I will deal with them according to their own conduct, and I will judge them by their own standards. They will know that I am the LORD."

chapters.summary: The LORD declares that the end has come upon the land of Israel. Disaster upon disaster will strike — the sword outside, famine and plague inside — and neither silver nor gold will save them in the day of wrath.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in mine house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, that the hand of the Lord GOD fell there upon me.
verses.modern: In the sixth year, on the fifth day of the sixth month, I was sitting in my house with the elders of Judah sitting in front of me. The hand of the Lord GOD fell on me there.

verses.kjv: Then I beheld, and lo a likeness as the appearance of fire: from the appearance of his loins even downward, fire; and from his loins even upward, as the appearance of brightness, as the colour of amber.
verses.modern: I looked and saw a figure that looked like fire. From what appeared to be His waist down was fire. From His waist up He was brilliant — like glowing metal.

verses.kjv: And he put forth the form of an hand, and took me by a lock of mine head; and the spirit lifted me up between the earth and the heaven, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the inner gate that looketh toward the north; where was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provoketh to jealousy.
verses.modern: He stretched out what looked like a hand and took me by the hair of my head. The Spirit lifted me up between earth and heaven and in visions of God brought me to Jerusalem — to the entrance of the north gate of the inner court, where the idol that provokes God's jealousy stood.

verses.kjv: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the vision that I saw in the plain.
verses.modern: The glory of the God of Israel was there, like the vision I had seen in the plain.

verses.kjv: Then said he unto me, Son of man, lift up thine eyes now the way toward the north. So I lifted up mine eyes the way toward the north, and northward at the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.
verses.modern: He said to me, "Son of man, look toward the north." I looked toward the north, and there at the entrance north of the altar gate was this idol that provokes jealousy.

verses.kjv: He said furthermore unto me, Son of man, seest thou what they do? even the great abominations that the house of Israel committeth here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? but turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations.
verses.modern: He said to me, "Son of man, do You see what they are doing — the great abominations the house of Israel is committing here, driving Me far from My sanctuary? But You will see even greater abominations."

verses.kjv: And he brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold a hole in the wall.
verses.modern: Then He brought me to the entrance of the court, and I looked and saw a hole in the wall.

verses.kjv: Then said he unto me, Son of man, dig now in the wall: and when I had digged in the wall, behold a door.
verses.modern: He said to me, "Son of man, dig through the wall." So I dug through the wall and saw a doorway.

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, Go in, and behold the wicked abominations that they do here.
verses.modern: He said to me, "Go in and see the wicked abominations they are doing here."

verses.kjv: So I went in and saw; and behold every form of creeping things, and abominable beasts, and all the idols of the house of Israel, pourtrayed upon the wall round about.
verses.modern: I went in and looked, and I saw every form of crawling creature and unclean animal and all the idols of the house of Israel — carved all over the walls.

verses.kjv: And there stood before them seventy men of the ancients of the house of Israel, and in the midst of them stood Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan, with every man his censer in his hand; and a thick cloud of incense went up.
verses.modern: Standing before them were seventy of the elders of the house of Israel. Jaazaniah son of Shaphan stood among them. Each man had his incense burner in his hand, and a fragrant cloud of incense was rising.

verses.kjv: Then said he unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen what the ancients of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in the chambers of his imagery? for they say, The LORD seeth us not; the LORD hath forsaken the earth.
verses.modern: He said to me, "Son of man, have You seen what the elders of the house of Israel are doing in the dark? Each of them is in His own room full of carved idols. They say, 'The LORD doesn't see us. The LORD has abandoned the land.'"

verses.kjv: He said also unto me, Turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations that they do.
verses.modern: He also said to me, "You will see even greater abominations than these."

verses.kjv: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the LORD's house which was toward the north; and, behold, there sat women weeping for Tammuz.
verses.modern: Then He brought me to the entrance of the north gate of the LORD's house. There I saw women sitting and weeping for Tammuz.

verses.kjv: Then said he unto me, Hast thou seen this, O son of man? turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations than these.
verses.modern: He said to me, "Do You see this, Son of man? You will see abominations even greater than these."

verses.kjv: And he brought me into the inner court of the LORD's house, and, behold, at the door of the temple of the LORD, between the porch and the altar, were about five and twenty men, with their backs toward the temple of the LORD, and their faces toward the east; and they worshipped the sun toward the east.
verses.modern: He brought me into the inner court of the LORD's house, and at the entrance to the temple, between the porch and the altar, were about twenty-five men. Their backs were toward the temple of the LORD and their faces toward the east. They were bowing down to the sun in the east.

verses.kjv: Then he said unto me, Hast thou seen this, O son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? for they have filled the land with violence, and have returned to provoke me to anger: and, lo, they put the branch to their nose.
verses.modern: He said to me, "Have You seen this, Son of man? Is it a trivial thing for the house of Judah to do the abominations they are doing here? They have filled the land with violence and repeatedly provoked Me to anger. Look — they are even putting the branch to their nose."

verses.kjv: Therefore will I also deal in fury: mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: and though they cry in mine ears with a loud voice, yet will I not hear them.
verses.modern: "Therefore I will deal with them in fury. My eye will not spare and I will have no pity. Even if they shout in My ears with a loud voice, I will not hear them."

chapters.summary: The Spirit transports Ezekiel in a vision to the temple in Jerusalem. He sees escalating abominations — an idol of jealousy at the gate, elders burning incense to carved images in secret, women weeping for Tammuz, and men bowing to the sun with their backs to the temple.

verses.kjv: He cried also in mine ears with a loud voice, saying, Cause them that have charge over the city to draw near, even every man with his destroying weapon in his hand.
verses.modern: He called in my hearing with a loud voice, "Bring the executioners of the city here, each with a weapon of destruction in his hand."

verses.kjv: And, behold, six men came from the way of the higher gate, which lieth toward the north, and every man a slaughter weapon in his hand; and one man among them was clothed with linen, with a writer's inkhorn by his side: and they went in, and stood beside the brasen altar.
verses.modern: Six men came from the direction of the upper gate, which faces north, each with a deadly weapon in his hand. With them was a man dressed in linen who carried a writing kit at his side. They came in and stood beside the bronze altar.

verses.kjv: And the glory of the God of Israel was gone up from the cherub, whereupon he was, to the threshold of the house. And he called to the man clothed with linen, which had the writer's inkhorn by his side;
verses.modern: Now the glory of the God of Israel went up from the cherub where it had been and moved to the threshold of the house. The LORD called to the man clothed in linen who had the writing kit.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto him, Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof.
verses.modern: The LORD said to Him, "Go through the city — through Jerusalem — and put a mark on the foreheads of those who grieve and mourn over all the abominations being done in the city."

verses.kjv: And to the others he said in mine hearing, Go ye after him through the city, and smite: let not your eye spare, neither have ye pity:
verses.modern: To the others He said in my hearing, "Follow Him through the city and strike. Do not let Your eye spare, and have no pity."

verses.kjv: Slay utterly old and young, both maids, and little children, and women: but come not near any man upon whom is the mark; and begin at my sanctuary. Then they began at the ancient men which were before the house.
verses.modern: "Kill old men, young men, young women, little children, and women — but do not touch anyone who has the mark. Begin at My sanctuary." So they began with the elders who were in front of the house.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain: go ye forth. And they went forth, and slew in the city.
verses.modern: He said to them, "Defile the house and fill the courts with the slain. Go!" So they went out and killed throughout the city.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, while they were slaying them, and I was left, that I fell upon my face, and cried, and said, Ah Lord GOD! wilt thou destroy all the residue of Israel in thy pouring out of thy fury upon Jerusalem?
verses.modern: While they were killing and I was left alone, I fell on my face and cried out, "Ah, Lord GOD! Are You going to destroy all who remain in Israel when You pour out Your wrath on Jerusalem?"

verses.kjv: Then said he unto me, The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceeding great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perverseness: for they say, The LORD hath forsaken the earth, and the LORD seeth not.
verses.modern: He said to me, "The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is very great. The land is full of bloodshed and the city is full of injustice. They say, 'The LORD has forsaken the land. The LORD does not see.'"

verses.kjv: And as for me also, mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity, but I will recompense their way upon their head.
verses.modern: "My eye will not spare, and I will have no pity. I will bring their deeds on their own heads."

verses.kjv: And, behold, the man clothed with linen, which had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, I have done as thou hast commanded me.
verses.modern: Then the man in linen with the writing kit came back and reported, "I have done as You commanded."

chapters.summary: Six executioners with destroying weapons are summoned, along with a man in linen carrying a writing kit. The man marks the foreheads of those who grieve over Jerusalem's abominations, and the rest are slaughtered without pity — beginning at the sanctuary.

verses.kjv: Then I looked, and, behold, in the firmament that was above the head of the cherubims there appeared over them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.
verses.modern: I looked and saw that above the firmament over the heads of the cherubim there was something like a sapphire stone — the appearance of the likeness of a throne.

verses.kjv: And he spake unto the man clothed with linen, and said, Go in between the wheels, even under the cherub, and fill thine hand with coals of fire from between the cherubims, and scatter them over the city. And he went in in my sight.
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to the man in linen and said, "Go between the wheels under the cherubim. Fill Your hands with burning coals from between the cherubim and scatter them over the city." He went in as I watched.

verses.kjv: Now the cherubims stood on the right side of the house, when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.
verses.modern: The cherubim were standing on the south side of the house when the man went in. The cloud filled the inner court.

verses.kjv: Then the glory of the LORD went up from the cherub, and stood over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD's glory.
verses.modern: The glory of the LORD rose from above the cherubim and moved to the threshold of the house. The house was filled with the cloud, and the court was filled with the radiance of the LORD's glory.

verses.kjv: And the sound of the cherubims' wings was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of the Almighty God when he speaketh.
verses.modern: The sound of the wings of the cherubim could be heard as far as the outer court — like the voice of God Almighty when He speaks.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that when he had commanded the man clothed with linen, saying, Take fire from between the wheels, from between the cherubims; then he went in, and stood beside the wheels.
verses.modern: When God commanded the man in linen, "Take fire from between the wheels, from between the cherubim," the man went in and stood beside the wheels.

verses.kjv: And one cherub stretched forth his hand from between the cherubims unto the fire that was between the cherubims, and took thereof, and put it into the hands of him that was clothed with linen: who took it, and went out.
verses.modern: Then one of the cherubim reached out his hand to the fire between the cherubim. He took some of it and put it into the hands of the man in linen, who took it and went out.

verses.kjv: And there appeared in the cherubims the form of a man's hand under their wings.
verses.modern: The cherubim appeared to have the form of human hands under their wings.

verses.kjv: And when I looked, behold the four wheels by the cherubims, one wheel by one cherub, and another wheel by another cherub: and the appearance of the wheels was as the colour of a beryl stone.
verses.modern: I looked and saw four wheels beside the cherubim — one wheel beside each cherub. The wheels gleamed like topaz.

verses.kjv: And as for their appearances, they four had one likeness, as if a wheel had been in the midst of a wheel.
verses.modern: All four wheels looked the same — as if a wheel were within a wheel.

verses.kjv: When they went, they went upon their four sides; they turned not as they went, but to the place whither the head looked they followed it; they turned not as they went.
verses.modern: When they moved, they went in any of the four directions without turning. They followed the direction the head was facing and did not turn as they moved.

verses.kjv: And their whole body, and their backs, and their hands, and their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes round about, even the wheels that they four had.
verses.modern: Their entire bodies — including their backs, hands, and wings — and the wheels were covered with eyes all around, all four of them.

verses.kjv: As for the wheels, it was cried unto them in my hearing, O wheel.
verses.modern: As for the wheels, they were called "the whirling wheels" as I heard.

verses.kjv: And every one had four faces: the first face was the face of a cherub, and the second face was the face of a man, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.
verses.modern: Each of the cherubim had four faces: the first was the face of a cherub, the second a human face, the third a lion's face, and the fourth an eagle's face.

verses.kjv: And the cherubims were lifted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river of Chebar.
verses.modern: The cherubim rose upward. These were the living creatures I had seen by the river Chebar.

verses.kjv: And when the cherubims went, the wheels went by them: and when the cherubims lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the same wheels also turned not from beside them.
verses.modern: When the cherubim moved, the wheels moved beside them. When the cherubim spread their wings to rise from the ground, the wheels did not leave their side.

verses.kjv: When they stood, these stood; and when they were lifted up, these lifted up themselves also: for the spirit of the living creature was in them.
verses.modern: When the cherubim stood still, the wheels stood still. When they rose, the wheels rose with them — for the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.

verses.kjv: Then the glory of the LORD departed from off the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubims.
verses.modern: Then the glory of the LORD departed from the threshold of the house and stopped above the cherubim.

verses.kjv: And the cherubims lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight: when they went out, the wheels also were beside them, and every one stood at the door of the east gate of the LORD's house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
verses.modern: The cherubim spread their wings and rose up from the earth as I watched. The wheels were beside them as they went. They stopped at the entrance of the east gate of the LORD's house. The glory of the God of Israel was above them.

verses.kjv: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river of Chebar; and I knew that they were the cherubims.
verses.modern: These were the living creatures I had seen beneath the God of Israel by the river Chebar. I recognized that they were cherubim.

verses.kjv: Every one had four faces apiece, and every one four wings; and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.
verses.modern: Each had four faces and four wings. Under their wings was the likeness of human hands.

verses.kjv: And the likeness of their faces was the same faces which I saw by the river of Chebar, their appearances and themselves: they went every one straight forward.
verses.modern: Their faces looked just like the faces I had seen by the river Chebar. Each one moved straight forward.

chapters.summary: Ezekiel sees the glory of the LORD depart from the threshold of the temple and stand over the cherubim. Coals of fire are scattered over the city, and the cherubim with their wheels rise from the earth as the glory moves to the east gate.

verses.kjv: Moreover the spirit lifted me up, and brought me unto the east gate of the LORD's house, which looketh eastward: and behold at the door of the gate five and twenty men; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.
verses.modern: The Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the east gate of the LORD's house, which faces east. At the entrance of the gate I saw twenty-five men. Among them were Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah — leaders of the people.

verses.kjv: Then said he unto me, Son of man, these are the men that devise mischief, and give wicked counsel in this city:
verses.modern: The LORD said to me, "Son of man, these are the men who plot evil and give wicked advice in this city."

verses.kjv: Which say, It is not near; let us build houses: this city is the caldron, and we be the flesh.
verses.modern: "They say, 'The time is not near to build houses. This city is the pot, and we are the meat.'"

verses.kjv: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of man.
verses.modern: "Therefore prophesy against them. Prophesy, Son of man."

verses.kjv: And the Spirit of the LORD fell upon me, and said unto me, Speak; Thus saith the LORD; Thus have ye said, O house of Israel: for I know the things that come into your mind, every one of them.
verses.modern: The Spirit of the LORD came on me and said, "Speak: 'This is what the LORD says. That is what You have said, house of Israel. I know what comes into Your mind, every single one of those thoughts.'"

verses.kjv: Ye have multiplied your slain in this city, and ye have filled the streets thereof with the slain.
verses.modern: "You have killed many people in this city and filled its streets with the dead."

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Your slain whom ye have laid in the midst of it, they are the flesh, and this city is the caldron: but I will bring you forth out of the midst of it.
verses.modern: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: "The bodies You have thrown down in this city are the meat, and this city is the pot — but I will bring You out of it."

verses.kjv: Ye have feared the sword; and I will bring a sword upon you, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "You dread the sword, so I will bring a sword against You, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: And I will bring you out of the midst thereof, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.
verses.modern: "I will bring You out of the city and hand You over to foreigners. I will execute judgment on You."

verses.kjv: Ye shall fall by the sword; I will judge you in the border of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "You will fall by the sword. I will judge You at the border of Israel. You will know that I am the LORD."

verses.kjv: This city shall not be your caldron, neither shall ye be the flesh in the midst thereof; but I will judge you in the border of Israel:
verses.modern: "This city will not be Your pot, and You will not be the meat in it. I will judge You at the border of Israel."

verses.kjv: And ye shall know that I am the LORD: for ye have not walked in my statutes, neither executed my judgments, but have done after the manners of the heathen that are round about you.
verses.modern: "You will know that I am the LORD, for You have not lived by My statutes or followed My laws. Instead You have followed the practices of the heathen around you."

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when I prophesied, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then fell I down upon my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, Ah Lord GOD! wilt thou make a full end of the remnant of Israel?
verses.modern: While I was prophesying, Pelatiah son of Benaiah died. I fell facedown and cried out, "Ah, Lord GOD! Will You completely destroy the remnant of Israel?"

verses.kjv: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, thy brethren, even thy brethren, the men of thy kindred, and all the house of Israel wholly, are they unto whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, Get you far from the LORD: unto us is this land given in possession.
verses.modern: "Son of man, the people of Jerusalem have said about your fellow exiles and all the house of Israel, 'They are far from the LORD. This land has been given to us as our possession.'"

verses.kjv: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Although I have cast them far off among the heathen, and although I have scattered them among the countries, yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come.
verses.modern: "Therefore say: This is what the Lord GOD says: Although I sent them far away among the heathen and scattered them among the lands, yet I have been a small sanctuary for them in the countries where they have gone."

verses.kjv: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even gather you from the people, and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.
verses.modern: "Therefore say: This is what the Lord GOD says: I will gather You from the peoples and assemble You from the lands where You have been scattered, and I will give You back the land of Israel."

verses.kjv: And they shall come thither, and they shall take away all the detestable things thereof and all the abominations thereof from thence.
verses.modern: "When they return, they will remove all its vile images and detestable idols."

verses.kjv: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them an heart of flesh:
verses.modern: "I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within them. I will remove their heart of stone and give them a heart of flesh."

verses.kjv: That they may walk in my statutes, and keep mine ordinances, and do them: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God.
verses.modern: "Then they will follow My statutes and keep My laws and carry them out. They will be My people, and I will be their God."

verses.kjv: But as for them whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will recompense their way upon their own heads, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "But as for those whose hearts are devoted to their vile images and detestable idols, I will bring their deeds on their own heads, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: Then did the cherubims lift up their wings, and the wheels beside them; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
verses.modern: Then the cherubim spread their wings, and the wheels were beside them. The glory of the God of Israel was above them.

verses.kjv: And the glory of the LORD went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city.
verses.modern: The glory of the LORD rose up from within the city and stopped on the mountain to the east of the city.

verses.kjv: Afterwards the spirit took me up, and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to them of the captivity. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.
verses.modern: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God to the exiles in Babylonia. After this the vision I had seen went away from me.

verses.kjv: Then I spake unto them of the captivity all the things that the LORD had shewed me.
verses.modern: I told the exiles everything the LORD had shown me.

chapters.summary: The glory of the LORD departs from the city and stands on the mountain east of Jerusalem. Yet the LORD promises to gather His scattered people, give them one heart, put a new spirit within them, and replace their heart of stone with a heart of flesh.

verses.kjv: The word of the LORD also came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, thou dwellest in the midst of a rebellious house, which have eyes to see, and see not; they have ears to hear, and hear not: for they are a rebellious house.
verses.modern: "Son of man, You live among a rebellious people. They have eyes to see but do not see, ears to hear but do not hear — for they are a rebellious house."

verses.kjv: Therefore, thou son of man, prepare thee stuff for removing, and remove by day in their sight; and thou shalt remove from thy place to another place in their sight: it may be they will consider, though they be a rebellious house.
verses.modern: "Son of man, pack Your belongings for exile and move out in the daytime as they watch. Move from Your place to another place in their sight. Perhaps they will understand, even though they are a rebellious house."

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou bring forth thy stuff by day in their sight, as stuff for removing: and thou shalt go forth at even in their sight, as they that go forth into captivity.
verses.modern: "Bring out Your belongings by day as if going into exile. Then go out in the evening as they watch — as those who go into captivity go out."

verses.kjv: Dig thou through the wall in their sight, and carry out thereby.
verses.modern: "Dig through the wall in their sight and carry Your belongings out through it."

verses.kjv: In their sight shalt thou bear it upon thy shoulders, and carry it forth in the twilight: thou shalt cover thy face, that thou see not the ground: for I have set thee for a sign unto the house of Israel.
verses.modern: "Carry Your pack on Your shoulders and go out in the dark. Cover Your face so You cannot see the ground — for I have made You a sign to the house of Israel."

verses.kjv: And I did so as I was commanded: I brought forth my stuff by day, as stuff for captivity, and in the even I digged through the wall with mine hand; I brought it forth in the twilight, and I bare it upon my shoulder in their sight.
verses.modern: I did as I was commanded. By day I brought out my belongings as though going into exile. In the evening I dug through the wall by hand. I carried my pack out in the dark and bore it on my shoulder as they watched.

verses.kjv: And in the morning came the word of the LORD unto me, saying,
verses.modern: In the morning the word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, hath not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said unto thee, What doest thou?
verses.modern: "Son of man, did the house of Israel — that rebellious house — not ask You what You were doing?"

verses.kjv: Say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; This burden concerneth the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel that are among them.
verses.modern: "Say to them: This is what the Lord GOD says: This message concerns the prince in Jerusalem and the whole house of Israel who are there."

verses.kjv: Say, I am your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them: they shall remove and go into captivity.
verses.modern: "Say: I am a sign to You. As I have done, so it will be done to them. They will go into exile as captives."

verses.kjv: And the prince that is among them shall bear upon his shoulder in the twilight, and shall go forth: they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby: he shall cover his face, that he see not the ground with his eyes.
verses.modern: "The prince among them will put his pack on his shoulder in the dark and go out through the wall. They will dig a hole through the wall to carry him through. He will cover his face so he cannot see the land."

verses.kjv: My net also will I spread upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare: and I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die there.
verses.modern: "I will throw My net over him and catch him in My snare. I will bring him to Babylon in the land of the Chaldeans, but he will not see it — and there he will die."

verses.kjv: And I will scatter toward every wind all that are about him to help him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.
verses.modern: "I will scatter in every direction all his helpers and all his troops, and I will pursue them with a drawn sword."

verses.kjv: And they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall scatter them among the nations, and disperse them in the countries.
verses.modern: "They will know that I am the LORD when I scatter them among the nations and disperse them through the lands."

verses.kjv: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the heathen whither they come; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "But I will spare a few of them from sword, famine, and plague, so they may confess all their abominations among the heathen where they go. They will know that I am the LORD."

verses.kjv: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, eat thy bread with quaking, and drink thy water with trembling and with carefulness;
verses.modern: "Son of man, eat Your bread while trembling and drink Your water in fear and anxiety."

verses.kjv: And say unto the people of the land, Thus saith the Lord GOD of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and of the land of Israel; They shall eat their bread with carefulness, and drink their water with astonishment, that her land may be desolate from all that is therein, because of the violence of all them that dwell therein.
