verses.modern: "Say to the people of the land: This is what the Lord GOD says about those living in Jerusalem and in the land of Israel. They will eat their food in anxiety and drink their water in despair. Their land will be stripped bare because of the violence of all who live there."

verses.kjv: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be desolate; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "The inhabited cities will lie in ruins and the land will become a wasteland. Then You will know that I am the LORD."

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, what is that proverb that ye have in the land of Israel, saying, The days are prolonged, and every vision faileth?
verses.modern: "Son of man, what is this proverb You have in the land of Israel: 'The days drag on and every vision fails to come true'?"

verses.kjv: Tell them therefore, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel; but say unto them, The days are at hand, and the effect of every vision.
verses.modern: "Say to them: This is what the Lord GOD says: I am going to stop this proverb. It will no longer be used in Israel. Say to them, 'The days are near when every vision will be fulfilled.'"

verses.kjv: For there shall be no more any vain vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.
verses.modern: "There will be no more false visions or flattering predictions within the house of Israel."

verses.kjv: For I am the LORD: I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass; it shall be no more prolonged: for in your days, O rebellious house, will I say the word, and will perform it, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "For I am the LORD. I will speak, and the word I speak will be fulfilled. It will no longer be delayed. In Your own days, You rebellious house, I will speak the word and carry it out, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, The vision that he seeth is for many days to come, and he prophesieth of the times that are far off.
verses.modern: "Son of man, the house of Israel is saying, 'The vision He sees is for many years from now. He is prophesying about the distant future.'"

verses.kjv: Therefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; There shall none of my words be prolonged any more, but the word which I have spoken shall be done, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "Therefore say to them: This is what the Lord GOD says: None of My words will be delayed any longer. The word I have spoken will be fulfilled, declares the Lord GOD."

chapters.summary: The LORD commands Ezekiel to pack his belongings and dig through the wall in the sight of the people as a sign of exile. The prince in Jerusalem will carry his bags on his shoulder at twilight, and every vision and prophecy will shortly be fulfilled — no longer delayed.

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel that prophesy, and say thou unto them that prophesy out of their own hearts, Hear ye the word of the LORD;
verses.modern: "Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who are now prophesying. Say to those who prophesy from their own imagination, 'Hear the word of the LORD!'"

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe unto the foolish prophets, that follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!
verses.modern: "This is what the Lord GOD says: How terrible it will be for the foolish prophets who follow their own spirit and have seen nothing!"

verses.kjv: O Israel, thy prophets are like the foxes in the deserts.
verses.modern: "Israel, Your prophets are like jackals among ruins."

verses.kjv: Ye have not gone up into the gaps, neither made up the hedge for the house of Israel to stand in the battle in the day of the LORD.
verses.modern: "You have not gone up to the breaks in the wall or repaired it for the house of Israel so it will stand firm in battle on the day of the LORD."

verses.kjv: They have seen vanity and lying divination, saying, The LORD saith: and the LORD hath not sent them: and they have made others to hope that they would confirm the word.
verses.modern: "Their visions are false and their divinations a lie. They say, 'The LORD declares,' but the LORD has not sent them. Yet they expect their word to be confirmed."

verses.kjv: Have ye not seen a vain vision, and have ye not spoken a lying divination, whereas ye say, The LORD saith it; albeit I have not spoken?
verses.modern: "Have You not seen false visions and spoken lying divinations when You say, 'The LORD declares,' though I have not spoken?"

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye have spoken vanity, and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Because You have spoken false visions and seen lies, I am against You, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: And mine hand shall be upon the prophets that see vanity, and that divine lies: they shall not be in the assembly of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither shall they enter into the land of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and give lying predictions. They will not belong to the council of My people or be listed in the records of Israel or enter the land of Israel. You will know that I am the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and there was no peace; and one built up a wall, and, lo, others daubed it with untempered morter:
verses.modern: "Because they have led My people astray by saying 'Peace' when there is no peace — and because when a flimsy wall is built, they coat it with whitewash —"

verses.kjv: Say unto them which daub it with untempered morter, that it shall fall: there shall be an overflowing shower; and ye, O great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall rend it.
verses.modern: "tell those who coat it with whitewash that it will fall. A torrential rain will come. I will send great hailstones crashing down, and a violent wind will tear it apart."

verses.kjv: Lo, when the wall is fallen, shall it not be said unto you, Where is the daubing wherewith ye have daubed it?
verses.modern: "When the wall collapses, people will say to You, 'Where is the whitewash You covered it with?'"

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even rend it with a stormy wind in my fury; and there shall be an overflowing shower in mine anger, and great hailstones in my fury to consume it.
verses.modern: "Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: In My wrath I will send a violent wind. In My anger a torrential rain will fall, and in My fury great hailstones will pound it to destruction."

verses.kjv: So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered morter, and bring it down to the ground, so that the foundation thereof shall be discovered, and it shall fall, and ye shall be consumed in the midst thereof: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "I will tear down the wall You have covered with whitewash and level it to the ground so that its foundation will be exposed. When it falls, You will be destroyed in it. You will know that I am the LORD."

verses.kjv: Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall, and upon them that have daubed it with untempered morter, and will say unto you, The wall is no more, neither they that daubed it;
verses.modern: "I will spend My wrath on the wall and on those who covered it with whitewash. I will say to You, 'The wall is gone, and so are those who whitewashed it.'"

verses.kjv: To wit, the prophets of Israel which prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and which see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "These are the prophets of Israel who prophesied to Jerusalem and saw visions of peace for her when there was no peace, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: Likewise, thou son of man, set thy face against the daughters of thy people, which prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy thou against them,
verses.modern: "Now, Son of man, set Your face against the daughters of Your people who prophesy from their own imagination. Prophesy against them."

verses.kjv: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the women that sew pillows to all armholes, and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls! Will ye hunt the souls of my people, and will ye save the souls alive that come unto you?
verses.modern: "Say: This is what the Lord GOD says: How terrible it will be for the women who sew magic bands on every wrist and make veils for people of every height to trap souls. Will You trap the souls of My people and keep Your own souls alive?"

verses.kjv: And will ye pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to slay the souls that should not die, and to save the souls alive that should not live, by your lying to my people that hear your lies?
verses.modern: "You have defiled Me among My people for handfuls of barley and pieces of bread. By lying to My people who love a lie, You have killed those who should not die and kept alive those who should not live."

verses.kjv: Wherefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against your pillows, wherewith ye there hunt the souls to make them fly, and I will tear them from your arms, and will let the souls go, even the souls that ye hunt to make them fly.
verses.modern: "Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I am against Your magic bands with which You trap people like birds. I will tear them from Your arms and set free the people you have trapped."

verses.kjv: Your kerchiefs also will I tear, and deliver my people out of your hand, and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "I will tear off Your veils and rescue My people from Your hands. They will no longer fall prey to Your power. You will know that I am the LORD."

verses.kjv: Because with lies ye have made the heart of the righteous sad, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, by promising him life:
verses.modern: "Because you disheartened the righteous with your lies when I had not caused them grief, and because you encouraged the wicked not to turn from their evil ways and so preserved their lives —"

verses.kjv: Therefore ye shall see no more vanity, nor divine divinations: for I will deliver my people out of your hand: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "therefore You will no longer see false visions or give predictions. I will rescue My people from Your hands. You will know that I am the LORD."

chapters.summary: The LORD condemns the false prophets of Israel who prophesy peace when there is no peace, whitewashing a flimsy wall. He also denounces the women who sew magic bands and veils to hunt souls for handfuls of barley and pieces of bread.

verses.kjv: Then came certain of the elders of Israel unto me, and sat before me.
verses.modern: Some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat down in front of me.

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, these men have set up their idols in their heart, and put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face: should I be enquired of at all by them?
verses.modern: "Son of man, these men have set up idols in their hearts and placed the stumbling block of their iniquity right in front of them. Should I let them inquire of Me at all?"

verses.kjv: Therefore speak unto them, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Every man of the house of Israel that setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to the prophet; I the LORD will answer him that cometh according to the multitude of his idols;
verses.modern: "Speak to them and say: This is what the Lord GOD says: When any Israelite sets up idols in His heart and puts the stumbling block of His iniquity before Him, and then comes to a prophet — I the LORD will answer Him according to His many idols."

verses.kjv: That I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.
verses.modern: "I will do this to recapture the hearts of the people of Israel who have all abandoned Me for their idols."

verses.kjv: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Repent, and turn yourselves from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations.
verses.modern: "Therefore say to the house of Israel: This is what the Lord GOD says: Repent. Turn from Your idols and turn away from all Your abominations."

verses.kjv: For every one of the house of Israel, or of the stranger that sojourneth in Israel, which separateth himself from me, and setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to a prophet to enquire of him concerning me; I the LORD will answer him by myself:
verses.modern: "When any Israelite or any foreigner living in Israel separates Himself from Me, sets up idols in His heart, puts the stumbling block of His iniquity before Him, and comes to a prophet to ask Me something — I the LORD will answer Him Myself."

verses.kjv: And I will set my face against that man, and will make him a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from the midst of my people; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "I will set My face against that man and make him a sign and a byword. I will cut Him off from among My people. You will know that I am the LORD."

verses.kjv: And if the prophet be deceived when he hath spoken a thing, I the LORD have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.
verses.modern: "And if a prophet is deceived and speaks a message, I the LORD have allowed that prophet to be deceived. I will stretch out My hand against Him and destroy Him from among My people Israel."

verses.kjv: And they shall bear the punishment of their iniquity: the punishment of the prophet shall be even as the punishment of him that seeketh unto him;
verses.modern: "Both the prophet and the person who consults him will bear the punishment for their iniquity."

verses.kjv: That the house of Israel may go no more astray from me, neither be polluted any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "This is so the house of Israel will no longer stray from Me and will no longer defile themselves with all their transgressions. They will be My people and I will be their God, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, when the land sinneth against me by trespassing grievously, then will I stretch out mine hand upon it, and will break the staff of the bread thereof, and will send famine upon it, and will cut off man and beast from it:
verses.modern: "Son of man, when a land sins against Me by trespassing grievously, I will stretch out My hand against it and cut off its food supply. I will send famine on it and cut off man and beast from it."

verses.kjv: Though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver but their own souls by their righteousness, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "Even if these three men — Noah, Daniel, and Job — were in it, they could save only themselves by their righteousness, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: If I cause noisome beasts to pass through the land, and they spoil it, so that it be desolate, that no man may pass through because of the beasts:
verses.modern: "If I send wild animals through that country and they leave it childless and it becomes desolate so that no one will travel through it because of the animals —"

verses.kjv: Though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters; they only shall be delivered, but the land shall be desolate.
verses.modern: "as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, even if these three men were in it, they could not save their own sons or daughters. They alone would be saved, but the land would be desolate."

verses.kjv: Or if I bring a sword upon that land, and say, Sword, go through the land; so that I cut off man and beast from it:
verses.modern: "Or if I bring a sword against that country and say, 'Let the sword pass through the land,' and I kill its people and their animals —"

verses.kjv: Though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only shall be delivered themselves.
verses.modern: "as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, even if these three men were in it, they could not save their own sons or daughters. They alone would be saved."

verses.kjv: Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my fury upon it in blood, to cut off from it man and beast:
verses.modern: "Or if I send a plague into that land and pour out My wrath on it with bloodshed to kill its people and their animals —"

verses.kjv: Though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither son nor daughter; they shall but deliver their own souls by their righteousness.
verses.modern: "as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were in it, they could not save son or daughter. They would save only themselves by their righteousness."

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD; How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem, the sword, and the famine, and the noisome beast, and the pestilence, to cut off from it man and beast?
verses.modern: "For this is what the Lord GOD says: How much worse will it be when I send My four dreadful judgments against Jerusalem — sword, famine, wild animals, and plague — to kill its people and their animals!"

verses.kjv: Yet, behold, therein shall be left a remnant that shall be brought forth, both sons and daughters: behold, they shall come forth unto you, and ye shall see their way and their doings: and ye shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought upon it.
verses.modern: "Yet there will be survivors — sons and daughters who will be brought out. They will come to You, and when You see their behavior and their actions, You will be comforted about the disaster I have brought on Jerusalem — about everything I have brought on it."

verses.kjv: And they shall comfort you, when ye see their ways and their doings: and ye shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "They will comfort You when You see how they have behaved. You will know that I did not do without cause everything I have done in it, declares the Lord GOD."

chapters.summary: Elders come to Ezekiel, but the LORD declares they have set up idols in their hearts. He warns that even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were in a sinful land, they could save only themselves by their own righteousness — not their sons or daughters.

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, What is the vine tree more than any tree, or than a branch which is among the trees of the forest?
verses.modern: "Son of man, what good is the wood of a grapevine compared to any other wood — to a branch from any of the trees of the forest?"

verses.kjv: Shall wood be taken thereof to do any work? or will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon?
verses.modern: "Is wood from a vine ever used for anything useful? Can anyone make a peg from it to hang things on?"

verses.kjv: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire devoureth both the ends of it, and the middle of it is burned. Is it meet for any work?
verses.modern: "No — it is thrown into the fire as fuel. The fire burns both ends and chars the middle. Is it then useful for anything?"

verses.kjv: Behold, when it was whole, it was meet for no work: how much less shall it be meet yet for any work, when the fire hath devoured it, and it is burned?
verses.modern: "Even when it was whole it was not fit for any purpose. How much less can it be made into something useful when fire has burned and charred it?"

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; As the vine tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.modern: "Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: As I have given the wood of the vine among the forest trees as fuel for fire, so I will treat the inhabitants of Jerusalem."

verses.kjv: And I will set my face against them; they shall go out from one fire, and another fire shall devour them; and ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I set my face against them.
verses.modern: "I will set My face against them. Although they have escaped from one fire, another fire will consume them. You will know that I am the LORD when I set My face against them."

verses.kjv: And I will make the land desolate, because they have committed a trespass, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "I will make the land desolate because they have committed a trespass, declares the Lord GOD."

chapters.summary: The LORD compares Jerusalem to a useless vine — its wood cannot even be made into a peg. Since it was worthless even when whole, how much more useless is it now that fire has burned it? The LORD will make the land desolate because of their unfaithfulness.

verses.kjv: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations,
verses.modern: "Son of man, confront Jerusalem with her abominations."

verses.kjv: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD unto Jerusalem; Thy birth and thy nativity is of the land of Canaan; thy father was an Amorite, and thy mother an Hittite.
verses.modern: "Say: This is what the Lord GOD says to Jerusalem: Your origin and birth were in the land of Canaan. Your father was an Amorite and Your mother a Hittite."

verses.kjv: And as for thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water to supple thee; thou wast not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.
verses.modern: "On the day You were born, Your umbilical cord was not cut, You were not washed with water, You were not rubbed with salt, and You were not wrapped in cloths."

verses.kjv: None eye pitied thee, to do any of these unto thee, to have compassion upon thee; but thou wast cast out in the open field, to the lothing of thy person, in the day that thou wast born.
verses.modern: "No one looked on you with pity or had compassion enough to do any of these things for You. You were thrown out into the open field on the day You were born — despised and rejected."

verses.kjv: And when I passed by thee, and saw thee polluted in thine own blood, I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood, Live; yea, I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood, Live.
verses.modern: "Then I passed by and saw You there, struggling in Your blood. I said to You as You lay in Your blood, 'Live!' Yes, I said to You in Your blood, 'Live!'"

verses.kjv: I have caused thee to multiply as the bud of the field, and thou hast increased and waxen great, and thou art come to excellent ornaments: thy breasts are fashioned, and thine hair is grown, whereas thou wast naked and bare.
verses.modern: "I made You grow like a plant of the field. You grew up and became tall. You came to have great beauty. Your breasts formed and Your hair grew, yet You were naked and bare."

verses.kjv: Now when I passed by thee, and looked upon thee, behold, thy time was the time of love; and I spread my skirt over thee, and covered thy nakedness: yea, I sware unto thee, and entered into a covenant with thee, saith the Lord GOD, and thou becamest mine.
verses.modern: "Later I passed by and looked at You, and You were old enough for love. I spread the corner of My garment over You and covered Your nakedness. I gave You My solemn oath and entered into a covenant with You, declares the Lord GOD, and You became Mine."

verses.kjv: Then washed I thee with water; yea, I throughly washed away thy blood from thee, and I anointed thee with oil.
verses.modern: "I bathed You with water, washed the blood from You, and anointed You with oil."

verses.kjv: I clothed thee also with broidered work, and shod thee with badgers' skin, and I girded thee about with fine linen, and I covered thee with silk.
verses.modern: "I dressed You in embroidered cloth and gave You fine leather sandals. I wrapped You in fine linen and covered You with costly fabric."

verses.kjv: I decked thee also with ornaments, and I put bracelets upon thy hands, and a chain on thy neck.
verses.modern: "I adorned You with jewelry. I put bracelets on Your wrists and a necklace around Your neck."

verses.kjv: And I put a jewel on thy forehead, and earrings in thine ears, and a beautiful crown upon thine head.
verses.modern: "I put a ring on Your nose, earrings in Your ears, and a beautiful crown on Your head."

verses.kjv: Thus wast thou decked with gold and silver; and thy raiment was of fine linen, and silk, and broidered work; thou didst eat fine flour, and honey, and oil: and thou wast exceeding beautiful, and thou didst prosper into a kingdom.
verses.modern: "You were adorned with gold and silver. Your clothing was fine linen, costly fabric, and embroidered cloth. You ate fine flour, honey, and olive oil. You grew very beautiful and became a queen."

verses.kjv: And thy renown went forth among the heathen for thy beauty: for it was perfect through my comeliness, which I had put upon thee, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "Your fame spread among the heathen because of your beauty, for it was perfect because of the splendor I gave You, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: But thou didst trust in thine own beauty, and playedst the harlot because of thy renown, and pouredst out thy fornications on every one that passed by; his it was.
verses.modern: "But You trusted in Your beauty and used Your fame to become a harlot. You lavished Your favors on everyone who passed by and Your beauty became His."

verses.kjv: And of thy garments thou didst take, and deckedst thy high places with divers colours, and playedst the harlot thereupon: the like things shall not come, neither shall it be so.
verses.modern: "You took some of Your clothes and made colorful shrines, where You played the harlot. Such things should not happen and should not occur."

verses.kjv: Thou hast also taken thy fair jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given thee, and madest to thyself images of men, and didst commit whoredom with them,
verses.modern: "You also took the beautiful jewelry I gave You — the gold and silver — and You made for Yourself male idols and committed whoredom with them."

verses.kjv: And tookest thy broidered garments, and coveredst them: and thou hast set mine oil and mine incense before them.
verses.modern: "You took Your embroidered clothes and covered them. You set My oil and My incense before them."

verses.kjv: My meat also which I gave thee, fine flour, and oil, and honey, wherewith I fed thee, thou hast even set it before them for a sweet savour: and thus it was, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "Also the food I gave You — the fine flour, olive oil, and honey I fed You — you offered as a fragrant aroma before them. That is what happened, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: Moreover thou hast taken thy sons and thy daughters, whom thou hast borne unto me, and these hast thou sacrificed unto them to be devoured. Is this of thy whoredoms a small matter,
verses.modern: "And You took Your sons and daughters whom You bore to Me and sacrificed them as food to idols. Was Your whoredom not enough?"

verses.kjv: That thou hast slain my children, and delivered them to cause them to pass through the fire for them?
verses.modern: "You slaughtered My children and sacrificed them to the idols."

verses.kjv: And in all thine abominations and thy whoredoms thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, when thou wast naked and bare, and wast polluted in thy blood.
verses.modern: "In all Your abominations and Your whoredom You did not remember the days of Your youth — when You were naked and bare, struggling in Your blood."

verses.kjv: And it came to pass after all thy wickedness, (woe, woe unto thee! saith the Lord GOD;)
verses.modern: "After all Your wickedness — how terrible it will be for You, declares the Lord GOD —"

verses.kjv: That thou hast also built unto thee an eminent place, and hast made thee an high place in every street.
verses.modern: "you built Yourself a shrine and made Yourself a high place in every public square."

verses.kjv: Thou hast built thy high place at every head of the way, and hast made thy beauty to be abhorred, and hast opened thy legs to every one that passed by, and multiplied thy whoredoms.
verses.modern: "At every street corner You built Your shrines and degraded Your beauty, offering Yourself to anyone who passed by and multiplying your whoredoms."

verses.kjv: Thou hast also committed fornication with the Egyptians thy neighbours, great of flesh; and hast increased thy whoredoms, to provoke me to anger.
verses.modern: "You committed fornication with the Egyptians, Your neighbors of great flesh, and multiplied Your whoredoms to provoke Me to anger."

verses.kjv: Behold, therefore I have stretched out my hand over thee, and have diminished thine ordinary food, and delivered thee unto the will of them that hate thee, the daughters of the Philistines, which are ashamed of thy lewd way.
verses.modern: "Therefore I stretched out My hand against You and reduced Your food supply. I handed You over to the desire of those who hate You — the daughters of the Philistines, who were appalled by Your shameless conduct."

verses.kjv: Thou hast played the whore also with the Assyrians, because thou wast unsatiable; yea, thou hast played the harlot with them, and yet couldest not be satisfied.
verses.modern: "You also played the harlot with the Assyrians because You were never satisfied. You played the harlot with them and still could not be satisfied."

verses.kjv: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy fornication in the land of Canaan unto Chaldea; and yet thou wast not satisfied herewith.
verses.modern: "You multiplied Your whoredoms in the land of Canaan all the way to Chaldea, yet even then You were not satisfied."

verses.kjv: How weak is thine heart, saith the Lord GOD, seeing thou doest all these things, the work of an imperious whorish woman;
verses.modern: "How sick Your heart is, declares the Lord GOD, that You did all these things — the brazen acts of a shameless harlot."

verses.kjv: In that thou buildest thine eminent place in the head of every way, and makest thine high place in every street; and hast not been as an harlot, in that thou scornest hire;
verses.modern: "When You built Your shrines at every street corner and Your high places in every public square, You were unlike a harlot — you refused payment."

verses.kjv: But as a wife that committeth adultery, which taketh strangers instead of her husband!
verses.modern: "You were an adulterous wife who takes strangers instead of her own husband!"

verses.kjv: They give gifts to all whores: but thou givest thy gifts to all thy lovers, and hirest them, that they may come unto thee on every side for thy whoredom.
verses.modern: "Every harlot receives payment, but You gave gifts to all Your lovers, paying them to come to You from all around for Your whoredoms."

verses.kjv: And the contrary is in thee from other women in thy whoredoms, whereas none followeth thee to commit whoredoms: and in that thou givest a reward, and no reward is given unto thee, therefore thou art contrary.
verses.modern: "You were the opposite of other women. No one solicited you — you solicited them. You paid Your lovers instead of receiving payment. You were completely different."

verses.kjv: Wherefore, O harlot, hear the word of the LORD:
verses.modern: "Therefore, You harlot, hear the word of the LORD!"

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thy filthiness was poured out, and thy nakedness discovered through thy whoredoms with thy lovers, and with all the idols of thy abominations, and by the blood of thy children, which thou didst give unto them;
verses.modern: "This is what the Lord GOD says: Because You poured out Your lust and exposed Your nakedness in Your whoredom with Your lovers — with all Your vile idols — and because You gave them Your children's blood —"

verses.kjv: Behold, therefore I will gather all thy lovers, with whom thou hast taken pleasure, and all them that thou hast loved, with all them that thou hast hated; I will even gather them round about against thee, and will discover thy nakedness unto them, that they may see all thy nakedness.
verses.modern: "therefore I am going to gather all Your lovers with whom You found pleasure — all those You loved and all those You hated. I will gather them against You from all around and strip You naked in front of them, and they will see Your complete nakedness."

verses.kjv: And I will judge thee, as women that break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will give thee blood in fury and jealousy.
verses.modern: "I will punish You as women who commit adultery and shed blood are punished. I will bring on You the blood of wrath and jealousy."

verses.kjv: And I will also give thee into their hand, and they shall throw down thine eminent place, and shall break down thy high places: they shall strip thee also of thy clothes, and shall take thy fair jewels, and leave thee naked and bare.
verses.modern: "I will hand You over to them, and they will tear down Your shrines and demolish Your high places. They will strip off Your clothes, take Your beautiful jewelry, and leave You naked and bare."

verses.kjv: They shall also bring up a company against thee, and they shall stone thee with stones, and thrust thee through with their swords.
verses.modern: "They will bring a crowd against You and stone You and cut You to pieces with their swords."

verses.kjv: And they shall burn thine houses with fire, and execute judgments upon thee in the sight of many women: and I will cause thee to cease from playing the harlot, and thou also shalt give no hire any more.
verses.modern: "They will burn Your houses with fire and execute judgment on You in the sight of many women. I will put an end to Your whoredom, and You will no longer pay lovers."

verses.kjv: So will I make my fury toward thee to rest, and my jealousy shall depart from thee, and I will be quiet, and will be no more angry.
verses.modern: "Then My wrath against You will be spent and My jealousy will depart. I will be calm and no longer angry."

verses.kjv: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, but hast fretted me in all these things; behold, therefore I also will recompense thy way upon thine head, saith the Lord GOD: and thou shalt not commit this lewdness above all thine abominations.
verses.modern: "Because You did not remember the days of Your youth but enraged Me with all these things — I will surely bring Your conduct down on Your own head, declares the Lord GOD. Did You not add indecency to all Your other abominations?"

verses.kjv: Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall use this proverb against thee, saying, As is the mother, so is her daughter.
verses.modern: "Everyone who uses proverbs will apply this to You: 'Like mother, like daughter.'"

verses.kjv: Thou art thy mother's daughter, that lotheth her husband and her children; and thou art the sister of thy sisters, which lothed their husbands and their children: your mother was an Hittite, and your father an Amorite.
verses.modern: "You are a true daughter of Your mother, who despised her husband and her children. You are a true sister of Your sisters, who despised their husbands and children. Your mother was a Hittite and Your father an Amorite."

verses.kjv: And thine elder sister is Samaria, she and her daughters that dwell at thy left hand: and thy younger sister, that dwelleth at thy right hand, is Sodom and her daughters.
verses.modern: "Your older sister is Samaria, who lives with her daughters to Your north. Your younger sister, who lives with her daughters to Your south, is Sodom."

verses.kjv: Yet hast thou not walked after their ways, nor done after their abominations: but, as if that were a very little thing, thou wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways.
verses.modern: "You have not merely walked in their ways or done their abominations. In a very short time You were more corrupt than they in all Your ways."

verses.kjv: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters.
verses.modern: "As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, Your sister Sodom and her daughters never did what You and Your daughters have done."

verses.kjv: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
verses.modern: "Now this was the iniquity of Your sister Sodom: she and her daughters had pride, fullness of bread, and abundance of idleness. They did not strengthen the hand of the poor and needy."

verses.kjv: And they were haughty, and committed abomination before me: therefore I took them away as I saw good.
verses.modern: "They were haughty and did detestable things before Me. Therefore I removed them when I saw it."

verses.kjv: Neither hath Samaria committed half of thy sins; but thou hast multiplied thine abominations more than they, and hast justified thy sisters in all thine abominations which thou hast done.
verses.modern: "Samaria did not commit half Your sins. You have done more abominations than they have. By all the abominations You have done, You have made Your sisters look righteous."

verses.kjv: Thou also, which hast judged thy sisters, bear thine own shame for thy sins that thou hast committed more abominable than they: they are more righteous than thou: yea, be thou confounded also, and bear thy shame, in that thou hast justified thy sisters.
verses.modern: "Bear Your own disgrace, for You have given Your sisters reason to appear righteous. Since You sinned more abominably than they did, they are more righteous than You. Be ashamed and bear Your disgrace, for You have made Your sisters appear righteous."

verses.kjv: When I shall bring again their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, then will I bring again the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them:
verses.modern: "But I will bring again their captivity — the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters — and I will bring again Your captives in the midst of them."

verses.kjv: That thou mayest bear thine own shame, and mayest be confounded in all that thou hast done, in that thou art a comfort unto them.
verses.modern: "so that You may bear Your disgrace and be ashamed of all You have done in becoming a comfort to them."

verses.kjv: When thy sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former estate, and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate, then thou and thy daughters shall return to your former estate.
verses.modern: "Your sisters — Sodom and her daughters, and Samaria and her daughters — will return to what they were before. You and Your daughters will also return to what You were before."

verses.kjv: For thy sister Sodom was not mentioned by thy mouth in the day of thy pride,
verses.modern: "In Your days of pride You did not even mention Your sister Sodom."

verses.kjv: Before thy wickedness was discovered, as at the time of thy reproach of the daughters of Syria, and all that are round about her, the daughters of the Philistines, which despise thee round about.
verses.modern: "That was before Your wickedness was exposed. Now You are the object of scorn for the daughters of Aram and all her neighbors, and for the daughters of the Philistines — all those around You who despise You."

verses.kjv: Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thine abominations, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: "You will bear the consequences of Your lewdness and Your abominations, declares the LORD."

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even deal with thee as thou hast done, which hast despised the oath in breaking the covenant.
verses.modern: "For this is what the Lord GOD says: I will deal with You as You deserve, because You have despised the oath by breaking the covenant."

verses.kjv: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth, and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.
verses.modern: "Yet I will remember the covenant I made with You in the days of Your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with You."

verses.kjv: Then thou shalt remember thy ways, and be ashamed, when thou shalt receive thy sisters, thine elder and thy younger: and I will give them unto thee for daughters, but not by thy covenant.
verses.modern: "Then You will remember Your ways and be ashamed when You receive Your sisters, both Your older and Your younger. I will give them to You as daughters, but not on account of Your covenant."

verses.kjv: And I will establish my covenant with thee; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD:
verses.modern: "So I will establish My covenant with You, and You will know that I am the LORD."

verses.kjv: That thou mayest remember, and be confounded, and never open thy mouth any more because of thy shame, when I am pacified toward thee for all that thou hast done, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "Then when I make atonement for You for all You have done, You will remember and be ashamed and never open Your mouth again because of Your disgrace, declares the Lord GOD."

chapters.summary: The LORD tells Jerusalem's history as an allegory: she was an abandoned infant whom He rescued, raised, and married. She became exceedingly beautiful but played the harlot with every nation around her, worse than Sodom and Samaria — yet the LORD will remember His covenant and establish an everlasting covenant with her.

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, put forth a riddle, and speak a parable unto the house of Israel;
verses.modern: "Son of man, set forth a riddle and tell a parable to the house of Israel."

verses.kjv: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; A great eagle with great wings, longwinged, full of feathers, which had divers colours, came unto Lebanon, and took the highest branch of the cedar:
verses.modern: "Say: This is what the Lord GOD says: A great eagle with powerful wings, long feathers, and full plumage of varied colors came to Lebanon and took the top of the cedar."

verses.kjv: He cropped off the top of his young twigs, and carried it into a land of traffick; he set it in a city of merchants.
verses.modern: "He broke off the topmost of its young twigs and carried it to a land of traders. He planted it in a city of merchants."

verses.kjv: He took also of the seed of the land, and planted it in a fruitful field; he placed it by great waters, and set it as a willow tree.
verses.modern: "He also took some of the seed of the land and planted it in fertile soil. He put it beside plentiful waters and set it like a willow."

verses.kjv: And it grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and the roots thereof were under him: so it became a vine, and brought forth branches, and shot forth sprigs.
verses.modern: "It sprouted and became a spreading vine — low-growing but wide. Its branches turned toward Him, and its roots grew down into the soil. So it became a vine, produced branches, and put out leafy boughs."

verses.kjv: There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers: and, behold, this vine did bend her roots toward him, and shot forth her branches toward him, that he might water it by the furrows of her plantation.
verses.modern: "But there was another great eagle with powerful wings and full plumage. This vine bent its roots toward Him and stretched its branches toward Him, looking for water from the soil where it was planted."

verses.kjv: It was planted in a good soil by great waters, that it might bring forth branches, and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a goodly vine.
verses.modern: "It had been planted in good soil beside abundant waters so it could produce branches, bear fruit, and become a splendid vine."

verses.kjv: Say thou, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Shall it prosper? shall he not pull up the roots thereof, and cut off the fruit thereof, that it wither? it shall wither in all the leaves of its spring, even without great power or many people to pluck it up by the roots thereof.
verses.modern: "Say to them: This is what the Lord GOD says: Will it thrive? Will not the first eagle pull up its roots and strip off its fruit so it withers? All its fresh growth will wither. It will not take a strong arm or many people to pull it up by the roots."

verses.kjv: Yea, behold, being planted, shall it prosper? shall it not utterly wither, when the east wind toucheth it? it shall wither in the furrows where it grew.
verses.modern: "Even though it was planted, will it thrive? Will it not utterly wither when the east wind strikes it — wither away in the very beds where it grew?"

verses.kjv: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Say now to the rebellious house, Know ye not what these things mean? tell them, Behold, the king of Babylon is come to Jerusalem, and hath taken the king thereof, and the princes thereof, and led them with him to Babylon;
verses.modern: "Say to that rebellious house: Don't you know what these things mean? The king of Babylon came to Jerusalem, took its king and its officials, and brought them back to Babylon."

verses.kjv: And hath taken of the king's seed, and made a covenant with him, and hath taken an oath of him: he hath also taken the mighty of the land:
verses.modern: "He took a member of the royal family and made a covenant with him, binding him with an oath. He also took away the leading men of the land."

verses.kjv: That the kingdom might be base, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping of his covenant it might stand.
verses.modern: "This was so that the kingdom would be kept low, unable to rise again — surviving only by keeping the covenant."

verses.kjv: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and much people. Shall he prosper? shall he escape that doeth such things? or shall he break the covenant, and be delivered?
verses.modern: "But the king of Judah rebelled against Babylon by sending envoys to Egypt to get horses and a great army. Will he succeed? Can he break the covenant and escape?"

verses.kjv: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely in the place where the king dwelleth that made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he brake, even with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.
verses.modern: "As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, He will die in Babylon — in the land of the king who put him on the throne and whose oath he despised and whose covenant He broke."

verses.kjv: Neither shall Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company make for him in the war, by casting up mounts, and building forts, to cut off many persons:
verses.modern: "Pharaoh with his mighty army and great forces will not help him in the war when siege ramps are built and siege towers erected to destroy many lives."

verses.kjv: Seeing he despised the oath by breaking the covenant, when, lo, he had given his hand, and hath done all these things, he shall not escape.
verses.modern: "He despised the oath by breaking the covenant. Because he had given his word and done all these things, he will not escape."

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; As I live, surely mine oath that he hath despised, and my covenant that he hath broken, even it will I recompense upon his own head.
verses.modern: "Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: As surely as I live, I will bring down on His own head the oath He despised and the covenant He broke."

verses.kjv: And I will spread my net upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare, and I will bring him to Babylon, and will plead with him there for his trespass that he hath trespassed against me.
verses.modern: "I will throw My net over Him and catch Him in My snare. I will bring Him to Babylon and enter into judgment with Him there for the trespass He committed against Me."

verses.kjv: And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword, and they that remain shall be scattered toward all winds: and ye shall know that I the LORD have spoken it.
verses.modern: "All His best troops will fall by the sword, and the survivors will be scattered in every direction. You will know that I the LORD have spoken."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar, and will set it; I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one, and will plant it upon an high mountain and eminent:
verses.modern: "This is what the Lord GOD says: I Myself will take a tender shoot from the top of a tall cedar and plant it. From the topmost of its young branches I will take a tender sprig and plant it on a high and lofty mountain."

verses.kjv: In the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it: and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar: and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell.
verses.modern: "On the mountain heights of Israel I will plant it. It will produce branches and bear fruit and become a great cedar. Birds of every kind will nest in it. They will find shelter in the shade of its branches."

verses.kjv: And all the trees of the field shall know that I the LORD have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish: I the LORD have spoken and have done it.
verses.modern: "All the trees of the field will know that I the LORD bring down the tall tree and make the low tree grow tall. I dry up the green tree and make the dry tree flourish. I the LORD have spoken, and I will do it."

chapters.summary: Ezekiel tells a riddle of two great eagles and a vine. The first eagle represents Babylon, which planted Zedekiah as a vassal king; but the vine turned toward a second eagle — Egypt — breaking the covenant. The LORD declares that He Himself will plant a tender twig on a high mountain, and it will become a noble cedar.

verses.kjv: The word of the LORD came unto me again, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: What mean ye, that ye use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge?
verses.modern: "What do You mean by using this proverb in the land of Israel: 'The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge'?"

verses.kjv: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, ye shall not have occasion any more to use this proverb in Israel.
verses.modern: "As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, You will no longer use this proverb in Israel."

verses.kjv: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul that sinneth, it shall die.
verses.modern: "Every soul belongs to Me — the soul of the father and the soul of the son alike. The soul that sins is the one who will die."

verses.kjv: But if a man be just, and do that which is lawful and right,
verses.modern: "Suppose a man is righteous and does what is just and right."

verses.kjv: And hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, neither hath defiled his neighbour's wife, neither hath come near to a menstruous woman,
verses.modern: "He does not eat at the mountain shrines or look to the idols of Israel. He does not defile His neighbor's wife or sleep with a woman during her period."

verses.kjv: And hath not oppressed any, but hath restored to the debtor his pledge, hath spoiled none by violence, hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment;
verses.modern: "He does not oppress anyone but returns what a borrower pledged. He does not commit robbery but gives His food to the hungry and provides clothing for the naked."

verses.kjv: He that hath not given forth upon usury, neither hath taken any increase, that hath withdrawn his hand from iniquity, hath executed true judgment between man and man,
verses.modern: "He does not lend money at interest or take a profit. He keeps His hand from wrongdoing and judges fairly between man and man."

verses.kjv: Hath walked in my statutes, and hath kept my judgments, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "He follows My decrees and keeps My laws faithfully. That man is righteous. He will surely live, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: If he beget a son that is a robber, a shedder of blood, and that doeth the like to any one of these things,
verses.modern: "But suppose this man has a violent son who sheds blood and does any of these things —"

verses.kjv: And that doeth not any of those duties, but even hath eaten upon the mountains, and defiled his neighbour's wife,
verses.modern: "though the father did not do any of them. The son eats at the mountain shrines, defiles his neighbor's wife,"

verses.kjv: Hath oppressed the poor and needy, hath spoiled by violence, hath not restored the pledge, and hath lifted up his eyes to the idols, hath committed abomination,
verses.modern: "oppresses the poor and needy, commits robbery, does not return what he took as a pledge, looks to idols, and does detestable things."

verses.kjv: Hath given forth upon usury, and hath taken increase: shall he then live? he shall not live: he hath done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon him.
verses.modern: "He lends at interest and takes a profit. Will such a man live? He will not! Because he has done all these detestable things, he will surely die. His blood will be on his own head."

verses.kjv: Now, lo, if he beget a son, that seeth all his father's sins which he hath done, and considereth, and doeth not such like,
verses.modern: "But suppose this violent son has a son who sees all the sins his father committed, and though he sees them, he does not do such things."

verses.kjv: That hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hath not defiled his neighbour's wife,
verses.modern: "He does not eat at the mountain shrines or look to the idols of Israel. He does not defile his neighbor's wife."

verses.kjv: Neither hath oppressed any, hath not withholden the pledge, neither hath spoiled by violence, but hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment,
verses.modern: "He does not oppress anyone or hold back any pledge. He does not commit robbery but gives his food to the hungry and provides clothing for the naked."

verses.kjv: That hath taken off his hand from the poor, that hath not received usury nor increase, hath executed my judgments, hath walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father, he shall surely live.
verses.modern: "He withholds his hand from sin and takes no interest or profit. He keeps My laws and follows My decrees. He will not die for his father's iniquity. He will surely live."

verses.kjv: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, spoiled his brother by violence, and did that which is not good among his people, behold, even he shall die in his iniquity.
verses.modern: "But his father will die for his own iniquity, because he practiced extortion, robbed his brother, and did what was wrong among his people."

verses.kjv: Yet say ye, Why? doth not the son bear the iniquity of the father? When the son hath done that which is lawful and right, and hath kept all my statutes, and hath done them, he shall surely live.
verses.modern: "Yet you say, 'Why? Does not the son bear the iniquity of the father?' When the son has done what is lawful and right, and has kept all My statutes and done them, he will surely live.

verses.kjv: The soul that sinneth, it shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son: the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him.
verses.modern: The soul that sins, it shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son. The righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him.

verses.kjv: But if the wicked will turn from all his sins that he hath committed, and keep all my statutes, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
verses.modern: "But if a wicked person turns away from all his sins and keeps all My decrees, doing what is just and right — he will surely live. He will not die."

verses.kjv: All his transgressions that he hath committed, they shall not be mentioned unto him: in his righteousness that he hath done he shall live.
verses.modern: "None of the offenses he has committed will be counted against him. Because of the righteous things he has done, he will live."

verses.kjv: Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die? saith the Lord GOD: and not that he should return from his ways, and live?
verses.modern: "Do I take any pleasure in the death of the wicked? declares the Lord GOD. Rather, am I not pleased when they turn from their ways and live?"

verses.kjv: But when the righteous turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and doeth according to all the abominations that the wicked man doeth, shall he live? All his righteousness that he hath done shall not be mentioned: in his trespass that he hath trespassed, and in his sin that he hath sinned, in them shall he die.
verses.modern: "But if a righteous person turns from their righteousness and commits iniquity, doing all the abominations the wicked person does, will they live? None of the righteous things they have done will be remembered. In their trespass that they have trespassed and in their sin that they have sinned, they will die."

verses.kjv: Yet ye say, The way of the LORD is not equal. Hear now, O house of Israel; Is not my way equal? are not your ways unequal?
verses.modern: "Yet you say, 'The way of the Lord is not fair.' Hear me, house of Israel: Is My way unfair? Is it not your ways that are unfair?"

verses.kjv: When a righteous man turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and dieth in them; for his iniquity that he hath done shall he die.
verses.modern: "If a righteous person turns from their righteousness and commits sin, they die for it. They die because of the sin they have committed."

verses.kjv: Again, when the wicked man turneth away from his wickedness that he hath committed, and doeth that which is lawful and right, he shall save his soul alive.
verses.modern: "But if a wicked person turns away from the wickedness they have committed and does what is just and right, they will save their life."

verses.kjv: Because he considereth, and turneth away from all his transgressions that he hath committed, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
verses.modern: "Because they considered all the offenses they had committed and turned away from them, they will surely live. They will not die."

verses.kjv: Yet saith the house of Israel, The way of the Lord is not equal. O house of Israel, are not my ways equal? are not your ways unequal?
verses.modern: "Yet the house of Israel says, 'The way of the Lord is not fair.' Are My ways unfair, house of Israel? Is it not your ways that are unfair?"

verses.kjv: Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways, saith the Lord GOD. Repent, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.
verses.modern: "Therefore I will judge You, house of Israel, each one according to his own ways, declares the Lord GOD. Repent! Turn away from all Your offenses. Then iniquity will not be Your downfall."

verses.kjv: Cast away from you all your transgressions, whereby ye have transgressed; and make you a new heart and a new spirit: for why will ye die, O house of Israel?
verses.modern: "Rid yourselves of all the offenses You have committed, and get a new heart and a new spirit. Why will You die, house of Israel?"

verses.kjv: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth, saith the Lord GOD: wherefore turn yourselves, and live ye.
verses.modern: "For I take no pleasure in the death of anyone, declares the Lord GOD. Repent and live!"

chapters.summary: The LORD declares that the soul that sins shall die — each person bears their own iniquity. A righteous man who turns to wickedness will die; a wicked man who repents and does what is right will live. The LORD takes no pleasure in the death of the wicked but calls all to repent and live.

verses.kjv: Moreover take thou up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,
verses.modern: "Take up a lament for the princes of Israel."

verses.kjv: And say, What is thy mother? A lioness: she lay down among lions, she nourished her whelps among young lions.
verses.modern: "Say: What was your mother? A lioness among lions. She crouched down among young lions. She reared her cubs."

verses.kjv: And she brought up one of her whelps: it became a young lion, and it learned to catch the prey; it devoured men.
verses.modern: "She brought up one of her cubs. He became a young lion. He learned to prey on animals. He devoured men."

verses.kjv: The nations also heard of him; he was taken in their pit, and they brought him with chains unto the land of Egypt.
verses.modern: "The nations heard about him. He was caught in their pit. They led him away with hooks to the land of Egypt."

verses.kjv: Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her whelps, and made him a young lion.
verses.modern: "When she saw that her hope was gone — her expectation had failed — she took another of her cubs and made him a young lion."

verses.kjv: And he went up and down among the lions, he became a young lion, and learned to catch the prey, and devoured men.
verses.modern: "He prowled among the lions. He became a young lion. He learned to prey on animals. He devoured men."

verses.kjv: And he knew their desolate palaces, and he laid waste their cities; and the land was desolate, and the fulness thereof, by the noise of his roaring.
verses.modern: "He broke down their strongholds and devastated their towns. The land and everything in it was terrified by the sound of his roaring."

verses.kjv: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces, and spread their net over him: he was taken in their pit.
verses.modern: "Then the nations came against him from the surrounding regions. They spread their net over him and caught him in their pit."

verses.kjv: And they put him in ward in chains, and brought him to the king of Babylon: they brought him into holds, that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel.
verses.modern: "With hooks they put him in a cage and brought him to the king of Babylon. They put him in prison so his roar would no longer be heard on the mountains of Israel."

verses.kjv: Thy mother is like a vine in thy blood, planted by the waters: she was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.
verses.modern: "Your mother was like a vine in your vineyard, planted beside the water. It was fruitful and full of branches because of the abundant water."

verses.kjv: And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule, and her stature was exalted among the thick branches, and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches.
verses.modern: "Its branches were strong — fit to be a ruler's scepter. It grew tall and reached up to the clouds. It was conspicuous for its height and its many branches."

verses.kjv: But she was plucked up in fury, she was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up her fruit: her strong rods were broken and withered; the fire consumed them.
verses.modern: "But it was uprooted in fury and thrown down to the ground. The east wind dried up its fruit. Its strong branches were torn off and withered. Fire consumed them."

verses.kjv: And now she is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty ground.
verses.modern: "Now it is planted in the desert, in a dry and thirsty land."

verses.kjv: And fire is gone out of a rod of her branches, which hath devoured her fruit, so that she hath no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule. This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.
verses.modern: "Fire spread from one of its main branches and consumed its fruit. No strong branch is left on it fit to be a ruler's scepter. This is a lament, and it is used as a lament."

chapters.summary: Ezekiel takes up a lament for the princes of Israel. Their mother is pictured as a lioness whose cubs were captured — one taken to Egypt, the other to Babylon. She is then compared to a vine once fruitful and strong, now plucked up, withered, and burned with fire.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, that certain of the elders of Israel came to enquire of the LORD, and sat before me.
verses.modern: In the seventh year, on the tenth day of the fifth month, some of the elders of Israel came to inquire of the LORD. They sat down in front of me.

verses.kjv: Then came the word of the LORD unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, speak unto the elders of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Are ye come to enquire of me? As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will not be enquired of by you.
verses.modern: "Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel and say to them: This is what the Lord GOD says: Have You come to inquire of Me? As surely as I live, I will not let You inquire of Me, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: Wilt thou judge them, son of man, wilt thou judge them? cause them to know the abominations of their fathers:
verses.modern: "Will You judge them? Will You judge them, Son of man? Confront them with the abominations of their fathers."

verses.kjv: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day when I chose Israel, and lifted up mine hand unto the seed of the house of Jacob, and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt, when I lifted up mine hand unto them, saying, I am the LORD your God;
verses.modern: "Say to them: This is what the Lord GOD says: On the day I chose Israel and raised My hand in oath to the descendants of the house of Jacob, I made Myself known to them in Egypt. I raised My hand to them and said, 'I am the LORD Your God.'"

verses.kjv: In the day that I lifted up mine hand unto them, to bring them forth of the land of Egypt into a land that I had espied for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands:
verses.modern: "On that day I swore to bring them out of Egypt into a land I had searched out for them — a land flowing with milk and honey, the most beautiful of all lands."

verses.kjv: Then said I unto them, Cast ye away every man the abominations of his eyes, and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
verses.modern: "I said to them: Each of You — throw away the vile things You set Your eyes on. Do not defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt. I am the LORD Your God."

verses.kjv: But they rebelled against me, and would not hearken unto me: they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes, neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt: then I said, I will pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.
verses.modern: "But they rebelled against Me and would not listen. They did not throw away the vile things they had set their eyes on, nor did they forsake the idols of Egypt. So I said I would pour out My wrath on them and accomplish My anger against them in Egypt."

verses.kjv: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, among whom they were, in whose sight I made myself known unto them, to bring them forth out of the land of Egypt.
verses.modern: "But I acted for the sake of My name, that it would not be profaned in the eyes of the heathen among whom they lived. In their sight I made Myself known to Israel by bringing them out of Egypt."

verses.kjv: Wherefore I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness.
verses.modern: "So I brought them out of Egypt and led them into the desert."

verses.kjv: And I gave them my statutes, and shewed them my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them.
verses.modern: "I gave them My decrees and laws. The man who obeys them will live by them."

verses.kjv: Moreover also I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am the LORD that sanctify them.
verses.modern: "I also gave them My Sabbaths as a sign between Me and them, so they would know that I am the LORD Who makes them holy."

verses.kjv: But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness: they walked not in my statutes, and they despised my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; and my sabbaths they greatly polluted: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.
verses.modern: "But the house of Israel rebelled against Me in the desert. They did not follow My decrees but rejected My laws — though the man who obeys them will live by them — and they greatly desecrated My Sabbaths. So I said I would pour out My wrath on them in the desert and destroy them."

verses.kjv: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, in whose sight I brought them out.
verses.modern: "But I acted for the sake of My name, that it would not be profaned in the eyes of the heathen who had seen Me bring them out."

verses.kjv: Yet also I lifted up my hand unto them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands;
verses.modern: "Also, I swore to them in the desert that I would not bring them into the land I had given them — the land flowing with milk and honey, most beautiful of all lands —"

verses.kjv: Because they despised my judgments, and walked not in my statutes, but polluted my sabbaths: for their heart went after their idols.
verses.modern: "because they rejected My laws, did not follow My decrees, and desecrated My Sabbaths. Their hearts were devoted to their idols."

verses.kjv: Nevertheless mine eye spared them from destroying them, neither did I make an end of them in the wilderness.
verses.modern: "Yet I looked on them with pity. I did not destroy them or put an end to them in the desert."

verses.kjv: But I said unto their children in the wilderness, Walk ye not in the statutes of your fathers, neither observe their judgments, nor defile yourselves with their idols:
verses.modern: "I said to their children in the desert: Do not follow your fathers' decrees or keep their laws or defile yourselves with their idols."

verses.kjv: I am the LORD your God; walk in my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them;
verses.modern: "I am the LORD Your God. Follow My decrees and keep My laws and carry them out."

verses.kjv: And hallow my sabbaths; and they shall be a sign between me and you, that ye may know that I am the LORD your God.
verses.modern: "Keep My Sabbaths holy. They will be a sign between Me and You so You may know that I am the LORD Your God."

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding the children rebelled against me: they walked not in my statutes, neither kept my judgments to do them, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; they polluted my sabbaths: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.
verses.modern: "But the children rebelled against Me too. They did not follow My decrees or keep My laws — though the man who obeys them will live by them — and they desecrated My Sabbaths. So I said I would pour out My wrath on them in the desert and accomplish My anger against them."

verses.kjv: Nevertheless I withdrew mine hand, and wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted in the sight of the heathen, in whose sight I brought them forth.
verses.modern: "But I held back My hand. I acted for the sake of My name, that it would not be profaned in the eyes of the heathen who had seen Me bring them out."

verses.kjv: I lifted up mine hand unto them also in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the heathen, and disperse them through the countries;
verses.modern: "Also, in the desert I swore to scatter them among the heathen and disperse them through the lands."

verses.kjv: Because they had not executed my judgments, but had despised my statutes, and had polluted my sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers' idols.
verses.modern: "This was because they had not obeyed My laws but had rejected My decrees and desecrated My Sabbaths, and their eyes had followed after their fathers' idols."

verses.kjv: Wherefore I gave them also statutes that were not good, and judgments whereby they should not live;
verses.modern: "So I gave them over to statutes that were not good and laws through which they could not live."

verses.kjv: And I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused to pass through the fire all that openeth the womb, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "I let them become defiled through their gifts — sacrificing every firstborn — so that I could fill them with horror. Then they would know that I am the LORD."

verses.kjv: Therefore, son of man, speak unto the house of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Yet in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.
verses.modern: "Therefore, Son of man, speak to the house of Israel and say to them: This is what the Lord GOD says: In this also Your fathers blasphemed Me, in that they committed a trespass against Me."

verses.kjv: For when I had brought them into the land, for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to them, then they saw every high hill, and all the thick trees, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering: there also they made their sweet savour, and poured out there their drink offerings.
verses.modern: "When I brought them into the land I had sworn to give them and they saw any high hill or any leafy tree, they offered their sacrifices there. They brought their offerings that provoked Me. They placed their fragrant incense there and poured out their drink offerings."

verses.kjv: Then I said unto them, What is the high place whereunto ye go? And the name thereof is called Bamah unto this day.
verses.modern: "Then I said to them: What is this high place You go to? It is called Bamah to this day."

verses.kjv: Wherefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Are ye polluted after the manner of your fathers? and commit ye whoredom after their abominations?
verses.modern: "Therefore say to the house of Israel: This is what the Lord GOD says: Will You defile yourselves the way Your ancestors did and lust after their vile images?"

verses.kjv: For when ye offer your gifts, when ye make your sons to pass through the fire, ye pollute yourselves with all your idols, even unto this day: and shall I be enquired of by you, O house of Israel? As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will not be enquired of by you.
verses.modern: "When You offer Your gifts — when You sacrifice Your children in the fire — you continue to defile yourselves with all Your idols to this day. And should I let You inquire of Me, house of Israel? As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will not let You inquire of Me."

verses.kjv: And that which cometh into your mind shall not be at all, that ye say, We will be as the heathen, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.
verses.modern: "What You have in mind will never happen — your thought that You will be like the heathen, like the peoples of the other lands, serving wood and stone."

verses.kjv: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you:
verses.modern: "As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will rule over You with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm and with outpoured wrath."

verses.kjv: And I will bring you out from the people, and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out.
verses.modern: "I will bring You out from the nations and gather you from the countries where You have been scattered — with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm and with outpoured wrath."

verses.kjv: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face.
verses.modern: "I will bring You into the wilderness of the nations and there I will execute judgment on you face to face."

verses.kjv: Like as I pleaded with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I plead with you, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "As I judged Your ancestors in the wilderness of Egypt, so I will judge You, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant:
verses.modern: "I will take note of You as You pass under My rod, and I will bring You into the bond of the covenant."

verses.kjv: And I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me: I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn, and they shall not enter into the land of Israel: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "I will purge You of those who rebel and transgress against Me. I will bring them out of the land where they are living as strangers, but they will not enter the land of Israel. Then You will know that I am the LORD."
