verses.kjv: As for you, O house of Israel, thus saith the Lord GOD; Go ye, serve ye every one his idols, and hereafter also, if ye will not hearken unto me: but pollute ye my holy name no more with your gifts and with your idols.
verses.modern: "As for You, house of Israel, this is what the Lord GOD says: Go and serve Your idols, every one of you! But afterward you will surely listen to Me and no longer profane My holy name with Your gifts and Your idols."

verses.kjv: For in mine holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel, saith the Lord GOD, there shall all the house of Israel, all of them in the land, serve me: there will I accept them, and there will I require your offerings, and the firstfruits of your oblations, with all your holy things.
verses.modern: "For on My holy mountain — the high mountain of Israel — the whole house of Israel will serve Me in the land, declares the Lord GOD. There I will accept them. There I will require Your offerings and Your choice gifts, along with all Your holy things."

verses.kjv: I will accept you with your sweet savour, when I bring you out from the people, and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered; and I will be sanctified in you before the heathen.
verses.modern: "I will accept You as a fragrant offering when I bring You out from the heathen and gather you from the lands where you have been scattered. I will be proved holy through You in the sight of the heathen."

verses.kjv: And ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall bring you into the land of Israel, into the country for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to your fathers.
verses.modern: "You will know that I am the LORD when I bring You into the land of Israel — the land I swore to give Your ancestors."

verses.kjv: And there shall ye remember your ways, and all your doings, wherein ye have been defiled; and ye shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that ye have committed.
verses.modern: "There You will remember Your conduct and all the actions by which You have defiled yourselves. You will despise yourselves for all the evil You have done."

verses.kjv: And ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I have wrought with you for my name's sake, not according to your wicked ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, O ye house of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "You will know that I am the LORD when I deal with You for My name's sake and not according to Your evil ways and Your corrupt practices, house of Israel, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, set thy face toward the south, and drop thy word toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the south field;
verses.modern: "Son of man, set Your face toward the south. Preach against the south and prophesy against the forest of the southern region."

verses.kjv: And say to the forest of the south, Hear the word of the LORD; Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will kindle a fire in thee, and it shall devour every green tree in thee, and every dry tree: the flaming flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein.
verses.modern: "Say to the southern forest: Hear the word of the LORD. This is what the Lord GOD says: I am about to set fire to You, and it will consume every green tree and every dry tree in You. The blazing flame will not be quenched, and every face from south to north will be scorched by it."

verses.kjv: And all flesh shall see that I the LORD have kindled it: it shall not be quenched.
verses.modern: "Everyone will see that I the LORD have kindled it. It will not be quenched."

verses.kjv: Then said I, Ah Lord GOD! they say of me, Doth he not speak parables?
verses.modern: Then I said, "Ah, Lord GOD! People are saying of me, 'Isn't he just telling parables?'"

chapters.summary: Elders come to inquire of the LORD, but He refuses them and recounts Israel's long history of rebellion — in Egypt, in the wilderness, and in the land. Yet for the sake of His name, He will gather them from the nations, purge the rebels, and bring them to the mountain of Israel where they will serve Him.

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, set thy face toward Jerusalem, and drop thy word toward the holy places, and prophesy against the land of Israel,
verses.modern: "Son of man, set Your face toward Jerusalem. Preach against the sanctuaries and prophesy against the land of Israel."

verses.kjv: And say to the land of Israel, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I am against thee, and will draw forth my sword out of his sheath, and will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked.
verses.modern: "Say to the land of Israel: This is what the LORD says: I am against You. I will draw My sword from its sheath and cut off from You both the righteous and the wicked."

verses.kjv: Seeing then that I will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked, therefore shall my sword go forth out of his sheath against all flesh from the south to the north:
verses.modern: "Because I will cut off both the righteous and the wicked, My sword will go out from its sheath against everyone from south to north."

verses.kjv: That all flesh may know that I the LORD have drawn forth my sword out of his sheath: it shall not return any more.
verses.modern: "Then all flesh will know that I the LORD have drawn My sword from its sheath. It will not return again."

verses.kjv: Sigh therefore, thou son of man, with the breaking of thy loins; and with bitterness sigh before their eyes.
verses.modern: "Groan, Son of man — groan with anguish and a broken heart before them."

verses.kjv: And it shall be, when they say unto thee, Wherefore sighest thou? that thou shalt answer, For the tidings; because it cometh: and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and all knees shall be weak as water: behold, it cometh, and shall be brought to pass, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "When they ask You why You are groaning, say: Because of the news that is coming. Every heart will melt with fear and every hand will go limp. Every spirit will faint and every knee will be weak as water. It is coming! It will be fulfilled, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith the LORD; Say, A sword, a sword is sharpened, and also furbished:
verses.modern: "Son of man, prophesy and say: This is what the Lord says: A sword, a sword is sharpened and polished —"

verses.kjv: It is sharpened to make a sore slaughter; it is furbished that it may glitter: should we then make mirth? it contemneth the rod of my son, as every tree.
verses.modern: "sharpened for the slaughter, polished to flash like lightning! Shall we rejoice? The sword despises every wooden scepter."

verses.kjv: And he gave it to be furbished, that it may be handled: this sword is sharpened, and it is furbished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.
verses.modern: "The sword is handed to the polisher to make it ready for the slayer's hand."

verses.kjv: Cry and howl, son of man: for it shall be upon my people, it shall be upon all the princes of Israel: terrors by reason of the sword shall be upon my people: smite therefore upon thy thigh.
verses.modern: "Cry out and wail, Son of man, for it is destined for My people. It is for all the princes of Israel. They are thrown to the sword along with My people. Strike Your thigh in grief."

verses.kjv: Because it is a trial, and what if the sword contemn even the rod? it shall be no more, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "Testing will surely come. And what if the scepter, which the sword despises, does not continue? declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: Thou therefore, son of man, prophesy, and smite thine hands together, and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the slain: it is the sword of the great men that are slain, which entereth into their privy chambers.
verses.modern: "So prophesy, Son of man. Clap Your hands together. Let the sword strike twice, even three times. It is the sword for the slain — the sword for the great slaughter that surrounds them."

verses.kjv: I have set the point of the sword against all their gates, that their heart may faint, and their ruins be multiplied: ah! it is made bright, it is wrapped up for the slaughter.
verses.modern: "I have stationed the sword for slaughter at all their gates, so that hearts will melt with fear and many will stumble. Ah, it is made to flash like lightning! It is drawn for slaughter."

verses.kjv: Go thee one way or other, either on the right hand, or on the left, whithersoever thy face is set.
verses.modern: "Slash to the right! Slash to the left! Wherever Your blade is aimed!"

verses.kjv: I will also smite mine hands together, and I will cause my fury to rest: I the LORD have spoken it.
verses.modern: "I too will clap My hands, and My wrath will be spent. I the LORD have spoken."

verses.kjv: The word of the LORD came unto me again, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Also, thou son of man, appoint thee two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come: both twain shall come forth out of one land: and choose thou a place, choose it at the head of the way to the city.
verses.modern: "Son of man, mark out two roads for the sword of the king of Babylon to take. Both roads lead from the same country. Make a signpost where the road forks and leads to a city."

verses.kjv: Appoint a way, that the sword may come to Rabbath of the Ammonites, and to Judah in Jerusalem the defenced.
verses.modern: "Mark out one road for the sword to come to Rabbah of the Ammonites and another to Judah and fortified Jerusalem."

verses.kjv: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination: he made his arrows bright, he consulted with images, he looked in the liver.
verses.modern: "For the king of Babylon will stop at the fork in the road, at the junction of the two roads, to seek an omen. He will cast lots with arrows, he will consult his idols, he will examine the liver."

verses.kjv: At his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem, to appoint captains, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to appoint battering rams against the gates, to cast a mount, and to build a siege fort.
verses.modern: "Into his right hand will come the lot for Jerusalem, where he is to set up battering rams, to give the command to slaughter, to sound the battle cry, to set battering rams against the gates, to build a siege ramp, and to erect siege works."

verses.kjv: And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight, to them that have sworn oaths: but he will call to remembrance the iniquity, that they may be taken.
verses.modern: "It will seem like a false omen to those who have sworn oaths, but he will remind them of their guilt and take them captive."

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are discovered, so that in all your doings your sins do appear; because, I say, that ye are come to remembrance, ye shall be taken with the hand.
verses.modern: "Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Because You have made Your guilt known — your transgressions exposed and Your sins revealed in all You do — because You are brought to remembrance, You will be taken captive."

verses.kjv: And thou, profane wicked prince of Israel, whose day is come, when iniquity shall have an end,
verses.modern: "And You, profane and wicked prince of Israel, whose day has come — the time of final punishment —"

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Remove the diadem, and take off the crown: this shall not be the same: exalt him that is low, and abase him that is high.
verses.modern: "this is what the Lord GOD says: Take off the turban. Remove the crown. Things will not remain as they are. Lift up the lowly and bring down the proud."

verses.kjv: I will overturn, overturn, overturn, it: and it shall be no more, until he come whose right it is; and I will give it him.
verses.modern: "A ruin! A ruin! I will make it a ruin. It will not be restored until He comes to whom it rightfully belongs. To Him I will give it."

verses.kjv: And thou, son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD concerning the Ammonites, and concerning their reproach; even say thou, The sword, the sword is drawn: for the slaughter it is furbished, to consume because of the glittering:
verses.modern: "Son of man, prophesy and say: This is what the Lord GOD says about the Ammonites and their contempt: A sword, a sword, drawn for slaughter — polished to consume, to flash like lightning —"

verses.kjv: Whiles they see vanity unto thee, whiles they divine a lie unto thee, to bring thee upon the necks of them that are slain, of the wicked, whose day is come, when their iniquity shall have an end.
verses.modern: "while false visions are seen for you and lying divinations are told about you. The sword will be laid on the necks of the wicked who are to be slain, whose day has come — the time of final punishment."

verses.kjv: Shall I cause it to return into his sheath? I will judge thee in the place where thou wast created, in the land of thy nativity.
verses.modern: "Return the sword to its sheath! I will judge you in the place where you were created, in the land of your origin."

verses.kjv: And I will pour out mine indignation upon thee, I will blow against thee in the fire of my wrath, and I will deliver thee into the hand of brutish men, and skilful to destroy.
verses.modern: "I will pour out My wrath on you and breathe out My fiery anger against you. I will hand you over to brutal men, skilled in destruction."

verses.kjv: Thou shalt be for fuel to the fire; thy blood shall be in the midst of the land; thou shalt be no more remembered: for I the LORD have spoken it.
verses.modern: "You will be fuel for the fire. Your blood will flow throughout the land. You will be remembered no more, for I the LORD have spoken."

chapters.summary: The LORD draws His sword from its sheath against the land of Israel — it is sharpened and polished for slaughter. The king of Babylon stands at the crossroads using divination, and the lot falls on Jerusalem. The crown will be removed until He comes whose right it is.

verses.kjv: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Now, thou son of man, wilt thou judge, wilt thou judge the bloody city? yea, thou shalt shew her all her abominations.
verses.modern: "Son of man, will You judge? Will You judge the city of bloodshed? Confront her with all her abominations."

verses.kjv: Then say thou, Thus saith the Lord GOD, The city sheddeth blood in the midst of it, that her time may come, and maketh idols against herself to defile herself.
verses.modern: "Say: This is what the Lord GOD says: O city that brings on herself doom by shedding blood in her midst and defiles herself by making idols —"

verses.kjv: Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed; and hast defiled thyself in thine idols which thou hast made; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near, and art come even unto thy years: therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the heathen, and a mocking to all countries.
verses.modern: "you have become guilty because of the blood You have shed and have become defiled by the idols You have made. You have brought Your days to a close, and the end of Your years has come. Therefore I have made You an object of scorn to the heathen and a laughingstock to all the countries."

verses.kjv: Those that be near, and those that be far from thee, shall mock thee, which art infamous and much vexed.
verses.modern: "Those near and far will mock You — infamous city, full of turmoil."

verses.kjv: Behold, the princes of Israel, every one were in thee to their power to shed blood.
verses.modern: "See how each of the princes of Israel who are in You uses His power to shed blood."

verses.kjv: In thee have they set light by father and mother: in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the stranger: in thee have they vexed the fatherless and the widow.
verses.modern: "In You they have treated father and mother with contempt. In You they have oppressed the foreigner and mistreated the fatherless and the widow."

verses.kjv: Thou hast despised mine holy things, and hast profaned my sabbaths.
verses.modern: "You have despised My holy things and desecrated My Sabbaths."

verses.kjv: In thee are men that carry tales to shed blood: and in thee they eat upon the mountains: in thee have they committed lewdness.
verses.modern: "In You are slanderers bent on shedding blood. In You are those who eat at the mountain shrines and commit indecent acts."

verses.kjv: In thee have they discovered their fathers' nakedness: in thee have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution.
verses.modern: "In You men violate their fathers' wives. In You men rape women during their periods."

verses.kjv: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbour's wife; and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter in law; and another in thee hath humbled his sister, his father's daughter.
verses.modern: "In You one man commits a detestable offense with His neighbor's wife. Another shamefully defiles His daughter-in-law. Another violates His sister, His own father's daughter."

verses.kjv: In thee have they taken gifts to shed blood; thou hast taken usury and increase, and thou hast greedily gained of thy neighbours by extortion, and hast forgotten me, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "In You people accept bribes to shed blood. You take interest and profit and make gain from Your neighbors by extortion. And You have forgotten Me, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: Behold, therefore I have smitten mine hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made, and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee.
verses.modern: "I will surely strike My hands together at the unjust gain You have made and at the blood that has been shed in You."

verses.kjv: Can thine heart endure, or can thine hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with thee? I the LORD have spoken it, and will do it.
verses.modern: "Will Your courage hold out or Your hands remain strong in the day I deal with You? I the LORD have spoken, and I will do it."

verses.kjv: And I will scatter thee among the heathen, and disperse thee in the countries, and will consume thy filthiness out of thee.
verses.modern: "I will scatter You among the heathen and disperse you through the countries. I will purge You of Your uncleanness."

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take thine inheritance in thyself in the sight of the heathen, and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "When You have been defiled in the eyes of the heathen, you will know that I am the LORD."

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, the house of Israel is to me become dross: all they are brass, and tin, and iron, and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are even the dross of silver.
verses.modern: "Son of man, the house of Israel has become worthless to Me. They are all the impurities — bronze, tin, iron, and lead — left inside a furnace. They have become like slag from silver."

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye are all become dross, behold, therefore I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.
verses.modern: "Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Because You have all become slag, I will gather You into Jerusalem."

verses.kjv: As they gather silver, and brass, and iron, and lead, and tin, into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire upon it, to melt it; so will I gather you in mine anger and in my fury, and I will leave you there, and melt you.
verses.modern: "As silver, bronze, iron, lead, and tin are gathered into a furnace to be melted with a blast of fire, so I will gather You in My anger and My wrath. I will put You in the furnace and melt You."

verses.kjv: Yea, I will gather you, and blow upon you in the fire of my wrath, and ye shall be melted in the midst thereof.
verses.modern: "I will gather You and blow on You with My fiery wrath. You will be melted inside the city."

verses.kjv: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof; and ye shall know that I the LORD have poured out my fury upon you.
verses.modern: "As silver is melted in a furnace, so You will be melted inside the city. Then You will know that I the LORD have poured out My wrath on You."

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, say unto her, Thou art the land that is not cleansed, nor rained upon in the day of indignation.
verses.modern: "Son of man, say to the land: You are a land that has not been cleansed or rained on in the day of wrath."

verses.kjv: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey; they have devoured souls; they have taken the treasure and precious things; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof.
verses.modern: "The conspiracy of her prophets in her midst is like a roaring lion tearing its prey. They devour people. They seize treasure and precious things. They make many widows within her."

verses.kjv: Her priests have violated my law, and have profaned mine holy things: they have put no difference between the holy and profane, neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.
verses.modern: "Her priests do violence to My law and profane My holy things. They do not distinguish between the holy and the common. They do not teach the difference between the unclean and the clean. They shut their eyes to My Sabbaths, and I am profaned among them."

verses.kjv: Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain.
verses.modern: "Her officials within her are like wolves tearing their prey — shedding blood and destroying lives to make unjust gain."

verses.kjv: And her prophets have daubed them with untempered morter, seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord GOD, when the LORD hath not spoken.
verses.modern: "Her prophets whitewash these deeds with false visions and lying divinations. They say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says,' when the LORD has not spoken."

verses.kjv: The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery, and have vexed the poor and needy: yea, they have oppressed the stranger wrongfully.
verses.modern: "The people of the land practice extortion and commit robbery. They oppress the poor and needy and mistreat the foreigner, denying them justice."

verses.kjv: And I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it: but I found none.
verses.modern: "I looked for someone among them who would build up the wall and stand before Me in the gap on behalf of the land so I would not have to destroy it, but I found no one."

verses.kjv: Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I recompensed upon their heads, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "So I poured out My wrath on them and consumed them with My fiery anger. I brought down on their own heads all they had done, declares the Lord GOD."

chapters.summary: The LORD catalogs Jerusalem's sins: bloodshed, idolatry, dishonoring parents, oppressing the stranger, profaning the Sabbath. Princes, priests, prophets, and people alike are corrupt. The LORD sought someone to stand in the gap but found no one, and so He pours out His wrath.

verses.kjv: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother:
verses.modern: "Son of man, there were two women, daughters of the same mother."

verses.kjv: And they committed whoredoms in Egypt; they committed whoredoms in their youth: there were their breasts pressed, and there they bruised the teats of their virginity.
verses.modern: "They committed whoredoms in Egypt — whoredoms from their youth. Their breasts were pressed there, and the teats of their virginity were handled there."

verses.kjv: And the names of them were Aholah the elder, and Aholibah her sister: and they were mine, and they bare sons and daughters. Thus were their names; Samaria is Aholah, and Jerusalem Aholibah.
verses.modern: "The older was named Oholah, and her sister was Oholibah. They were Mine and gave birth to sons and daughters. Oholah is Samaria, and Oholibah is Jerusalem."

verses.kjv: And Aholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbours,
verses.modern: "Oholah engaged in whoredom while she was still Mine. She lusted after her lovers — the Assyrians, her neighbors."

verses.kjv: Which were clothed with blue, captains and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.
verses.modern: "They were officers dressed in blue, governors and commanders — all handsome young men, mounted horsemen."

verses.kjv: Thus she committed her whoredoms with them, with all them that were the chosen men of Assyria, and with all on whom she doted: with all their idols she defiled herself.
verses.modern: "She gave herself as a harlot to all the elite men of Assyria, and she defiled herself with all their idols."

verses.kjv: Neither left she her whoredoms brought from Egypt: for in her youth they lay with her, and they bruised the breasts of her virginity, and poured their whoredom upon her.
verses.modern: "She did not give up the whoredom she had begun in Egypt, where men had slept with her in her youth and fondled her virgin breasts and poured out their lust on her."

verses.kjv: Wherefore I have delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, upon whom she doted.
verses.modern: "Therefore I handed her over to her lovers — the Assyrians, after whom she lusted."

verses.kjv: These discovered her nakedness: they took her sons and her daughters, and slew her with the sword: and she became famous among women; for they had executed judgment upon her.
verses.modern: "They stripped her naked, took her sons and daughters, and killed her with the sword. She became a byword among women, for judgment was executed on her."

verses.kjv: And when her sister Aholibah saw this, she was more corrupt in her inordinate love than she, and in her whoredoms more than her sister in her whoredoms.
verses.modern: "Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet in her lust and whoredom she was more depraved than her sister."

verses.kjv: She doted upon the Assyrians her neighbours, captains and rulers clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them desirable young men.
verses.modern: "She too lusted after the Assyrians — governors and commanders, warriors in full dress, mounted horsemen — all handsome young men."

verses.kjv: Then I saw that she was defiled, that they took both one way,
verses.modern: "I saw that she too had defiled herself. Both of them had gone the same way."

verses.kjv: And that she increased her whoredoms: for when she saw men pourtrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans pourtrayed with vermilion,
verses.modern: "But she carried her whoredom still further. She saw men carved on a wall — figures of Chaldeans drawn in red,"

verses.kjv: Girded with girdles upon their loins, exceeding in dyed attire upon their heads, all of them princes to look to, after the manner of the Babylonians of Chaldea, the land of their nativity:
verses.modern: "dressed with belts on their waists and flowing turbans on their heads — all of them looked like Babylonian commanders, like men of Chaldea, the land of their birth."

verses.kjv: And as soon as she saw them with her eyes, she doted upon them, and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea.
verses.modern: "At the sight of them she lusted after them and sent messengers to them in Chaldea."

verses.kjv: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their whoredom, and she was polluted with them, and her mind was alienated from them.
verses.modern: "Then the Babylonians came to her, to the bed of love, and in their lust they defiled her. After she had been defiled by them, she turned away from them in disgust."

verses.kjv: So she discovered her whoredoms, and discovered her nakedness: then my mind was alienated from her, like as my mind was alienated from her sister.
verses.modern: "When she carried on her whoredom openly and exposed her nakedness, I turned away from her in disgust, just as I had turned away from her sister."

verses.kjv: Yet she multiplied her whoredoms, in calling to remembrance the days of her youth, wherein she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt.
verses.modern: "Yet she multiplied her whoredom, remembering the days of her youth when she had been a harlot in Egypt."

verses.kjv: For she doted upon their paramours, whose flesh is as the flesh of asses, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.
verses.modern: "She lusted after their lovers, whose genitals were like those of donkeys and whose emission was like that of horses."

verses.kjv: So thou calledst to remembrance the lewdness of thy youth, in bruising thy teats by the Egyptians for the paps of thy youth.
verses.modern: "So You longed for the lewdness of Your youth, when in Egypt Your bosom was caressed and Your young breasts fondled."

verses.kjv: Therefore, O Aholibah, thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will raise up thy lovers against thee, from whom thy mind is alienated, and I will bring them against thee on every side;
verses.modern: "Therefore, Oholibah, this is what the Lord GOD says: I will stir up Your lovers against You — those You turned away from in disgust — and I will bring them against You from every side."

verses.kjv: The Babylonians, and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, and Shoa, and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them: all of them desirable young men, captains and rulers, great lords and renowned, all of them riding upon horses.
verses.modern: "The Babylonians and all the Chaldeans — the men of Pekod and Shoa and Koa — and all the Assyrians with them, all of them handsome young men, governors and commanders — great lords and renowned warriors — all of them riding horses."

verses.kjv: And they shall come against thee with chariots, wagons, and wheels, and with an assembly of people, which shall set against thee buckler and shield and helmet round about: and I will set judgment before them, and they shall judge thee according to their judgments.
verses.modern: "They will come against You with weapons, chariots, and wagons, and with a crowd of people. They will take up positions against You on every side with armor and shields and helmets. I will commit the judgment to them, and they will judge You by their own standards."

verses.kjv: And I will set my jealousy against thee, and they shall deal furiously with thee: they shall take away thy nose and thine ears; and thy remnant shall fall by the sword: they shall take thy sons and thy daughters; and thy residue shall be devoured by the fire.
verses.modern: "I will direct My jealous anger against You, and they will deal with You in fury. They will cut off Your nose and Your ears, and those who are left will fall by the sword. They will take away Your sons and daughters, and Your survivors will be consumed by fire."

verses.kjv: They shall also strip thee out of thy clothes, and take away thy fair jewels.
verses.modern: "They will also strip off Your clothes and take away Your fine jewelry."

verses.kjv: Thus will I make thy lewdness to cease from thee, and thy whoredom brought from the land of Egypt: so that thou shalt not lift up thine eyes unto them, nor remember Egypt any more.
verses.modern: "So I will put an end to Your lewdness and the whoredom You began in Egypt. You will not look on these things with longing or remember Egypt anymore."

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will deliver thee into the hand of them whom thou hatest, into the hand of them from whom thy mind is alienated:
verses.modern: "For this is what the Lord GOD says: I am about to hand You over to those You hate — to those You turned away from in disgust."

verses.kjv: And they shall deal with thee hatefully, and shall take away all thy labour, and shall leave thee naked and bare: and the nakedness of thy whoredoms shall be discovered, both thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.
verses.modern: "They will deal with You in hatred and take everything You have worked for, leaving You naked and bare. The shame of Your whoredom will be exposed — your lewdness and Your whoredoms."

verses.kjv: I will do these things unto thee, because thou hast gone a whoring after the heathen, and because thou art polluted with their idols.
verses.modern: "These things will be done to You because You have pursued the heathen with lust and defiled yourself with their idols."

verses.kjv: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister; therefore will I give her cup into thine hand.
verses.modern: "You have followed in the path of Your sister, so I will put her cup into Your hand."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Thou shalt drink of thy sister's cup deep and large: thou shalt be laughed to scorn and had in derision; it containeth much.
verses.modern: "This is what the Lord GOD says: You will drink Your sister's cup — a cup large and deep. You will be laughed at and mocked. The cup holds so much."

verses.kjv: Thou shalt be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of thy sister Samaria.
verses.modern: "You will be filled with drunkenness and sorrow — the cup of ruin and desolation, the cup of Your sister Samaria."

verses.kjv: Thou shalt even drink it and suck it out, and thou shalt break the sherds thereof, and pluck off thine own breasts: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "You will drink it and drain it dry and chew its pieces — and You will tear out Your own breasts. For I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast forgotten me, and cast me behind thy back, therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.
verses.modern: "Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Because You have forgotten Me and thrust Me behind Your back, You must bear the consequences of Your lewdness and whoredom."

verses.kjv: The LORD said moreover unto me; Son of man, wilt thou judge Aholah and Aholibah? yea, declare unto them their abominations;
verses.modern: The LORD said to me, "Son of man, will You judge Oholah and Oholibah? Confront them with their abominations."

verses.kjv: That they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands, and with their idols have they committed adultery, and have also caused their sons, whom they bare unto me, to pass for them through the fire, to devour them.
verses.modern: "For they have committed adultery and blood is on their hands. They committed adultery with their idols and even sacrificed their children — whom they bore to Me — as food for idols."

verses.kjv: Moreover this they have done unto me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my sabbaths.
verses.modern: "They have also done this to Me: At that same time they defiled My sanctuary and desecrated My Sabbaths."

verses.kjv: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and, lo, thus have they done in the midst of mine house.
verses.modern: "On the very day they sacrificed their children to their idols, they entered My sanctuary and desecrated it. That is what they did in My house."

verses.kjv: And furthermore, that ye have sent for men to come from far, unto whom a messenger was sent; and, lo, they came: for whom thou didst wash thyself, paintedst thy face, and deckedst thyself with ornaments,
verses.modern: "They even sent messengers for men who came from far away — when a messenger was sent to them, they came. For their sake You bathed Yourself, painted Your eyes, and put on Your jewelry."

verses.kjv: And satest upon a stately bed, and a table prepared before it, whereupon thou hast set mine incense and mine oil.
verses.modern: "You sat on an elegant couch with a table spread before it. On it You placed My incense and My oil."

verses.kjv: And a voice of a multitude being at ease was with her: and with the men of the common sort were brought Sabeans from the wilderness, which put bracelets upon their hands, and beautiful crowns upon their heads.
verses.modern: "The noise of a carefree crowd was around her. Drunkards were brought from the desert along with men of the common sort, and they put bracelets on the wrists of Oholah and Oholibah and beautiful crowns on their heads."

verses.kjv: Then said I unto her that was old in adulteries, Will they now commit whoredoms with her, and she with them?
verses.modern: "Then I said about the one worn out by adultery, 'Now let them use her as a harlot, for that is all she is.'"

verses.kjv: Yet they went in unto her, as they go in unto a woman that playeth the harlot: so went they in unto Aholah and unto Aholibah, the lewd women.
verses.modern: "And they slept with her as men sleep with a harlot. So they slept with Oholah and Oholibah, these shameless women."

verses.kjv: And the righteous men, they shall judge them after the manner of adulteresses, and after the manner of women that shed blood; because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.
verses.modern: "But righteous men will sentence them to the punishment due adulteresses and women who shed blood — because they are adulteresses and blood is on their hands."

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD; I will bring up a company upon them, and will give them to be removed and spoiled.
verses.modern: "This is what the Lord GOD says: Bring a mob against them and hand them over to terror and plunder."

verses.kjv: And the company shall stone them with stones, and dispatch them with their swords; they shall slay their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.
verses.modern: "The mob will stone them and cut them down with swords. They will kill their sons and daughters and burn down their houses."

verses.kjv: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness.
verses.modern: "So I will put an end to lewdness in the land, that all women may take warning and not imitate Your lewdness."

verses.kjv: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and ye shall bear the sins of your idols: and ye shall know that I am the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "You will suffer the penalty for Your lewdness and bear the consequences of Your idol worship. Then You will know that I am the Lord GOD."

chapters.summary: The LORD tells the allegory of two sisters, Aholah and Aholibah — Samaria and Jerusalem. Both played the harlot with the nations around them, lusting after Assyria and Babylon. Aholah fell first; yet Aholibah did not learn but surpassed her sister's whoredoms, and judgment comes upon her.

verses.kjv: Again in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: In the ninth year, on the tenth day of the tenth month, the word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, write thee the name of the day, even of this same day: the king of Babylon set himself against Jerusalem this same day.
verses.modern: "Son of man, write down this date — this very day — because the king of Babylon has laid siege to Jerusalem this very day."

verses.kjv: And utter a parable unto the rebellious house, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Set on a pot, set it on, and also pour water into it:
verses.modern: "Tell a parable to that rebellious house and say to them: This is what the Lord GOD says: Put on the pot. Put it on and pour water into it."

verses.kjv: Gather the pieces thereof into it, even every good piece, the thigh, and the shoulder; fill it with the choice bones.
verses.modern: "Put into it the pieces of meat — every good piece, the thigh and the shoulder. Fill it with the best bones."

verses.kjv: Take the choice of the flock, and burn also the bones under it, and make it boil well, and let them seethe the bones of it therein.
verses.modern: "Take the pick of the flock. Pile the wood beneath it. Bring it to a boil and cook the bones in it."

verses.kjv: Wherefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the bloody city, to the pot whose scum is therein, and whose scum is not gone out of it! bring it out piece by piece; let no lot fall upon it.
verses.modern: "For this is what the Lord GOD says: How terrible for the city of bloodshed — the pot now encrusted with filth, whose deposit will not go away! Empty it piece by piece without casting lots for the pieces."

verses.kjv: For her blood is in the midst of her; she set it upon the top of a rock; she poured it not upon the ground, to cover it with dust;
verses.modern: "For the blood she shed is in her midst. She poured it on the bare rock. She did not pour it on the ground, where the dust would cover it."

verses.kjv: That it might cause fury to come up to take vengeance; I have set her blood upon the top of a rock, that it should not be covered.
verses.modern: "To stir up My wrath and take revenge, I put her blood on the bare rock so that it would not be covered."

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the bloody city! I will even make the pile for fire great.
verses.modern: "Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: How terrible for the city of bloodshed! I too will pile the wood high."

verses.kjv: Heap on wood, kindle the fire, consume the flesh, and spice it well, and let the bones be burned.
verses.modern: "So heap on the wood and kindle the fire. Cook the meat well, mixing in the spices, and let the bones be charred."

verses.kjv: Then set it empty upon the coals thereof, that the brass of it may be hot, and may burn, and that the filthiness of it may be molten in it, that the scum of it may be consumed.
verses.modern: "Then set the empty pot on the coals till it becomes hot and its copper glows, so that its impurities may be melted and its deposit burned away."

verses.kjv: She hath wearied herself with lies, and her great scum went not forth out of her: her scum shall be in the fire.
verses.modern: "It has frustrated all efforts. Its heavy deposit has not been removed — not even by fire."

verses.kjv: In thy filthiness is lewdness: because I have purged thee, and thou wast not purged, thou shalt not be purged from thy filthiness any more, till I have caused my fury to rest upon thee.
verses.modern: "Now Your impurity is lewdness. Because I tried to cleanse You but You would not be cleansed from Your impurity, You will not be clean again until My wrath against You has subsided."

verses.kjv: I the LORD have spoken it: it shall come to pass, and I will do it; I will not go back, neither will I spare, neither will I repent; according to thy ways, and according to thy doings, shall they judge thee, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "I the LORD have spoken. The time has come for Me to act. I will not hold back. I will not have pity. I will not relent. You will be judged according to Your conduct and Your actions, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: Also the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, behold, I take away from thee the desire of thine eyes with a stroke: yet neither shalt thou mourn nor weep, neither shall thy tears run down.
verses.modern: "Son of man, with one blow I am about to take away from You the delight of Your eyes. Yet do not lament or weep or let Your tears flow."

verses.kjv: Forbear to cry, make no mourning for the dead, bind the tire of thine head upon thee, and put on thy shoes upon thy feet, and cover not thy lips, and eat not the bread of men.
verses.modern: "Groan quietly. Do not mourn for the dead. Keep Your turban on Your head and Your sandals on Your feet. Do not cover the lower part of Your face or eat the customary food of mourners."

verses.kjv: So I spake unto the people in the morning: and at even my wife died; and I did in the morning as I was commanded.
verses.modern: I spoke to the people in the morning, and that evening my wife died. The next morning I did as I had been commanded.

verses.kjv: And the people said unto me, Wilt thou not tell us what these things are to us, that thou doest so?
verses.modern: The people asked me, "Won't you tell us what these things mean for us? Why are You behaving this way?"

verses.kjv: Then I answered them, The word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: I answered them, "The word of the LORD came to me:"

verses.kjv: Speak unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the excellency of your strength, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pitieth; and your sons and your daughters whom ye have left shall fall by the sword.
verses.modern: "Say to the house of Israel: This is what the Lord GOD says: I am about to desecrate My sanctuary — the stronghold You are so proud of, the delight of Your eyes, the desire of Your heart. The sons and daughters You left behind will fall by the sword."

verses.kjv: And ye shall do as I have done: ye shall not cover your lips, nor eat the bread of men.
verses.modern: "And You will do as I have done. You will not cover the lower part of Your face or eat the bread of mourners."

verses.kjv: And your tires shall be upon your heads, and your shoes upon your feet: ye shall not mourn nor weep; but ye shall pine away for your iniquities, and mourn one toward another.
verses.modern: "You will keep Your turbans on Your heads and Your sandals on Your feet. You will not mourn or weep but will waste away because of Your sins and groan among yourselves."

verses.kjv: Thus Ezekiel is unto you a sign: according to all that he hath done shall ye do: and when this cometh, ye shall know that I am the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "Ezekiel will be a sign to you. You will do just as He has done. When this happens, You will know that I am the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: Also, thou son of man, shall it not be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their minds, their sons and their daughters,
verses.modern: "And You, Son of man — on the day I take away their stronghold — their joy and pride, the delight of their eyes, their heart's desire — and their sons and daughters as well —"

verses.kjv: That he that escapeth in that day shall come unto thee, to cause thee to hear it with thine ears?
verses.modern: "on that day a fugitive will come to You and report it to You in person."

verses.kjv: In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him which is escaped, and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb: and thou shalt be a sign unto them; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "At that time Your mouth will be opened. You will speak with the fugitive and be silent no more. You will be a sign to them, and they will know that I am the LORD."

chapters.summary: On the very day Nebuchadnezzar begins the siege of Jerusalem, the LORD gives Ezekiel the parable of the boiling pot full of rust and corruption. That evening Ezekiel's wife dies, and the LORD forbids him to mourn — a sign that when the temple falls, the people's grief will be too great for tears.

verses.kjv: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, set thy face against the Ammonites, and prophesy against them;
verses.modern: "Son of man, set Your face against the Ammonites and prophesy against them."

verses.kjv: And say unto the Ammonites, Hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, when it was desolate; and against the house of Judah, when they went into captivity;
verses.modern: "Say to the Ammonites: Hear the word of the Lord GOD. This is what the Lord GOD says: Because You said 'Aha!' over My sanctuary when it was desecrated, and over the land of Israel when it was laid waste, and over the house of Judah when they went into exile —"

verses.kjv: Behold, therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession, and they shall set their palaces in thee, and make their dwellings in thee: they shall eat thy fruit, and they shall drink thy milk.
verses.modern: "therefore I am going to give You to the people of the East as a possession. They will set up their camps and pitch their tents among You. They will eat Your fruit and drink Your milk."

verses.kjv: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the Ammonites a couching place for flocks: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "I will turn Rabbah into a pasture for camels and Ammon into a resting place for flocks. Then You will know that I am the LORD."

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast clapped thine hands, and stamped with the feet, and rejoiced in heart with all thy despite against the land of Israel;
verses.modern: "For this is what the Lord GOD says: Because You have clapped Your hands and stamped Your feet, rejoicing with all the contempt You felt for the land of Israel —"

verses.kjv: Behold, therefore I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and will deliver thee for a spoil to the heathen; and I will cut thee off from the people, and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries: I will destroy thee; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "therefore I will stretch out My hand against You and give You as plunder to the heathen. I will cut you off from the peoples and eliminate You from the countries. I will destroy You, and You will know that I am the LORD."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah is like unto all the heathen;
verses.modern: "This is what the Lord GOD says: Because Moab and Seir said, 'Look, the house of Judah has become like all the other heathen' —"

verses.kjv: Therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Bethjeshimoth, Baalmeon, and Kiriathaim,
verses.modern: "therefore I will expose the flank of Moab, beginning at its frontier towns — Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon, and Kiriathaim — the glory of that land."

verses.kjv: Unto the men of the east with the Ammonites, and will give them in possession, that the Ammonites may not be remembered among the nations.
verses.modern: "I will give it along with Ammon to the people of the East as a possession, so that Ammon will not be remembered among the nations."

verses.kjv: And I will execute judgments upon Moab; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "And I will execute judgment on Moab. Then they will know that I am the LORD."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because that Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and hath greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them;
verses.modern: "This is what the Lord GOD says: Because Edom took revenge on the house of Judah and became very guilty by doing so —"

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also stretch out mine hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; and they of Dedan shall fall by the sword.
verses.modern: "therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I will stretch out My hand against Edom and kill its people and their animals. I will lay it waste, and from Teman to Dedan they will fall by the sword."

verses.kjv: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel: and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my fury; and they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "I will take vengeance on Edom by the hand of My people Israel, and they will deal with Edom in accordance with My anger and My wrath. They will know My vengeance, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart, to destroy it for the old hatred;
verses.modern: "This is what the Lord GOD says: Because the Philistines acted in vengeance and took revenge with malice in their hearts, destroying Israel with ancient hostility —"

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will stretch out mine hand upon the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethims, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.
verses.modern: "therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I am about to stretch out My hand against the Philistines, and I will cut off the Kerethites and destroy those remaining along the coast."

verses.kjv: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.
verses.modern: "I will carry out great vengeance on them and punish them in My wrath. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I take vengeance on them."

chapters.summary: The LORD pronounces judgment against four neighboring nations: Ammon for rejoicing over the temple's destruction, Moab for saying Judah is like all other nations, Edom for taking vengeance on Judah, and the Philistines for acting in revenge with spite. All will know that He is the LORD.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: In the eleventh year, on the first day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, because that Tyrus hath said against Jerusalem, Aha, she is broken that was the gate of the people: she is turned unto me: I shall be replenished, now she is laid waste:
verses.modern: "Son of man, because Tyre has said of Jerusalem, 'Aha! The gate of the peoples is broken, and its doors have swung open to me. Now that she lies in ruins, I will prosper' —"

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against thee, O Tyrus, and will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth his waves to come up.
verses.modern: "therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I am against You, Tyre, and I will bring many nations against You, like the sea casting up its waves."

verses.kjv: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyrus, and break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her like the top of a rock.
verses.modern: "They will destroy the walls of Tyre and pull down her towers. I will scrape away her rubble and make her a bare rock."

verses.kjv: It shall be a place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD: and it shall become a spoil to the nations.
verses.modern: "Out in the sea she will become a place to spread fishing nets, for I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD. She will become plunder for the nations."

verses.kjv: And her daughters which are in the field shall be slain by the sword; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "Her settlements on the mainland will be ravaged by the sword. Then they will know that I am the LORD."

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will bring upon Tyrus Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, a king of kings, from the north, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and companies, and much people.
verses.modern: "For this is what the Lord GOD says: From the north I am going to bring against Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon — king of kings — with horses and chariots, with horsemen and a great army."

verses.kjv: He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field: and he shall make a fort against thee, and cast a mount against thee, and lift up the buckler against thee.
verses.modern: "He will ravage Your settlements on the mainland with the sword. He will set up siege works against You, build a ramp up to Your walls, and raise His shields against You."

verses.kjv: And he shall set engines of war against thy walls, and with his axes he shall break down thy towers.
verses.modern: "He will direct the blows of His battering rams against Your walls and demolish Your towers with His weapons."

verses.kjv: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover thee: thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and of the wheels, and of the chariots, when he shall enter into thy gates, as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach.
verses.modern: "his horses will be so many that their dust will cover You. Your walls will tremble at the noise of the war horses, wagons, and chariots when He enters Your gates as men enter a city whose walls have been broken through."

verses.kjv: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets: he shall slay thy people by the sword, and thy strong garrisons shall go down to the ground.
verses.modern: "The hooves of his horses will trample all Your streets. He will kill Your people with the sword, and Your strong pillars will fall to the ground."

verses.kjv: And they shall make a spoil of thy riches, and make a prey of thy merchandise: and they shall break down thy walls, and destroy thy pleasant houses: and they shall lay thy stones and thy timber and thy dust in the midst of the water.
verses.modern: "They will plunder Your wealth and loot Your merchandise. They will break down Your walls and demolish Your fine houses and throw Your stones, timber, and rubble into the sea."

verses.kjv: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease; and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard.
verses.modern: "I will put an end to Your noisy songs, and the music of Your harps will be heard no more."

verses.kjv: And I will make thee like the top of a rock: thou shalt be a place to spread nets upon; thou shalt be built no more: for I the LORD have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "I will make You a bare rock, and You will become a place to spread fishing nets. You will never be rebuilt, for I the LORD have spoken, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD to Tyrus; Shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall, when the wounded cry, when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee?
verses.modern: "This is what the Lord GOD says to Tyre: Will not the coastlands tremble at the sound of Your fall, when the wounded groan and the slaughter takes place in Your midst?"

verses.kjv: Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay away their robes, and put off their broidered garments: they shall clothe themselves with trembling; they shall sit upon the ground, and shall tremble at every moment, and be astonished at thee.
verses.modern: "Then all the princes of the coast will step down from their thrones and lay aside their robes and take off their embroidered garments. Clothed with terror, they will sit on the ground, trembling every moment, appalled at You."

verses.kjv: And they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and say to thee, How art thou destroyed, that wast inhabited of seafaring men, the renowned city, which wast strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, which cause their terror to be on all that haunt it!
verses.modern: "They will take up a lament concerning You and say to You: 'How You are destroyed, You city of sailors — the renowned city, strong on the sea! She and her inhabitants spread their terror over all who lived there!'"

verses.kjv: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall; yea, the isles that are in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure.
verses.modern: "Now the coastlands tremble on the day of Your fall. The islands in the sea are terrified at Your end."

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD; When I shall make thee a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited; when I shall bring up the deep upon thee, and great waters shall cover thee;
verses.modern: "For this is what the Lord GOD says: When I make You a desolate city, like cities no longer inhabited, and when I bring the ocean depths over You and its vast waters cover You —"

verses.kjv: When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit, with the people of old time, and shall set thee in the low parts of the earth, in places desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that thou be not inhabited; and I shall set glory in the land of the living;
verses.modern: "then I will bring You down with those who go down to the pit, to the people of long ago. I will make you live in the earth below, as in ancient ruins, with those who go down to the pit, and You will not return or take Your place in the land of the living."

verses.kjv: I will make thee a terror, and thou shalt be no more: though thou be sought for, yet shalt thou never be found again, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "I will bring You to a horrible end and You will be no more. You will be sought, but You will never again be found, declares the Lord GOD."

chapters.summary: The LORD pronounces judgment against Tyre for rejoicing over Jerusalem's fall. Many nations will come against her like waves of the sea. Nebuchadnezzar will besiege her, her walls will be broken down, and her very stones and timbers will be cast into the waters. She will never be rebuilt.

verses.kjv: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Now, thou son of man, take up a lamentation for Tyrus;
verses.modern: "Son of man, take up a lament concerning Tyre."

verses.kjv: And say unto Tyrus, O thou that art situate at the entry of the sea, which art a merchant of the people for many isles, Thus saith the Lord GOD; O Tyrus, thou hast said, I am of perfect beauty.
verses.modern: "Say to Tyre, situated at the gateway to the sea, merchant of peoples on many coasts: This is what the Lord GOD says: You say, Tyre, 'I am perfect in beauty.'"

verses.kjv: Thy borders are in the midst of the seas, thy builders have perfected thy beauty.
verses.modern: "Your domain was on the high seas. Your builders brought Your beauty to perfection."

verses.kjv: They have made all thy ship boards of fir trees of Senir: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for thee.
verses.modern: "They made all Your planks from pine trees of Senir. They took a cedar from Lebanon to make the mast for You."

verses.kjv: Of the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars; the company of the Ashurites have made thy benches of ivory, brought out of the isles of Chittim.
verses.modern: "Of oaks from Bashan they made Your oars. Of cypress wood from the coasts of Cyprus they made Your deck, inlaid with ivory."

verses.kjv: Fine linen with broidered work from Egypt was that which thou spreadest forth to be thy sail; blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was that which covered thee.
verses.modern: "Your sail was of embroidered linen from Egypt and served as Your banner. Your awning was of blue and purple from the coasts of Elishah."

verses.kjv: The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were thy mariners: thy wise men, O Tyrus, that were in thee, were thy pilots.
verses.modern: "Men of Sidon and Arvad were Your oarsmen. Your skilled men, Tyre, were aboard as Your sailors."

verses.kjv: The ancients of Gebal and the wise men thereof were in thee thy calkers: all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to occupy thy merchandise.
verses.modern: "Veteran craftsmen of Byblos were on board as caulkers of Your seams. All the ships of the sea and their sailors came to You to trade for Your wares."

verses.kjv: They of Persia and of Lud and of Phut were in thine army, thy men of war: they hanged the shield and helmet in thee; they set forth thy comeliness.
verses.modern: "Men of Persia, Lydia, and Put served as soldiers in Your army. They hung their shields and helmets on Your walls, bringing You splendor."

verses.kjv: The men of Arvad with thine army were upon thy walls round about, and the Gammadims were in thy towers: they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about; they have made thy beauty perfect.
verses.modern: "Men of Arvad and Helech manned Your walls all around. The men of Gammad were in Your towers. They hung their shields around Your walls and brought Your beauty to perfection."

verses.kjv: Tarshish was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all kind of riches; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, they traded in thy fairs.
verses.modern: "Tarshish did business with You because of Your great wealth of goods. They exchanged silver, iron, tin, and lead for Your merchandise."

verses.kjv: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were thy merchants: they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market.
verses.modern: "Greece, Tubal, and Meshech traded with You. They bartered human beings and articles of bronze for Your wares."

verses.kjv: They of the house of Togarmah traded in thy fairs with horses and horsemen and mules.
verses.modern: "From Beth Togarmah they exchanged warhorses, work horses, and mules for Your merchandise."

verses.kjv: The men of Dedan were thy merchants; many isles were the merchandise of thine hand: they brought thee for a present horns of ivory and ebony.
verses.modern: "The men of Rhodes traded with You, and many coastlands were Your customers. They brought You ivory tusks and ebony as payment."

verses.kjv: Syria was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of the wares of thy making: they occupied in thy fairs with emeralds, purple, and broidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and agate.
verses.modern: "Aram did business with You because of Your many products. They exchanged turquoise, purple fabric, embroidered work, fine linen, coral, and rubies for Your merchandise."

verses.kjv: Judah, and the land of Israel, they were thy merchants: they traded in thy market wheat of Minnith, and Pannag, and honey, and oil, and balm.
verses.modern: "Judah and the land of Israel traded with You. They exchanged wheat from Minnith, and confections, honey, olive oil, and balm for Your wares."

verses.kjv: Damascus was thy merchant in the multitude of the wares of thy making, for the multitude of all riches; in the wine of Helbon, and white wool.
verses.modern: "Damascus did business with You because of Your many products and Your great wealth. They offered wine from Helbon and wool from Zahar."

verses.kjv: Dan also and Javan going to and fro occupied in thy fairs: bright iron, cassia, and calamus, were in thy market.
verses.modern: "Vedan and Javan from Uzal bought Your merchandise. They exchanged wrought iron, cassia, and calamus for Your wares."

verses.kjv: Dedan was thy merchant in precious clothes for chariots.
verses.modern: "Dedan traded in saddlecloths for riding."

verses.kjv: Arabia, and all the princes of Kedar, they occupied with thee in lambs, and rams, and goats: in these were they thy merchants.
verses.modern: "Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were Your customers. They traded with You in lambs, rams, and goats."

verses.kjv: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah, they were thy merchants: they occupied in thy fairs with chief of all spices, and with all precious stones, and gold.
verses.modern: "The merchants of Sheba and Raamah traded with You. For Your merchandise they exchanged the finest of all spices and precious stones and gold."

verses.kjv: Haran, and Canneh, and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad, were thy merchants.
verses.modern: "Haran, Canneh, and Eden and merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Kilmad traded with You."

verses.kjv: These were thy merchants in all sorts of things, in blue clothes, and broidered work, and in chests of rich apparel, bound with cords, and made of cedar, among thy merchandise.
verses.modern: "In Your marketplace they traded with You in choice garments, blue fabric, embroidered work and multicolored rugs, and tightly wound cords."

verses.kjv: The ships of Tarshish did sing of thee in thy market: and thou wast replenished, and made very glorious in the midst of the seas.
verses.modern: "The ships of Tarshish served as carriers for Your wares. You were filled with heavy cargo as You sailed the sea."

verses.kjv: Thy rowers have brought thee into great waters: the east wind hath broken thee in the midst of the seas.
verses.modern: "Your oarsmen took You out to the high seas. But the east wind has shattered You in the heart of the sea."

verses.kjv: Thy riches, and thy fairs, thy merchandise, thy mariners, and thy pilots, thy calkers, and the occupiers of thy merchandise, and all thy men of war, that are in thee, and in all thy company which is in the midst of thee, shall fall into the midst of the seas in the day of thy ruin.
verses.modern: "Your wealth, merchandise, and wares, Your mariners and sailors, Your caulkers, Your merchants and soldiers, and all the other people on board will sink into the heart of the sea on the day of Your shipwreck."

verses.kjv: The suburbs shall shake at the sound of the cry of thy pilots.
verses.modern: "The coastlands will quake when Your sailors cry out."

verses.kjv: And all that handle the oar, the mariners, and all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from their ships, they shall stand upon the land;
verses.modern: "All who handle the oars will abandon their ships. The mariners and all the sailors will stand on the shore."

verses.kjv: And shall cause their voice to be heard against thee, and shall cry bitterly, and shall cast up dust upon their heads, they shall wallow themselves in the ashes:
verses.modern: "They will raise their voice and cry out bitterly over You. They will throw dust on their heads and roll in the ashes."

verses.kjv: And they shall make themselves utterly bald for thee, and gird them with sackcloth, and they shall weep for thee with bitterness of heart and bitter wailing.
verses.modern: "They will shave their heads because of You and put on sackcloth. They will weep over You with anguish of soul and bitter mourning."

verses.kjv: And in their wailing they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and lament over thee, saying, What city is like Tyrus, like the destroyed in the midst of the sea?
verses.modern: "In their wailing they will take up a lament concerning You and mourn over You: 'Who was ever silenced like Tyre, surrounded by the sea?'"

verses.kjv: When thy wares went forth out of the seas, thou filledst many people; thou didst enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of thy riches and of thy merchandise.
verses.modern: "When Your merchandise went out on the seas, You satisfied many nations. With Your great wealth and Your wares You enriched the kings of the earth."

verses.kjv: In the time when thou shalt be broken by the seas in the depths of the waters thy merchandise and all thy company in the midst of thee shall fall.
verses.modern: "Now You are shattered by the sea in the depths of the waters. Your wares and all Your company have gone down with You."

verses.kjv: All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at thee, and their kings shall be sore afraid, they shall be troubled in their countenance.
verses.modern: "All who live in the coastlands are appalled at You. Their kings shudder with horror and their faces are distorted with fear."

verses.kjv: The merchants among the people shall hiss at thee; thou shalt be a terror, and never shalt be any more.
verses.modern: "The merchants among the nations hiss at you. You have come to a horrible end and will be no more."

chapters.summary: Ezekiel takes up a lament for Tyre, depicting her as a magnificent merchant ship built from the finest materials and trading with all the known world. Her riches, wares, and merchants are catalogued in detail — but she will sink into the heart of the seas, and the nations will be horrified at her end.

verses.kjv: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, say unto the prince of Tyrus, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thine heart is lifted up, and thou hast said, I am a God, I sit in the seat of God, in the midst of the seas; yet thou art a man, and not God, though thou set thine heart as the heart of God:
verses.modern: "Son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre: This is what the Lord GOD says: In the pride of Your heart You say, 'I am a god. I sit on the throne of a god in the heart of the seas.' But You are a mere mortal and not a god, even though You think You are as wise as a god."

verses.kjv: Behold, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee:
verses.modern: "Are You wiser than Daniel? Is no secret hidden from you?"

verses.kjv: With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures:
verses.modern: "By Your wisdom and understanding You have gained wealth for Yourself and amassed gold and silver in Your treasuries."

verses.kjv: By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches, and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches:
verses.modern: "By Your great skill in trading You have increased Your wealth, and because of Your wealth Your heart has grown proud."

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast set thine heart as the heart of God;
verses.modern: "Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Because You think You are wise — as wise as a god —"

verses.kjv: Behold, therefore I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations: and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom, and they shall defile thy brightness.
verses.modern: "I am going to bring foreigners against You, the most ruthless of nations. They will draw their swords against Your beauty and wisdom and pierce Your shining splendor."

verses.kjv: They shall bring thee down to the pit, and thou shalt die the deaths of them that are slain in the midst of the seas.
verses.modern: "They will bring You down to the pit, and You will die a violent death in the heart of the seas."

verses.kjv: Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee, I am God? but thou shalt be a man, and no God, in the hand of him that slayeth thee.
verses.modern: "Will You then say, 'I am a god,' in the presence of those who kill You? You will be just a mortal, not a god, in the hands of those who slay You."

verses.kjv: Thou shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "You will die the death of the uncircumcised at the hands of foreigners. For I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyrus, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Thou sealest up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.
verses.modern: "Son of man, take up a lament concerning the king of Tyre and say to him: This is what the Lord GOD says: You were the seal of perfection, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty."

verses.kjv: Thou hast been in Eden the garden of God; every precious stone was thy covering, the sardius, topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the emerald, and the carbuncle, and gold: the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was prepared in thee in the day that thou wast created.
verses.modern: "You were in Eden, the garden of God. Every precious stone adorned You — ruby, topaz, and emerald, chrysolite, onyx, and jasper, lapis lazuli, turquoise, and beryl. Your settings and mountings were made of gold. On the day You were created they were prepared."

verses.kjv: Thou art the anointed cherub that covereth; and I have set thee so: thou wast upon the holy mountain of God; thou hast walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire.
verses.modern: "You were anointed as a guardian cherub, for so I ordained You. You were on the holy mountain of God. You walked among the fiery stones."

verses.kjv: Thou wast perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created, till iniquity was found in thee.
verses.modern: "You were blameless in Your ways from the day You were created till iniquity was found in You."

verses.kjv: By the multitude of thy merchandise they have filled the midst of thee with violence, and thou hast sinned: therefore I will cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God: and I will destroy thee, O covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.
verses.modern: "Through Your widespread trade You were filled with violence, and You sinned. So I drove You in disgrace from the mountain of God, and I expelled You, guardian cherub, from among the fiery stones."

verses.kjv: Thine heart was lifted up because of thy beauty, thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness: I will cast thee to the ground, I will lay thee before kings, that they may behold thee.
verses.modern: "Your heart became proud on account of Your beauty. You corrupted Your wisdom because of Your splendor. So I threw You to the earth. I made a spectacle of You before kings."

verses.kjv: Thou hast defiled thy sanctuaries by the multitude of thine iniquities, by the iniquity of thy traffick; therefore will I bring forth a fire from the midst of thee, it shall devour thee, and I will bring thee to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold thee.
verses.modern: "By Your many sins and dishonest trade You have desecrated Your sanctuaries. So I made a fire come out from You, and it consumed You. I reduced You to ashes on the ground in the sight of all who were watching."

verses.kjv: All they that know thee among the people shall be astonished at thee: thou shalt be a terror, and never shalt thou be any more.
verses.modern: "All the nations who knew you are appalled at you. You have come to a horrible end and will be no more."

verses.kjv: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, set thy face against Zidon, and prophesy against it,
verses.modern: "Son of man, set Your face against Sidon. Prophesy against it."

verses.kjv: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against thee, O Zidon; and I will be glorified in the midst of thee: and they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall have executed judgments in her, and shall be sanctified in her.
verses.modern: "Say: This is what the Lord GOD says: I am against You, Sidon, and among You I will display My glory. They will know that I am the LORD when I inflict punishment on her and show Myself holy within her."

verses.kjv: For I will send into her pestilence, and blood into her streets; and the wounded shall be judged in the midst of her by the sword upon her on every side; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
