verses.modern: "I will send a plague upon her and make blood flow in her streets. The slain will fall within her, with the sword against her on every side. Then they will know that I am the LORD."

verses.kjv: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel, nor any grieving thorn of all that are round about them, that despised them; and they shall know that I am the LORD GOD.
verses.modern: "No longer will the people of Israel have malicious neighbors who are painful briers and sharp thorns. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered, and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.
verses.modern: "This is what the Lord GOD says: When I gather the people of Israel from the heathen where they have been scattered, I will be proved holy through them in the sight of the heathen. Then they will live in their own land, which I gave to My servant Jacob."

verses.kjv: And they shall dwell safely therein, and shall build houses, and plant vineyards; yea, they shall dwell with confidence, when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them; and they shall know that I am the LORD their God.
verses.modern: "They will live there in safety and will build houses and plant vineyards. They will live in safety when I inflict punishment on all their neighbors who treated them with contempt. Then they will know that I am the LORD their God."

chapters.summary: The LORD condemns the prince of Tyre, who says "I am a god" in his pride, and declares he will die the death of the uncircumcised. A lament follows for the king of Tyre — once in Eden, full of wisdom and beauty, the anointed cherub on the holy mountain of God — cast down because of his corruption. The LORD also pronounces judgment on Sidon.

verses.kjv: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, in the twelfth day of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: In the tenth year, on the twelfth day of the tenth month, the word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him, and against all Egypt:
verses.modern: "Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt and prophesy against him and against all Egypt."

verses.kjv: Speak, and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against thee, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great dragon that lieth in the midst of his rivers, which hath said, My river is mine own, and I have made it for myself.
verses.modern: "Say: This is what the Lord GOD says: I am against You, Pharaoh king of Egypt, you great monster lying among Your streams, who says, 'The Nile belongs to me. I made it for myself.'"

verses.kjv: But I will put hooks in thy jaws, and I will cause the fish of thy rivers to stick unto thy scales, and I will bring thee up out of the midst of thy rivers, and all the fish of thy rivers shall stick unto thy scales.
verses.modern: "But I will put hooks in Your jaws and make the fish of Your streams stick to Your scales. I will pull You out from among Your streams, with all the fish sticking to Your scales."

verses.kjv: And I will leave thee thrown into the wilderness, thee and all the fish of thy rivers: thou shalt fall upon the open fields; thou shalt not be brought together, nor gathered: I will give thee for meat to the beasts of the field and to the fowls of the heaven.
verses.modern: "I will leave You in the desert — you and all the fish of Your streams. You will fall on the open field and not be gathered or picked up. I will give You as food to the wild animals and the birds."

verses.kjv: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I am the LORD, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.
verses.modern: "Then all who live in Egypt will know that I am the LORD. You have been a staff of reed for the house of Israel."

verses.kjv: When they took hold of thee by thy hand, thou didst break, and rend all their shoulder: and when they leaned upon thee, thou brakest, and madest all their loins to be at a stand.
verses.modern: "When they grasped You with their hands, You splintered and tore open their shoulders. When they leaned on You, You broke and their backs were wrenched."

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will bring a sword upon thee, and cut off man and beast out of thee.
verses.modern: "Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I will bring a sword against You and kill Your people and their animals."

verses.kjv: And the land of Egypt shall be desolate and waste; and they shall know that I am the LORD: because he hath said, The river is mine, and I have made it.
verses.modern: "Egypt will become a desolate wasteland. Then they will know that I am the LORD. Because You said, 'The Nile is mine and I made it' —"

verses.kjv: Behold, therefore I am against thee, and against thy rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt utterly waste and desolate, from the tower of Syene even unto the border of Ethiopia.
verses.modern: "therefore I am against You and against Your streams, and I will make the land of Egypt a ruin and a desolate waste, from Migdol to Aswan, as far as the border of Cush."

verses.kjv: No foot of man shall pass through it, nor foot of beast shall pass through it, neither shall it be inhabited forty years.
verses.modern: "No foot of man or animal will pass through it. No one will live there for forty years."

verses.kjv: And I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities among the cities that are laid waste shall be desolate forty years: and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.
verses.modern: "I will make the land of Egypt desolate among devastated lands, and her cities will lie desolate forty years among ruined cities. I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them through the countries."

verses.kjv: Yet thus saith the Lord GOD; At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the people whither they were scattered:
verses.modern: "Yet this is what the Lord GOD says: At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the nations where they were scattered."

verses.kjv: And I will bring again the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their habitation; and they shall be there a base kingdom.
verses.modern: "I will bring Egypt back from captivity and return them to Upper Egypt, the land of their origin. There they will be a lowly kingdom."

verses.kjv: It shall be the basest of the kingdoms; neither shall it exalt itself any more above the nations: for I will diminish them, that they shall no more rule over the nations.
verses.modern: "It will be the lowliest of kingdoms and will never again exalt itself above the other nations. I will make it so weak that it will never again rule over the nations."

verses.kjv: And it shall be no more the confidence of the house of Israel, which bringeth their iniquity to remembrance, when they shall look after them: but they shall know that I am the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "Egypt will no longer be a source of confidence for the people of Israel but will remind them of their sin in turning to her for help. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the seven and twentieth year, in the first month, in the first day of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: In the twenty-seventh year, on the first day of the first month, the word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyrus: every head was made bald, and every shoulder was peeled: yet had he no wages, nor his army, for Tyrus, for the service that he had served against it:
verses.modern: "Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon drove his army in a hard campaign against Tyre. Every head was rubbed bare and every shoulder made raw. Yet he and his army got no reward from Tyre for the campaign he had led against it."

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall take her multitude, and take her spoil, and take her prey; and it shall be the wages for his army.
verses.modern: "Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I am going to give Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will carry off its wealth. He will loot and plunder it as pay for His army."

verses.kjv: I have given him the land of Egypt for his labour wherewith he served against it, because they wrought for me, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "I have given Him Egypt as a reward for His efforts because He and His army did it for Me, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: In that day will I cause the horn of the house of Israel to bud forth, and I will give thee the opening of the mouth in the midst of them; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "On that day I will make a horn of the house of Israel grow, and I will open Your mouth among them. Then they will know that I am the LORD."

chapters.summary: The LORD sets His face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great dragon lying in his rivers who says "My river is my own; I have made it." Egypt will become a desolation for forty years, then be restored as a lowly kingdom. Nebuchadnezzar will receive the spoils of Egypt as wages for his service against Tyre.

verses.kjv: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Howl ye, Woe worth the day!
verses.modern: "Son of man, prophesy and say: This is what the Lord GOD says: Wail and say, 'Alas for that day!'"

verses.kjv: For the day is near, even the day of the LORD is near, a cloudy day; it shall be the time of the heathen.
verses.modern: "For the day is near — the day of the LORD is near. It will be a day of clouds, a time of reckoning for the heathen."

verses.kjv: And the sword shall come upon Egypt, and great pain shall be in Ethiopia, when the slain shall fall in Egypt, and they shall take away her multitude, and her foundations shall be broken down.
verses.modern: "A sword will come against Egypt, and anguish will come upon Cush. When the slain fall in Egypt, her wealth will be carried away and her foundations torn down."

verses.kjv: Ethiopia, and Libya, and Lydia, and all the mingled people, and Chub, and the men of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by the sword.
verses.modern: "Cush and Put, Lydia and all Arabia, Libya and the people of the covenant land — they will all fall by the sword along with Egypt."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; They also that uphold Egypt shall fall; and the pride of her power shall come down: from the tower of Syene shall they fall in it by the sword, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "This is what the LORD says: The allies of Egypt will fall, and her proud strength will fail. From Migdol to Aswan they will fall by the sword within Egypt, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted.
verses.modern: "They will be desolate among desolate lands. Their cities will be among ruined cities."

verses.kjv: And they shall know that I am the LORD, when I have set a fire in Egypt, and when all her helpers shall be destroyed.
verses.modern: "They will know that I am the LORD when I set fire to Egypt and all her helpers are crushed."

verses.kjv: In that day shall messengers go forth from me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid, and great pain shall come upon them, as in the day of Egypt: for, lo, it cometh.
verses.modern: "On that day messengers will go out from Me in ships to frighten Cush out of her complacency. Anguish will take hold of them on the day of Egypt's doom, for it is surely coming."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon.
verses.modern: "This is what the Lord GOD says: I will put an end to the hordes of Egypt by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon."

verses.kjv: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, shall be brought to destroy the land: and they shall draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.
verses.modern: "He and His army — the most ruthless of nations — will be brought in to destroy the land. They will draw their swords against Egypt and fill the land with the slain."

verses.kjv: And I will make the rivers dry, and sell the land into the hand of the wicked: and I will make the land waste, and all that is therein, by the hand of strangers: I the LORD have spoken it.
verses.modern: "I will dry up the streams of the Nile and sell the land to evil men. By the hand of foreigners I will lay waste the land and everything in it. I the LORD have spoken."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause their images to cease out of Noph; and there shall be no more a prince of the land of Egypt: and I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.
verses.modern: "This is what the Lord GOD says: I will destroy the idols and put an end to the images in Memphis. No longer will there be a prince in Egypt, and I will spread fear throughout the land."

verses.kjv: And I will make Pathros desolate, and will set fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments in No.
verses.modern: "I will lay waste Upper Egypt, set fire to Zoan, and inflict punishment on Thebes."

verses.kjv: And I will pour my fury upon Sin, the strength of Egypt; and I will cut off the multitude of No.
verses.modern: "I will pour out My wrath on Pelusium, the stronghold of Egypt, and cut off the hordes of Thebes."

verses.kjv: And I will set fire in Egypt: Sin shall have great pain, and No shall be rent asunder, and Noph shall have distresses daily.
verses.modern: "I will set fire to Egypt. Pelusium will writhe in agony. Thebes will be torn apart. Memphis will be in constant distress."

verses.kjv: The young men of Aven and of Pibeseth shall fall by the sword: and these cities shall go into captivity.
verses.modern: "The young men of Heliopolis and Bubastis will fall by the sword, and the cities will go into captivity."

verses.kjv: At Tehaphnehes also the day shall be darkened, when I shall break there the yokes of Egypt: and the pride of her power shall cease in her: as for her, a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall go into captivity.
verses.modern: "Dark will be the day at Tahpanhes when I break the yoke of Egypt. There her proud strength will come to an end. She will be covered with clouds, and her villages will go into captivity."

verses.kjv: Thus will I execute judgments in Egypt: and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "So I will inflict punishment on Egypt, and they will know that I am the LORD."

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first month, in the seventh day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: In the eleventh year, on the seventh day of the first month, the word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and, lo, it shall not be bound up to be healed, to put a roller to bind it, to make it strong to hold the sword.
verses.modern: "Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt. It has not been bound up for healing or wrapped with a bandage so that it may become strong enough to hold a sword."

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong, and that which was broken; and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.
verses.modern: "Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt. I will break both his arms — the good arm as well as the broken one — and make the sword fall from His hand."

verses.kjv: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.
verses.modern: "I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them through the countries."

verses.kjv: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand: but I will break Pharaoh's arms, and he shall groan before him with the groanings of a deadly wounded man.
verses.modern: "I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and put My sword in his hand. But I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he will groan before the king of Babylon like a mortally wounded man."

verses.kjv: But I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall down; and they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall stretch it out upon the land of Egypt.
verses.modern: "I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, but the arms of Pharaoh will fall limp. They will know that I am the LORD when I put My sword into the hand of the king of Babylon and he brandishes it against Egypt."

verses.kjv: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and disperse them among the countries; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them through the countries. Then they will know that I am the LORD."

chapters.summary: The LORD declares a day of doom for Egypt and her allies. The sword of Babylon will come against her, the rivers will be dried up, the idols destroyed, and the cities laid waste from Migdol to Syene. The LORD will break the arms of Pharaoh and strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the third month, in the first day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: In the eleventh year, on the first day of the third month, the word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to his multitude; Whom art thou like in thy greatness?
verses.modern: "Son of man, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his hordes: Who can be compared with you in your greatness?"

verses.kjv: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches, and with a shadowing shroud, and of an high stature; and his top was among the thick boughs.
verses.modern: "Consider Assyria, once a cedar in Lebanon, with beautiful branches overshadowing the forest. It towered high, its top above the thick foliage."

verses.kjv: The waters made him great, the deep set him up on high with her rivers running round about his plants, and sent out her little rivers unto all the trees of the field.
verses.modern: "The waters nourished it and the deep springs made it grow tall. Their streams flowed all around its base and sent their channels to all the trees of the field."

verses.kjv: Therefore his height was exalted above all the trees of the field, and his boughs were multiplied, and his branches became long because of the multitude of waters, when he shot forth.
verses.modern: "So it towered higher than all the trees of the field. Its boughs multiplied and its branches grew long, spreading because of the abundant water."

verses.kjv: All the fowls of heaven made their nests in his boughs, and under his branches did all the beasts of the field bring forth their young, and under his shadow dwelt all great nations.
verses.modern: "All the birds of the sky nested in its boughs. All the wild animals gave birth under its branches. All the great nations lived in its shade."

verses.kjv: Thus was he fair in his greatness, in the length of his branches: for his root was by great waters.
verses.modern: "It was majestic in beauty with its spreading boughs, for its roots reached down to abundant waters."

verses.kjv: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide him: the fir trees were not like his boughs, and the chestnut trees were not like his branches; nor any tree in the garden of God was like unto him in his beauty.
verses.modern: "The cedars in the garden of God could not rival it, nor could the junipers equal its boughs, nor the plane trees compare with its branches. No tree in the garden of God could match its beauty."

verses.kjv: I have made him fair by the multitude of his branches: so that all the trees of Eden, that were in the garden of God, envied him.
verses.modern: "I made it beautiful with abundant branches, the envy of all the trees of Eden in the garden of God."

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast lifted up thyself in height, and he hath shot up his top among the thick boughs, and his heart is lifted up in his height;
verses.modern: "Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Because it towered on high and set its top among the thick boughs, and because it was proud of its height —"

verses.kjv: I have therefore delivered him into the hand of the mighty one of the heathen; he shall surely deal with him: I have driven him out for his wickedness.
verses.modern: "I handed it over to the ruler of the heathen, for him to deal with according to its wickedness. I cast it aside."

verses.kjv: And strangers, the terrible of the nations, have cut him off, and have left him: upon the mountains and in all the valleys his branches are fallen, and his boughs are broken by all the rivers of the land; and all the people of the earth are gone down from his shadow, and have left him.
verses.modern: "The most ruthless of foreign nations cut it down and left it. Its branches fell on the mountains and in all the valleys. Its boughs lay broken in all the ravines of the land. All the nations of the earth left its shade and went away."

verses.kjv: Upon his ruin shall all the fowls of the heaven remain, and all the beasts of the field shall be upon his branches:
verses.modern: "All the birds settled on the fallen tree, and all the wild animals lived among its branches."

verses.kjv: To the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves for their height, neither shoot up their top among the thick boughs, neither their trees stand up in their height, all that drink water: for they are all delivered unto death, to the nether parts of the earth, in the midst of the children of men, with them that go down to the pit.
verses.modern: "No other trees by the waters are to grow tall and set their tops among the thick foliage. No other well-watered tree is to reach such a height. They are all destined for death — for the depths of the earth — among mortals who go down to the pit."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day when he went down to the grave I caused a mourning: I covered the deep for him, and I restrained the floods thereof, and the great waters were stayed: and I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.
verses.modern: "This is what the Lord GOD says: On the day it was brought down to hell I caused mourning. I covered the deep springs with darkness for it, I held back its streams, and the great waters were restrained. I made Lebanon mourn for it, and all the trees of the field withered away."

verses.kjv: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to hell with them that descend into the pit: and all the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, shall be comforted in the nether parts of the earth.
verses.modern: "I made the nations tremble at the sound of its fall when I brought it down to hell with those who go down to the pit. Then all the trees of Eden, the finest and best of Lebanon — all the trees that were well-watered — were consoled in the depths of the earth."

verses.kjv: They also went down into hell with him unto them that be slain with the sword; and they that were his arm, that dwelt under his shadow in the midst of the heathen.
verses.modern: "They too, like the great tree, had gone down to hell, to those killed by the sword — those who had lived in its shade among the heathen."

verses.kjv: To whom art thou thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? yet shalt thou be brought down with the trees of Eden unto the nether parts of the earth: thou shalt lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "Which of the trees of Eden can be compared with You in glory and greatness? Yet You too will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the depths of the earth. You will lie among the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his hordes, declares the Lord GOD."

chapters.summary: The LORD compares Pharaoh to a great cedar in Lebanon — towering above all the trees, its top among the thick branches, envied by all the trees of Eden. But because it grew proud, it was cut down and cast to the earth by the most terrible of the nations, and all who dwelt in its shade departed.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: In the twelfth year, on the first day of the twelfth month, the word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, take up a lamentation for Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say unto him, Thou art like a young lion of the nations, and thou art as a whale in the seas: and thou camest forth with thy rivers, and troubledst the waters with thy feet, and fouledst their rivers.
verses.modern: "Son of man, take up a lament concerning Pharaoh king of Egypt and say to him: You are like a lion among the nations. You are like a monster in the seas, thrashing about in your streams, churning the water with your feet and muddying the streams."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will therefore spread out my net over thee with a company of many people; and they shall bring thee up in my net.
verses.modern: "This is what the Lord GOD says: With a great throng of people I will cast My net over You, and they will haul You up in My net."

verses.kjv: Then will I leave thee upon the land, I will cast thee forth upon the open field, and will cause all the fowls of the heaven to remain upon thee, and I will fill the beasts of the whole earth with thee.
verses.modern: "I will throw You on the land and hurl You on the open field. I will let all the birds of the sky settle on You and all the wild animals gorge themselves on You."

verses.kjv: And I will lay thy flesh upon the mountains, and fill the valleys with thy height.
verses.modern: "I will spread Your flesh on the mountains and fill the valleys with Your remains."

verses.kjv: I will also water with thy blood the land wherein thou swimmest, even to the mountains; and the rivers shall be full of thee.
verses.modern: "I will drench the land with Your flowing blood all the way to the mountains, and the ravines will be filled with Your flesh."

verses.kjv: And when I shall put thee out, I will cover the heaven, and make the stars thereof dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give her light.
verses.modern: "When I snuff You out, I will cover the heavens and darken their stars. I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon will not give its light."

verses.kjv: All the bright lights of heaven will I make dark over thee, and set darkness upon thy land, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "All the shining lights in the heavens I will darken over You. I will bring darkness over Your land, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: I will also vex the hearts of many people, when I shall bring thy destruction among the nations, into the countries which thou hast not known.
verses.modern: "I will trouble the hearts of many peoples when I bring about Your destruction among the nations — among lands you have not known."

verses.kjv: Yea, I will make many people amazed at thee, and their kings shall be horribly afraid for thee, when I shall brandish my sword before them; and they shall tremble at every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of thy fall.
verses.modern: "I will cause many peoples to be appalled at You, and their kings will shudder with horror because of You when I brandish My sword before them. On the day of Your downfall each of them will tremble every moment for His own life."

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD; The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon thee.
verses.modern: "For this is what the Lord GOD says: The sword of the king of Babylon will come against you."

verses.kjv: By the swords of the mighty will I cause thy multitude to fall, the terrible of the nations, all of them: and they shall spoil the pomp of Egypt, and all the multitude thereof shall be destroyed.
verses.modern: "By the swords of the mighty I will cause Your hordes to fall — the ruthless of all nations. They will shatter the pride of Egypt, and all its hordes will be destroyed."

verses.kjv: I will destroy also all the beasts thereof from beside the great waters; neither shall the foot of man trouble them any more, nor the hoofs of beasts trouble them.
verses.modern: "I will destroy all her cattle from beside abundant waters. No human foot will trouble them anymore, nor will the hooves of cattle churn them up."

verses.kjv: Then will I make their waters deep, and cause their rivers to run like oil, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "Then I will let her waters settle and make her streams flow like oil, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: When I shall make the land of Egypt desolate, and the country shall be destitute of that whereof it was full, when I shall smite all them that dwell therein, then shall they know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "When I make Egypt desolate and strip the land of everything in it — when I strike down all who live there — then they will know that I am the LORD."

verses.kjv: This is the lamentation wherewith they shall lament her: the daughters of the nations shall lament her: they shall lament for her, even for Egypt, and for all her multitude, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "This is the lament they will chant for her. The women of the nations will chant it. They will chant it over Egypt and all her hordes, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: It came to pass also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: In the twelfth year, on the fifteenth day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, even her, and the daughters of the famous nations, unto the nether parts of the earth, with them that go down into the pit.
verses.modern: "Son of man, wail for the hordes of Egypt and consign to the earth below both her and the daughters of mighty nations, along with those who go down to the pit."

verses.kjv: Whom dost thou pass in beauty? go down, and be thou laid with the uncircumcised.
verses.modern: "Say: Are You more favored than others? Go down and be laid among the uncircumcised."

verses.kjv: They shall fall in the midst of them that are slain by the sword: she is delivered to the sword: draw her and all her multitudes.
verses.modern: "They will fall among those killed by the sword. The sword is drawn. Drag her away and all her hordes."

verses.kjv: The strong among the mighty shall speak to him out of the midst of hell with them that help him: they are gone down, they lie uncircumcised, slain by the sword.
verses.modern: "From within hell the mighty leaders will say of Egypt and her allies: 'They have come down and they lie with the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword.'"

verses.kjv: Asshur is there and all her company: his graves are about him: all of them slain, fallen by the sword:
verses.modern: "Assyria is there with her whole army. Her graves are all around her. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword."

verses.kjv: Whose graves are set in the sides of the pit, and her company is round about her grave: all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which caused terror in the land of the living.
verses.modern: "Their graves are in the depths of the pit and her army lies around her grave. All of them fell by the sword — those who had spread terror in the land of the living."

verses.kjv: There is Elam and all her multitude round about her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which are gone down uncircumcised into the nether parts of the earth, which caused their terror in the land of the living; yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit.
verses.modern: "Elam is there with all her hordes around her grave. All of them fell by the sword — uncircumcised, gone down to the depths of the earth. They had spread their terror in the land of the living, but they bear their shame with those who go down to the pit."

verses.kjv: They have set her a bed in the midst of the slain with all her multitude: her graves are round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword: though their terror was caused in the land of the living, yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit: he is put in the midst of them that be slain.
verses.modern: "A bed is made for her among the slain, with all her hordes around her grave. All of them are uncircumcised, killed by the sword. Because their terror was spread in the land of the living, they bear their shame with those who go down to the pit. She is laid among the slain."

verses.kjv: There is Meshech, Tubal, and all her multitude: her graves are round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword, though they caused their terror in the land of the living.
verses.modern: "Meshech and Tubal are there, with all their hordes around their graves. All of them are uncircumcised, killed by the sword, though they spread their terror in the land of the living."

verses.kjv: And they shall not lie with the mighty that are fallen of the uncircumcised, which are gone down to hell with their weapons of war: and they have laid their swords under their heads, but their iniquities shall be upon their bones, though they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.
verses.modern: "Do they not lie with the other uncircumcised warriors who have fallen, who went down to hell with their weapons of war, whose swords were placed under their heads? The punishment for their sins rested on their bones, though the terror of these warriors had stalked through the land of the living."

verses.kjv: Yea, thou shalt be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised, and shalt lie with them that are slain with the sword.
verses.modern: "You too, Pharaoh, will be broken and will lie among the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword."

verses.kjv: There is Edom, her kings, and all her princes, which with their might are laid by them that were slain by the sword: they shall lie with the uncircumcised, and with them that go down to the pit.
verses.modern: "Edom is there, her kings and all her princes. Despite their power, they are laid with those killed by the sword. They lie with the uncircumcised, with those who go down to the pit."

verses.kjv: There be the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Zidonians, which are gone down with the slain; with their terror they are ashamed of their might; and they lie uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword, and bear their shame with them that go down to the pit.
verses.modern: "All the princes of the north and all the Sidonians are there. They went down with the slain in disgrace despite the terror caused by their power. They lie uncircumcised with those killed by the sword and bear their shame with those who go down to the pit."

verses.kjv: Pharaoh shall see them, and shall be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army slain by the sword, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "Pharaoh — he and all his army — will see them and find comfort for all His hordes killed by the sword, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: For I have caused my terror in the land of the living: and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that are slain with the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "Although I had Him spread terror in the land of the living, Pharaoh and all his hordes will be laid among the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword, declares the Lord GOD."

chapters.summary: Ezekiel takes up a lament for Pharaoh, comparing him to a great monster in the seas. The LORD will cast His net over Egypt and leave her carcass on the open field for the birds and beasts. Egypt will descend to the pit and lie among the uncircumcised with Assyria, Elam, Meshech, Tubal, Edom, and Sidon.

verses.kjv: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, speak to the children of thy people, and say unto them, When I bring the sword upon a land, if the people of the land take a man of their coasts, and set him for their watchman:
verses.modern: "Son of man, speak to Your people and say to them: When I bring a sword against a land, and the people of the land choose one of their men and make Him their watchman —"

verses.kjv: If when he seeth the sword come upon the land, he blow the trumpet, and warn the people;
verses.modern: "and He sees the sword coming against the land and blows the trumpet to warn the people —"

verses.kjv: Then whosoever heareth the sound of the trumpet, and taketh not warning; if the sword come, and take him away, his blood shall be upon his own head.
verses.modern: "then if anyone hears the trumpet but does not take warning and the sword comes and takes His life, His blood will be on His own head."

verses.kjv: He heard the sound of the trumpet, and took not warning; his blood shall be upon him. But he that taketh warning shall deliver his soul.
verses.modern: "Since He heard the sound of the trumpet but did not take warning, His blood will be on His own head. If He had taken warning, He would have saved Himself."

verses.kjv: But if the watchman see the sword come, and blow not the trumpet, and the people be not warned; if the sword come, and take any person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at the watchman's hand.
verses.modern: "But if the watchman sees the sword coming and does not blow the trumpet to warn the people and the sword comes and takes someone's life, that person's life will be taken because of their sin, but I will hold the watchman responsible for their blood."

verses.kjv: So thou, O son of man, I have set thee a watchman unto the house of Israel; therefore thou shalt hear the word at my mouth, and warn them from me.
verses.modern: "Son of man, I have made You a watchman for the house of Israel. So hear the word I speak and give them warning from Me."

verses.kjv: When I say unto the wicked, O wicked man, thou shalt surely die; if thou dost not speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
verses.modern: "When I say to the wicked, 'You wicked person, you will surely die,' and you do not speak out to dissuade them from their ways, that wicked person will die for their sin, and I will hold you responsible for their blood."

verses.kjv: Nevertheless, if thou warn the wicked of his way to turn from it; if he do not turn from his way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.
verses.modern: "But if you do warn the wicked person to turn from their ways and they do not do so, they will die for their sin, though you yourself will have been delivered."

verses.kjv: Therefore, O thou son of man, speak unto the house of Israel; Thus ye speak, saying, If our transgressions and our sins be upon us, and we pine away in them, how should we then live?
verses.modern: "Son of man, say to the house of Israel: 'This is what you are saying: Our offenses and sins weigh us down, and we are wasting away because of them. How then can we live?'"

verses.kjv: Say unto them, As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn ye, turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die, O house of Israel?
verses.modern: "Say to them: As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I take no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but rather that they turn from their ways and live. Turn! Turn from Your evil ways! Why will You die, house of Israel?"

verses.kjv: Therefore, thou son of man, say unto the children of thy people, The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression: as for the wickedness of the wicked, he shall not fall thereby in the day that he turneth from his wickedness; neither shall the righteous be able to live for his righteousness in the day that he sinneth.
verses.modern: "Son of man, say to your people: The righteousness of the righteous will not save them when they disobey. As for the wickedness of the wicked, they will not fall by it when they turn from it. The righteous person will not be able to live by their righteousness when they sin."

verses.kjv: When I shall say to the righteous, that he shall surely live; if he trust to his own righteousness, and commit iniquity, all his righteousnesses shall not be remembered; but for his iniquity that he hath committed, he shall die for it.
verses.modern: "If I tell the righteous person that they will surely live, but then they trust in their righteousness and do evil, none of their righteous acts will be remembered. They will die for the evil they have done."

verses.kjv: Again, when I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; if he turn from his sin, and do that which is lawful and right;
verses.modern: "And if I say to the wicked, 'You will surely die,' but they then turn away from their sin and do what is just and right —"

verses.kjv: If the wicked restore the pledge, give again that he had robbed, walk in the statutes of life, without committing iniquity; he shall surely live, he shall not die.
verses.modern: "if they return what they took as a pledge for a loan, give back what they have stolen, follow the decrees that give life, and do no evil — they will surely live. They will not die."

verses.kjv: None of his sins that he hath committed shall be mentioned unto him: he hath done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.
verses.modern: "None of the sins they have committed will be counted against them. They have done what is just and right. They will surely live."

verses.kjv: Yet the children of thy people say, The way of the Lord is not equal: but as for them, their way is not equal.
verses.modern: "Yet your people say, 'The way of the Lord is not fair.' But it is their way that is not fair."

verses.kjv: When the righteous turneth from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, he shall even die thereby.
verses.modern: "If the righteous turn from their righteousness and do evil, they will die for it."

verses.kjv: But if the wicked turn from his wickedness, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall live thereby.
verses.modern: "And if the wicked turn away from their wickedness and do what is just and right, they will live by doing so."

verses.kjv: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. O ye house of Israel, I will judge you every one after his ways.
verses.modern: "Yet you say, 'The way of the Lord is not fair.' I will judge each of you according to your own ways, house of Israel."

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month, in the fifth day of the month, that one that had escaped out of Jerusalem came unto me, saying, The city is smitten.
verses.modern: In the twelfth year of our exile, on the fifth day of the tenth month, a man who had escaped from Jerusalem came to me and said, "The city has fallen!"

verses.kjv: Now the hand of the LORD was upon me in the evening, afore he that was escaped came; and had opened my mouth, until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no more dumb.
verses.modern: Now the evening before the man arrived, the hand of the LORD had been on me. He opened my mouth before the man came to me in the morning. My mouth was opened and I was silent no longer.

verses.kjv: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, they that inhabit those wastes of the land of Israel speak, saying, Abraham was one, and he inherited the land: but we are many; the land is given us for inheritance.
verses.modern: "Son of man, the people living in those ruins in the land of Israel are saying, 'Abraham was only one man, yet he possessed the land. But we are many. Surely the land has been given to us as our possession.'"

verses.kjv: Wherefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Ye eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes toward your idols, and shed blood: and shall ye possess the land?
verses.modern: "Therefore say to them: This is what the Lord GOD says: You eat meat with the blood still in it, You look to Your idols, and You shed blood. Should You then possess the land?"

verses.kjv: Ye stand upon your sword, ye work abomination, and ye defile every one his neighbour's wife: and shall ye possess the land?
verses.modern: "You rely on Your sword, You do detestable things, and each of You defiles His neighbor's wife. Should You then possess the land?"

verses.kjv: Say thou thus unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; As I live, surely they that are in the wastes shall fall by the sword, and him that is in the open field will I give to the beasts to be devoured, and they that be in the forts and in the caves shall die of the pestilence.
verses.modern: "Say this to them: This is what the Lord GOD says: As surely as I live, those in the ruins will fall by the sword, those in the open field I will give to the wild animals to be devoured, and those in strongholds and caves will die of plague."

verses.kjv: For I will lay the land most desolate, and the pomp of her strength shall cease; and the mountains of Israel shall be desolate, that none shall pass through.
verses.modern: "I will make the land a desolate waste, and her proud strength will come to an end. The mountains of Israel will become so desolate that no one will cross them."

verses.kjv: Then shall they know that I am the LORD, when I have laid the land most desolate because of all their abominations which they have committed.
verses.modern: "Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have made the land a desolate waste because of all the abominations they have committed."

verses.kjv: Also, thou son of man, the children of thy people still are talking against thee by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak one to another, every one to his brother, saying, Come, I pray you, and hear what is the word that cometh forth from the LORD.
verses.modern: "As for You, Son of man, Your people are talking together about You by the walls and at the doors of the houses. They say to one another, 'Come and hear the message that has come from the LORD.'"

verses.kjv: And they come unto thee as the people cometh, and they sit before thee as my people, and they hear thy words, but they will not do them: for with their mouth they shew much love, but their heart goeth after their covetousness.
verses.modern: "My people come to You, as they usually do, and sit before You to hear Your words, but they do not put them into practice. Their mouths speak of love, but their hearts are greedy for unjust gain."

verses.kjv: And, lo, thou art unto them as a very lovely song of one that hath a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument: for they hear thy words, but they do them not.
verses.modern: "Indeed, to them You are nothing more than one who sings love songs with a beautiful voice and plays an instrument well, for they hear Your words but do not put them into practice."

verses.kjv: And when this cometh to pass, (lo, it will come,) then shall they know that a prophet hath been among them.
verses.modern: "When all this comes true — and it surely will — then they will know that a prophet has been among them."

chapters.summary: The LORD restates Ezekiel's role as watchman for the house of Israel. He reaffirms that the righteous who turns to sin will die, and the wicked who repents will live. News arrives that Jerusalem has fallen. The LORD rebukes those still in the ruins who claim the land by right of Abraham, and He warns that the exiles listen to Ezekiel's words but do not act on them.

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel, prophesy, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD unto the shepherds; Woe be to the shepherds of Israel that do feed themselves! should not the shepherds feed the flocks?
verses.modern: "Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy and say to them: This is what the Lord GOD says to the shepherds: How terrible it will be for the shepherds of Israel who only take care of themselves! Should not shepherds take care of the flock?"

verses.kjv: Ye eat the fat, and ye clothe you with the wool, ye kill them that are fed: but ye feed not the flock.
verses.modern: "You eat the curds, clothe yourselves with the wool, and slaughter the choice animals, but You do not take care of the flock."

verses.kjv: The diseased have ye not strengthened, neither have ye healed that which was sick, neither have ye bound up that which was broken, neither have ye brought again that which was driven away, neither have ye sought that which was lost; but with force and with cruelty have ye ruled them.
verses.modern: "You have not strengthened the weak or healed the sick or bound up the injured. You have not brought back the strays or searched for the lost. You have ruled them harshly and brutally."

verses.kjv: And they were scattered, because there is no shepherd: and they became meat to all the beasts of the field, when they were scattered.
verses.modern: "So they were scattered because there was no shepherd. When they were scattered, they became food for all the wild animals."

verses.kjv: My sheep wandered through all the mountains, and upon every high hill: yea, my flock was scattered upon all the face of the earth, and none did search or seek after them.
verses.modern: "My sheep wandered over all the mountains and on every high hill. They were scattered over the whole earth, and no one searched or looked for them."

verses.kjv: Therefore, ye shepherds, hear the word of the LORD;
verses.modern: "Therefore, You shepherds, hear the word of the LORD:"

verses.kjv: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely because my flock became a prey, and my flock became meat to every beast of the field, because there was no shepherd, neither did my shepherds search for my flock, but the shepherds fed themselves, and fed not my flock;
verses.modern: "As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, because My flock lacks a shepherd and so has been plundered and has become food for all the wild animals — and because My shepherds did not search for My flock but cared for themselves rather than for My flock —"

verses.kjv: Therefore, O ye shepherds, hear the word of the LORD;
verses.modern: "therefore, You shepherds, hear the word of the LORD:"

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against the shepherds; and I will require my flock at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the flock; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; for I will deliver my flock from their mouth, that they may not be meat for them.
verses.modern: "This is what the Lord GOD says: I am against the shepherds and will hold them accountable for My flock. I will remove them from tending the flock so that the shepherds can no longer feed themselves. I will rescue My flock from their mouths, and it will no longer be food for them."

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.
verses.modern: "For this is what the Lord GOD says: I Myself will search for My sheep and look after them."

verses.kjv: As a shepherd seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered; so will I seek out my sheep, and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.
verses.modern: "As a shepherd looks after His scattered flock when He is with them, so will I look after My sheep. I will rescue them from all the places where they were scattered on a day of clouds and darkness."

verses.kjv: And I will bring them out from the people, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them to their own land, and feed them upon the mountains of Israel by the rivers, and in all the inhabited places of the country.
verses.modern: "I will bring them out from the nations and gather them from the countries, and I will bring them into their own land. I will pasture them on the mountains of Israel, in the ravines and in all the settlements in the land."

verses.kjv: I will feed them in a good pasture, and upon the high mountains of Israel shall their fold be: there shall they lie in a good fold, and in a fat pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Israel.
verses.modern: "I will tend them in good pasture, and the mountain heights of Israel will be their grazing land. There they will lie down in good grazing land, and there they will feed in rich pasture on the mountains of Israel."

verses.kjv: I will feed my flock, and I will cause them to lie down, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "I Myself will tend My sheep and have them lie down, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: I will seek that which was lost, and bring again that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but I will destroy the fat and the strong; I will feed them with judgment.
verses.modern: "I will search for the lost and bring back the strays. I will bind up the injured and strengthen the weak, but the sleek and the strong I will destroy. I will shepherd the flock with justice."

verses.kjv: And as for you, O my flock, thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I judge between cattle and cattle, between the rams and the he goats.
verses.modern: "As for You, My flock, this is what the Lord GOD says: I will judge between one sheep and another — between rams and goats."

verses.kjv: Seemeth it a small thing unto you to have eaten up the good pasture, but ye must tread down with your feet the residue of your pastures? and to have drunk of the deep waters, but ye must foul the residue with your feet?
verses.modern: "Is it not enough for You to feed on the good pasture? Must You also trample the rest of Your pasture with Your feet? Is it not enough for You to drink clear water? Must You also muddy the rest with Your feet?"

verses.kjv: And as for my flock, they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet; and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet.
verses.modern: "Must My flock feed on what You have trampled and drink what You have muddied with Your feet?"

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD unto them; Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat cattle and between the lean cattle.
verses.modern: "Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says to them: I Myself will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep."

verses.kjv: Because ye have thrust with side and with shoulder, and pushed all the diseased with your horns, till ye have scattered them abroad;
verses.modern: "Because You shove with flank and shoulder, butting all the weak sheep with Your horns until You have driven them away —"

verses.kjv: Therefore will I save my flock, and they shall no more be a prey; and I will judge between cattle and cattle.
verses.modern: "I will save My flock, and they will no longer be plundered. I will judge between one sheep and another."

verses.kjv: And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.
verses.modern: "I will place over them one shepherd, My servant David, and he will tend them. He will tend them and be their shepherd."

verses.kjv: And I the LORD will be their God, and my servant David a prince among them; I the LORD have spoken it.
verses.modern: "I the LORD will be their God, and My servant David will be prince among them. I the LORD have spoken."

verses.kjv: And I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause the evil beasts to cease out of the land: and they shall dwell safely in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods.
verses.modern: "I will make a covenant of peace with them and rid the land of savage beasts so that they may live in the desert and sleep in the forests in safety."

verses.kjv: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in his season; there shall be showers of blessing.
verses.modern: "I will make them and the places surrounding My hill a blessing. I will send down showers in season. There will be showers of blessing."

verses.kjv: And the tree of the field shall yield her fruit, and the earth shall yield her increase, and they shall be safe in their land, and shall know that I am the LORD, when I have broken the bands of their yoke, and delivered them out of the hand of those that served themselves of them.
verses.modern: "The trees of the field will yield their fruit and the ground will yield its crops. The people will be secure in their land. They will know that I am the LORD when I break the bars of their yoke and rescue them from the hands of those who enslaved them."

verses.kjv: And they shall no more be a prey to the heathen, neither shall the beast of the land devour them; but they shall dwell safely, and none shall make them afraid.
verses.modern: "They will no longer be plundered by the heathen, nor will wild animals devour them. They will live in safety, and no one will make them afraid."

verses.kjv: And I will raise up for them a plant of renown, and they shall be no more consumed with hunger in the land, neither bear the shame of the heathen any more.
verses.modern: "I will provide for them a land renowned for its crops, and they will no longer be victims of famine in the land or bear the scorn of the heathen."

verses.kjv: Then shall they know that I the LORD their God am with them, and that they, even the house of Israel, are my people, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "Then they will know that I the LORD their God am with them and that they, the house of Israel, are My people, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: And ye my flock, the flock of my pasture, are men, and I am your God, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "You My sheep, the sheep of My pasture, are people, and I am Your God, declares the Lord GOD."

chapters.summary: The LORD condemns the shepherds of Israel who feed themselves instead of the flock, leaving the sheep scattered and prey to wild beasts. He declares He Himself will search for His sheep, gather them, and feed them on the mountains of Israel. He will set one shepherd over them — His servant David — and make a covenant of peace with them.

verses.kjv: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,
verses.modern: "Son of man, set Your face against Mount Seir. Prophesy against it."

verses.kjv: And say unto it, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, O mount Seir, I am against thee, and I will stretch out mine hand against thee, and I will make thee most desolate.
verses.modern: "Say to it: This is what the Lord GOD says: I am against You, Mount Seir. I will stretch out My hand against You and make You a desolate waste."

verses.kjv: I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate, and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "I will turn Your towns into ruins and You will be desolate. Then You will know that I am the LORD."

verses.kjv: Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time that their iniquity had an end:
verses.modern: "Because You harbored an ancient hostility and delivered the Israelites over to the sword at the time of their calamity, the time their punishment reached its climax —"

verses.kjv: Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee.
verses.modern: "therefore, as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will give You over to bloodshed and it will pursue You. Since You did not hate bloodshed, bloodshed will pursue You."

verses.kjv: Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate, and cut off from it him that passeth by and him that returneth.
verses.modern: "I will make Mount Seir a desolate waste and cut off from it all who come and go."

verses.kjv: And I will fill his mountains with his slain men: in thy hills, and in thy valleys, and in all thy rivers, shall they fall that are slain with the sword.
verses.modern: "I will fill Your mountains with the slain. Those killed by the sword will fall on Your hills, in Your valleys, and in all Your ravines."

verses.kjv: I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "I will make You desolate forever and Your towns will not be inhabited. Then You will know that I am the LORD."

verses.kjv: Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas the LORD was there:
verses.modern: "Because You said, 'These two nations and countries will be ours and we will take possession of them' — even though I the LORD was there —"

verses.kjv: Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will even do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I have judged thee.
verses.modern: "therefore, as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will treat You in accordance with the anger and jealousy You showed in Your hatred of them. I will make Myself known among them when I judge You."

verses.kjv: And thou shalt know that I am the LORD, and that I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume.
verses.modern: "Then You will know that I the LORD have heard all the contemptible things You have said against the mountains of Israel. You said, 'They have been laid waste and have been given over to us to devour.'"

verses.kjv: Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard them.
verses.modern: "You boasted against Me and spoke against Me without restraint. I heard it."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.
verses.modern: "This is what the Lord GOD says: While the whole earth rejoices, I will make You desolate."

verses.kjv: As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea, even all of it: and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "Because You rejoiced when the inheritance of the house of Israel was made desolate, that is how I will treat You. You will be desolate, Mount Seir, You and all of Edom. Then they will know that I am the LORD."

chapters.summary: The LORD pronounces judgment against Mount Seir — Edom — because of her perpetual hatred against Israel and her desire to possess both nations' lands. Because she rejoiced when Israel's inheritance was desolate, the LORD will make her a perpetual desolation.

verses.kjv: Also, thou son of man, prophesy unto the mountains of Israel, and say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD:
verses.modern: "Son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel and say: Mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because the enemy hath said against you, Aha, even the ancient high places are ours in possession:
verses.modern: "This is what the Lord GOD says: The enemy said of you, 'Aha! The ancient heights have become our possession.'"

verses.kjv: Therefore prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that ye might be a possession unto the residue of the heathen, and ye are taken up in the lips of talkers, and are an infamy of the people:
verses.modern: "Therefore prophesy and say: This is what the Lord GOD says: Because they ravaged and hounded You from every side so that You became the possession of the rest of the heathen and the object of people's gossip and slander —"

verses.kjv: Therefore, ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes, and to the cities that are forsaken, which became a prey and derision to the residue of the heathen that are round about;
verses.modern: "therefore, mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD. This is what the Lord GOD says to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys, to the desolate ruins and the deserted towns that have been plundered and ridiculed by the rest of the heathen around you —"

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea, which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart, with despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey.
verses.modern: "this is what the Lord GOD says: In My burning zeal I have spoken against the rest of the heathen, and against all Edom, for with wholehearted joy and spiteful minds they took My land as their possession so that they might plunder its pastureland."

verses.kjv: Prophesy therefore concerning the land of Israel, and say unto the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my fury, because ye have borne the shame of the heathen:
verses.modern: "Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel and say to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys: This is what the Lord GOD says: I speak in My jealous wrath because You have suffered the scorn of the heathen."

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I have lifted up mine hand, Surely the heathen that are about you, they shall bear their shame.
verses.modern: "Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I swear with uplifted hand that the heathen around you will also suffer scorn."

verses.kjv: But ye, O mountains of Israel, ye shall shoot forth your branches, and yield your fruit to my people of Israel; for they are at hand to come.
verses.modern: "But You, mountains of Israel, will produce branches and fruit for My people Israel, for they will soon come home."

verses.kjv: For, behold, I am for you, and I will turn unto you, and ye shall be tilled and sown:
verses.modern: "I am concerned for You and will look on You with favor. You will be plowed and sown."

verses.kjv: And I will multiply men upon you, all the house of Israel, even all of it: and the cities shall be inhabited, and the wastes shall be builded:
verses.modern: "I will multiply the number of people on You — even the whole house of Israel. The towns will be inhabited and the ruins rebuilt."

verses.kjv: And I will multiply upon you man and beast; and they shall increase and bring fruit: and I will settle you after your old estates, and will do better unto you than at your beginnings: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "I will increase the number of people and animals living on You, and they will be fruitful and become numerous. I will settle people on You as in the past and will make You prosper more than before. Then You will know that I am the LORD."

verses.kjv: Yea, I will cause men to walk upon you, even my people Israel; and they shall possess thee, and thou shalt be their inheritance, and thou shalt no more henceforth bereave them of men.
verses.modern: "I will cause people — My people Israel — to live on You. They will possess You, and You will be their inheritance. You will never again deprive them of their children."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because they say unto you, Thou land devourest up men, and hast bereaved thy nations;
verses.modern: "This is what the Lord GOD says: Because people say to You, 'You devour men and bereave Your nation of its children' —"

verses.kjv: Therefore thou shalt devour men no more, neither bereave thy nations any more, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "therefore You will no longer devour men or make Your nation childless, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: Neither will I cause men to hear in thee the shame of the heathen any more, neither shalt thou bear the reproach of the people any more, neither shalt thou cause thy nations to fall any more, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "No longer will I make You hear the taunts of the heathen. No longer will you suffer the scorn of the peoples or cause Your nation to fall, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to me:

verses.kjv: Son of man, when the house of Israel dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their own way and by their doings: their way was before me as the uncleanness of a removed woman.
verses.modern: "Son of man, when the house of Israel was living in their own land, they defiled it by their conduct and their actions. Their conduct was like a woman's monthly uncleanness in My sight."

verses.kjv: Wherefore I poured my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land, and for their idols wherewith they had polluted it:
verses.modern: "So I poured out My wrath on them because they had shed blood in the land and because they had defiled it with their idols."

verses.kjv: And I scattered them among the heathen, and they were dispersed through the countries: according to their way and according to their doings I judged them.
verses.modern: "I dispersed them among the heathen, and they were scattered through the countries. I judged them according to their conduct and their actions."

verses.kjv: And when they entered unto the heathen, whither they went, they profaned my holy name, when they said to them, These are the people of the LORD, and are gone forth out of his land.
verses.modern: "And wherever they went among the heathen they profaned My holy name, for it was said of them, 'These are the LORD's people, and yet they had to leave His land.'"

verses.kjv: But I had pity for mine holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the heathen, whither they went.
verses.modern: "I had concern for My holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the heathen where they had gone."

verses.kjv: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I do not this for your sakes, O house of Israel, but for mine holy name's sake, which ye have profaned among the heathen, whither ye went.
verses.modern: "Therefore say to the house of Israel: This is what the Lord GOD says: It is not for Your sake, house of Israel, that I am going to do these things, but for the sake of My holy name, which You have profaned among the heathen where you have gone."

verses.kjv: And I will sanctify my great name, which was profaned among the heathen, which ye have profaned in the midst of them; and the heathen shall know that I am the LORD, saith the Lord GOD, when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes.
verses.modern: "I will show the holiness of My great name, which has been profaned among the heathen — the name you have profaned among them. Then the heathen will know that I am the LORD, declares the Lord GOD, when I am proved holy through You before their eyes."

verses.kjv: For I will take you from among the heathen, and gather you out of all countries, and will bring you into your own land.
verses.modern: "For I will take You out of the heathen. I will gather you from all the countries and bring You back into Your own land."

verses.kjv: Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.
verses.modern: "I will sprinkle clean water on You, and You will be clean. I will cleanse You from all Your impurities and from all Your idols."

verses.kjv: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.
verses.modern: "I will give You a new heart and put a new spirit in You. I will remove from You Your heart of stone and give You a heart of flesh."

verses.kjv: And I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and ye shall keep my judgments, and do them.
verses.modern: "And I will put My Spirit in You and move You to follow My decrees and be careful to keep My laws."

verses.kjv: And ye shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; and ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.
verses.modern: "Then You will live in the land I gave Your ancestors. You will be My people, and I will be Your God."

verses.kjv: I will also save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the corn, and will increase it, and lay no famine upon you.
verses.modern: "I will save You from all Your uncleanness. I will call for the grain and make it plentiful and will not bring famine on You."

verses.kjv: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that ye shall receive no more reproach of famine among the heathen.
verses.modern: "I will increase the fruit of the trees and the crops of the field, so that You will no longer suffer disgrace among the heathen because of famine."

verses.kjv: Then shall ye remember your own evil ways, and your doings that were not good, and shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.
verses.modern: "Then You will remember Your evil ways and wicked deeds, and You will despise yourselves for Your sins and detestable practices."

verses.kjv: Not for your sakes do I this, saith the Lord GOD, be it known unto you: be ashamed and confounded for your own ways, O house of Israel.
verses.modern: "I want You to know that I am not doing this for Your sake, declares the Lord GOD. Be ashamed and disgraced for Your conduct, house of Israel!"

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day that I shall have cleansed you from all your iniquities I will also cause you to dwell in the cities, and the wastes shall be builded.
verses.modern: "This is what the Lord GOD says: On the day I cleanse You from all Your sins, I will resettle Your towns, and the ruins will be rebuilt."

verses.kjv: And the desolate land shall be tilled, whereas it lay desolate in the sight of all that passed by.
verses.modern: "The desolate land will be cultivated instead of lying desolate in the sight of all who pass through it."

verses.kjv: And they shall say, This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities are become fenced, and are inhabited.
verses.modern: "They will say, 'This land that was laid waste has become like the garden of Eden. The cities that were lying in ruins, desolate and destroyed, are now fortified and inhabited.'"

verses.kjv: Then the heathen that are left round about you shall know that I the LORD build the ruined places, and plant that that was desolate: I the LORD have spoken it, and I will do it.
verses.modern: "Then the heathen around you that remain will know that I the LORD have rebuilt what was destroyed and replanted what was desolate. I the LORD have spoken, and I will do it."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will yet for this be enquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them; I will increase them with men like a flock.
verses.modern: "This is what the Lord GOD says: Once again I will let the house of Israel ask Me to do this for them. I will increase their numbers like a flock."

verses.kjv: As the holy flock, as the flock of Jerusalem in her solemn feasts; so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men: and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "Like flocks of sheep for offerings, like the flocks at Jerusalem during her appointed festivals, so will the ruined cities be filled with flocks of people. Then they will know that I am the LORD."

chapters.summary: The LORD promises to restore the mountains of Israel, not for Israel's sake but for His holy name which they profaned among the nations. He will sprinkle clean water on them, give them a new heart and a new spirit, put His Spirit within them, and cause them to walk in His statutes.

verses.kjv: The hand of the LORD was upon me, and carried me out in the spirit of the LORD, and set me down in the midst of the valley which was full of bones,
verses.modern: The hand of the LORD was on me, and He brought me out by the Spirit of the LORD and set me in the middle of a valley. It was full of bones.

verses.kjv: And caused me to pass by them round about: and, behold, there were very many in the open valley; and, lo, they were very dry.
verses.modern: He led me back and forth among them, and I saw a great many bones on the floor of the valley. The bones were very dry.

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord GOD, thou knowest.
verses.modern: He asked me, "Son of man, can these bones live?" I said, "Sovereign Lord GOD, You alone know."

verses.kjv: Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.
verses.modern: Then He said to me, "Prophesy to these bones and say to them, 'Dry bones, hear the word of the LORD!'"

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD unto these bones; Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live:
verses.modern: "This is what the Lord GOD says to these bones: I will make breath enter You, and You will come to life."

verses.kjv: And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and ye shall live; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: "I will attach tendons to You and make flesh come on You and cover You with skin. I will put breath in You, and You will come to life. Then You will know that I am the LORD."

verses.kjv: So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold a shaking, and the bones came together, bone to his bone.
verses.modern: So I prophesied as I was commanded. As I was prophesying, there was a noise, a rattling sound, and the bones came together, bone to bone.

verses.kjv: And when I beheld, lo, the sinews and the flesh came up upon them, and the skin covered them above: but there was no breath in them.
