verses.modern: "The best of all the firstfruits and all Your special gifts will belong to the priests. You are to give them the first portion of Your ground meal so that a blessing may rest on Your household."

verses.kjv: The priests shall not eat of any thing that is dead of itself, or torn, whether it be fowl or beast.
verses.modern: "The priests must not eat anything, bird or animal, found dead or torn by wild animals."

chapters.summary: The east gate of the sanctuary is to remain shut because the LORD has entered through it; only the prince may sit in it to eat bread before the LORD. The Levites who went astray will serve in the temple but not approach the altar; only the sons of Zadok, who remained faithful, will minister before the LORD.

verses.kjv: Moreover, when ye shall divide by lot the land for inheritance, ye shall offer an oblation unto the LORD, an holy portion of the land: the length shall be the length of five and twenty thousand reeds, and the breadth shall be ten thousand. This shall be holy in all the borders thereof round about.
verses.modern: "When You divide the land by lot for an inheritance, you are to present to the LORD a portion of the land as a sacred district — twenty-five thousand cubits long and twenty thousand cubits wide. The entire area will be holy."

verses.kjv: Of this there shall be for the sanctuary five hundred in length, with five hundred in breadth, square round about; and fifty cubits round about for the suburbs thereof.
verses.modern: "Of this, a section five hundred cubits square is to be for the sanctuary, with fifty cubits of open land around it."

verses.kjv: And of this measure shalt thou measure the length of five and twenty thousand, and the breadth of ten thousand: and in it shall be the sanctuary and the most holy place.
verses.modern: "In the sacred district, measure off a section twenty-five thousand cubits long and ten thousand cubits wide. In it will be the sanctuary — the Most Holy Place."

verses.kjv: The holy portion of the land shall be for the priests the ministers of the sanctuary, which shall come near to minister unto the LORD: and it shall be a place for their houses, and an holy place for the sanctuary.
verses.modern: "It will be the sacred portion of the land for the priests, who minister in the sanctuary and who draw near to minister before the LORD. It will be a place for their houses as well as a holy place for the sanctuary."

verses.kjv: And the five and twenty thousand of length, and the ten thousand of breadth shall also the Levites, the ministers of the house, have for themselves, for a possession for twenty chambers.
verses.modern: "An area twenty-five thousand cubits long and ten thousand cubits wide will belong to the Levites, who serve in the temple, as their possession for towns to live in."

verses.kjv: And ye shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand broad, and five and twenty thousand long, over against the oblation of the holy portion: it shall be for the whole house of Israel.
verses.modern: "You are to give the city as its property an area five thousand cubits wide and twenty-five thousand cubits long, adjoining the sacred portion. It will belong to all the house of Israel."

verses.kjv: And a portion shall be for the prince on the one side and on the other side of the oblation of the holy portion, and of the possession of the city, before the oblation of the holy portion, and before the possession of the city, from the west side westward, and from the east side eastward: and the length shall be over against one of the portions, from the west border unto the east border.
verses.modern: "The prince will have the land bordering each side of the area formed by the sacred district and the city property. It will extend westward from the west side and eastward from the east side, running lengthwise from the western to the eastern border."

verses.kjv: In the land shall be his possession in Israel: and my princes shall no more oppress my people; and the rest of the land shall they give to the house of Israel according to their tribes.
verses.modern: "This land will be his possession in Israel. And My princes will no longer oppress My people but will allow the house of Israel to possess the land according to their tribes."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Let it suffice you, O princes of Israel: remove violence and spoil, and execute judgment and justice, take away your exactions from my people, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "This is what the Lord GOD says: You have gone far enough, princes of Israel! Give up Your violence and oppression and do what is just and right. Stop dispossessing My people, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: Ye shall have just balances, and a just ephah, and a just bath.
verses.modern: "You are to use accurate scales, an accurate ephah, and an accurate bath."

verses.kjv: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain the tenth part of an homer, and the ephah the tenth part of an homer: the measure thereof shall be after the homer.
verses.modern: "The ephah and the bath are to be the same size, the bath containing a tenth of a homer and the ephah a tenth of a homer. The homer is to be the standard measure for both."

verses.kjv: And the shekel shall be twenty gerahs: twenty shekels, five and twenty shekels, fifteen shekels, shall be your maneh.
verses.modern: "The shekel is to consist of twenty gerahs. Twenty shekels plus twenty-five shekels plus fifteen shekels equal one mina."

verses.kjv: This is the oblation that ye shall offer; the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of wheat, and ye shall give the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of barley:
verses.modern: "This is the special gift You are to offer: a sixth of an ephah from each homer of wheat and a sixth of an ephah from each homer of barley."

verses.kjv: Concerning the ordinance of oil, the bath of oil, ye shall offer the tenth part of a bath out of the cor, which is an homer of ten baths; for ten baths are an homer:
verses.modern: "The prescribed portion of olive oil, measured by the bath, is a tenth of a bath from each cor, which consists of ten baths or one homer — for ten baths are equivalent to a homer."

verses.kjv: And one lamb out of the flock, out of two hundred, out of the fat pastures of Israel; for a meat offering, and for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make reconciliation for them, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "Also one sheep is to be taken from every flock of two hundred from the well-watered pastures of Israel. These will be used for the grain offerings, burnt offerings, and fellowship offerings to make atonement for the people, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: All the people of the land shall give this oblation for the prince in Israel.
verses.modern: "All the people of the land will be required to give this special gift to the prince in Israel."

verses.kjv: And it shall be the prince's part to give burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and drink offerings, in the feasts, and in the new moons, and in the sabbaths, in all solemnities of the house of Israel: he shall prepare the sin offering, and the meat offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make reconciliation for the house of Israel.
verses.modern: "It will be the duty of the prince to provide the burnt offerings, grain offerings, and drink offerings at the festivals, the New Moons, and the Sabbaths — at all the appointed festivals of the house of Israel. He will provide the sin offerings, grain offerings, burnt offerings, and fellowship offerings to make atonement for the house of Israel."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the first month, in the first day of the month, thou shalt take a young bullock without blemish, and cleanse the sanctuary:
verses.modern: "This is what the Lord GOD says: In the first month on the first day You are to take a young bull without defect and purify the sanctuary."

verses.kjv: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering, and put it upon the posts of the house, and upon the four corners of the settle of the altar, and upon the posts of the gate of the inner court.
verses.modern: "The priest is to take some of the blood of the sin offering and put it on the doorposts of the temple, on the four corners of the upper ledge of the altar, and on the gateposts of the inner court."

verses.kjv: And so thou shalt do the seventh day of the month for every one that erreth, and for him that is simple: so shall ye reconcile the house.
verses.modern: "You are to do the same on the seventh day of the month for anyone who sins unintentionally or through ignorance. So you are to make atonement for the temple."

verses.kjv: In the first month, in the fourteenth day of the month, ye shall have the passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.
verses.modern: "In the first month on the fourteenth day you are to observe the Passover. For seven days the bread eaten is to be without yeast."

verses.kjv: And upon that day shall the prince prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bullock for a sin offering.
verses.modern: "On that day the prince is to provide a bull as a sin offering for himself and for all the people of the land."

verses.kjv: And seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to the LORD, seven bullocks and seven rams without blemish daily the seven days; and a kid of the goats daily for a sin offering.
verses.modern: "Every day during the seven days of the festival He is to provide seven bulls and seven rams without defect as a burnt offering to the LORD, and a male goat as a sin offering each day."

verses.kjv: And he shall prepare a meat offering of an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and an hin of oil for an ephah.
verses.modern: "He is to provide as a grain offering an ephah for each bull and an ephah for each ram, along with a hin of oil for each ephah."

verses.kjv: In the seventh month, in the fifteenth day of the month, shall he do the like in the feast of the seven days, according to the sin offering, according to the burnt offering, and according to the meat offering, and according to the oil.
verses.modern: "During the seven days of the festival, which begins in the seventh month on the fifteenth day, He is to make the same provision for sin offerings, burnt offerings, grain offerings, and oil."

chapters.summary: The LORD designates a holy portion of the land for the sanctuary, the priests, the Levites, and the city. The prince is given his own land on either side and is charged to use just balances, weights, and measures. Regulations for the prince's offerings at Passover and the feast of tabernacles are established.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; The gate of the inner court that looketh toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the sabbath it shall be opened, and in the day of the new moon it shall be opened.
verses.modern: "This is what the Lord GOD says: The gate of the inner court facing east is to be shut on the six working days, but on the Sabbath day and on the day of the New Moon it is to be opened."

verses.kjv: And the prince shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate without, and shall stand by the post of the gate, and the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate: then he shall go out; but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.
verses.modern: "The prince is to enter from the outside through the portico of the gateway and stand by the gatepost. The priests are to sacrifice his burnt offering and his fellowship offerings. He is to worship at the threshold of the gateway and then go out, but the gate will not be shut until evening."

verses.kjv: Likewise the people of the land shall worship at the door of this gate before the LORD in the sabbaths and in the new moons.
verses.modern: "On the Sabbaths and New Moons the people of the land are to worship in the presence of the LORD at the entrance of that gateway."

verses.kjv: And the burnt offering that the prince shall offer unto the LORD in the sabbath day shall be six lambs without blemish, and a ram without blemish.
verses.modern: "The burnt offering the prince brings to the LORD on the Sabbath day is to be six male lambs and a ram, all without defect."

verses.kjv: And the meat offering shall be an ephah for a ram, and the meat offering for the lambs as he shall be able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.
verses.modern: "The grain offering given with the ram is to be an ephah, and the grain offering with the lambs is to be as much as He wants to give, along with a hin of oil for each ephah."

verses.kjv: And in the day of the new moon it shall be a young bullock without blemish, and six lambs, and a ram: they shall be without blemish.
verses.modern: "On the day of the New Moon He is to offer a young bull, six lambs, and a ram, all without defect."

verses.kjv: And he shall prepare a meat offering, an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs according as his hand shall attain unto, and an hin of oil to an ephah.
verses.modern: "He is to provide as a grain offering one ephah with the bull, one ephah with the ram, and with the lambs as much as He wants to give, along with a hin of oil for each ephah."

verses.kjv: And when the prince shall enter, he shall go in by the way of the porch of that gate, and he shall go forth by the way thereof.
verses.modern: "When the prince enters, he is to go in through the portico of the gateway, and he is to go out the same way."

verses.kjv: But when the people of the land shall come before the LORD in the solemn feasts, he that entereth in by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate; and he that entereth by the way of the south gate shall go forth by the way of the north gate: he shall not return by the way of the gate whereby he came in, but shall go forth over against it.
verses.modern: "When the people of the land come before the LORD at the appointed festivals, whoever enters by the north gate to worship is to go out by the south gate, and whoever enters by the south gate is to go out by the north gate. No one is to return through the gate by which he entered, but each is to go out through the opposite gate."

verses.kjv: And the prince in the midst of them, when they go in, shall go in; and when they go forth, shall go forth.
verses.modern: "The prince is to be among them, going in when they go in and going out when they go out."

verses.kjv: And in the feasts and in the solemnities the meat offering shall be an ephah to a bullock, and an ephah to a ram, and to the lambs as he is able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.
verses.modern: "At the festivals and the appointed feasts, the grain offering is to be an ephah with a bull, an ephah with a ram, and with the lambs as much as he wants to give, along with a hin of oil for each ephah."

verses.kjv: Now when the prince shall prepare a voluntary burnt offering or peace offerings voluntarily unto the LORD, one shall then open him the gate that looketh toward the east, and he shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, as he did on the sabbath day: then he shall go out; and after his going out, one shall shut the gate.
verses.modern: "When the prince provides a freewill offering — whether a burnt offering or fellowship offerings — as a freewill offering to the LORD, the east gate is to be opened for Him. He is to offer His burnt offering or His fellowship offerings as He does on the Sabbath day. Then He shall go out, and after He has gone out, the gate will be shut."

verses.kjv: Thou shalt daily prepare a burnt offering unto the LORD of a lamb of the first year without blemish: thou shalt prepare it every morning.
verses.modern: "Every day You are to provide a year-old lamb without defect for a burnt offering to the LORD. You are to do this every morning."

verses.kjv: And thou shalt prepare a meat offering for it every morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of an hin of oil, to temper with the fine flour; a meat offering continually by a perpetual ordinance unto the LORD.
verses.modern: "You are also to provide a grain offering with it every morning — a sixth of an ephah with a third of a hin of oil to moisten the flour. The grain offering to the LORD is a lasting ordinance."

verses.kjv: Thus shall they prepare the lamb, and the meat offering, and the oil, every morning for a continual burnt offering.
verses.modern: "So the lamb, the grain offering, and the oil shall be provided every morning as a regular burnt offering."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; If the prince give a gift unto any of his sons, the inheritance thereof shall be his sons'; it shall be their possession by inheritance.
verses.modern: "This is what the Lord GOD says: If the prince makes a gift from his inheritance to one of His sons, it will also belong to His descendants. It is to be their property by inheritance."

verses.kjv: But if he give a gift of his inheritance to one of his servants, then it shall be his to the year of liberty; after it shall return to the prince: but his inheritance shall be his sons' for them.
verses.modern: "If, however, he makes a gift from his inheritance to one of his servants, the servant may keep it until the year of freedom. At that time it will revert to the prince. His inheritance belongs to his sons only; it shall be theirs."

verses.kjv: Moreover the prince shall not take of the people's inheritance by oppression, to thrust them out of their possession; but he shall give his sons inheritance out of his own possession: that my people be not scattered every man from his possession.
verses.modern: "The prince must not take any of the inheritance of the people, driving them off their property. He is to give his sons their inheritance out of his own property, so that none of My people will be separated from his property."

verses.kjv: After he brought me through the entry, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy chambers of the priests, which looked toward the north: and, behold, there was a place on the two sides westward.
verses.modern: Then the man brought me through the entrance at the side of the gate to the sacred rooms facing north, which belonged to the priests. And I saw a place at the far end on the west side.

verses.kjv: Then said he unto me, This is the place where the priests shall boil the trespass offering and the sin offering, where they shall bake the meat offering; that they bear them not out into the utter court, to sanctify the people.
verses.modern: He said to me, "This is the place where the priests will cook the guilt offering and the sin offering and bake the grain offering, to avoid bringing them into the outer court and consecrating the people there."

verses.kjv: Then he brought me forth into the utter court, and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and, behold, in every corner of the court there was a court.
verses.modern: He then brought me out into the outer court and led me around to its four corners. In each corner of the outer court was another court —

verses.kjv: In the four corners of the court there were courts joined of forty cubits long and thirty broad: these four corners were of one measure.
verses.modern: enclosed courts forty cubits long and thirty cubits wide — all four of them were the same size.

verses.kjv: And there was a row of building round about in them, round about them four, and it was made with boiling places under the rows round about.
verses.modern: Around the inside of each of the four courts was a ledge of stonework, with cooking places built below the ledge all around the inside.

verses.kjv: Then said he unto me, These are the places of them that boil, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.
verses.modern: He said to me, "These are the kitchens where those who minister at the temple are to cook the sacrifices of the people."

chapters.summary: Regulations are given for the prince's worship at the east gate on the Sabbath and New Moon, and for the people's movement through the gates during the appointed feasts. The prince may give portions of his inheritance to his sons permanently but only lend to his servants. Ezekiel is shown the kitchens where the priests and ministers will boil the offerings.

verses.kjv: Afterward he brought me again unto the door of the house; and, behold, waters issued out from under the threshold of the house eastward: for the forefront of the house stood toward the east, and the waters came down from under from the right side of the house, at the south side of the altar.
verses.modern: The man brought me back to the entrance of the temple, and I saw water flowing from under the threshold of the temple toward the east, for the temple faced east. The water was coming down from under the south side of the temple, south of the altar.

verses.kjv: Then brought he me out of the way of the gate northward, and led me about the way without unto the utter gate by the way that looketh eastward; and, behold, there ran out waters on the right side.
verses.modern: Then he brought me out through the north gate and led me around the outside to the outer gate facing east, and the water was trickling from the south side.

verses.kjv: And when the man that had the line in his hand went forth eastward, he measured a thousand cubits, and he brought me through the waters; the waters were to the ankles.
verses.modern: As the man went eastward with a measuring line in his hand, he measured off a thousand cubits and then led me through water that was ankle-deep.

verses.kjv: Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through the waters; the waters were to the knees. Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through; the waters were to the loins.
verses.modern: He measured off another thousand cubits and led me through water that was knee-deep. He measured off another thousand and led me through water that was up to the waist.

verses.kjv: Afterward he measured a thousand; and it was a river that I could not pass over: for the waters were risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be passed over.
verses.modern: He measured off another thousand, but now it was a river that I could not cross, because the water had risen and was deep enough to swim in — a river that no one could cross.

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen this? Then he brought me, and caused me to return to the brink of the river.
verses.modern: He asked me, "Son of man, do you see this?" Then he led me back to the bank of the river.

verses.kjv: Now when I had returned, behold, at the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.
verses.modern: When I arrived back at the bank, I saw a great number of trees on each side of the river.

verses.kjv: Then said he unto me, These waters issue out toward the east country, and go down into the desert, and go into the sea: which being brought forth into the sea, the waters shall be healed.
verses.modern: He said to me, "This water flows toward the eastern region and goes down into the Arabah, where it enters the Dead Sea. When it empties into the sea, the salty water there becomes fresh."

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that every thing that liveth, which moveth, whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish, because these waters shall come thither: for they shall be healed; and every thing shall live whither the river cometh.
verses.modern: "Everything that lives and moves, wherever the rivers come, will live. There will be a very great number of fish, because these waters flow there and the waters will be healed. Everything will live wherever the river comes."

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that the fishers shall stand upon it from Engedi even unto Eneglaim; they shall be a place to spread forth nets; their fish shall be according to their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceeding many.
verses.modern: "Fishermen will stand along the shore. From En Gedi to En Eglaim there will be places for spreading nets. The fish will be of many kinds — like the fish of the Mediterranean Sea."

verses.kjv: But the miry places thereof and the marishes thereof shall not be healed; they shall be given to salt.
verses.modern: "But the swamps and marshes will not become fresh. They will be left for salt."

verses.kjv: And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.
verses.modern: "Fruit trees of all kinds will grow on both banks of the river. Their leaves will not wither, nor will their fruit fail. Every month they will bear fruit, because the water from the sanctuary flows to them. Their fruit will serve for food and their leaves for healing."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; This shall be the border, whereby ye shall inherit the land according to the twelve tribes of Israel: Joseph shall have two portions.
verses.modern: "This is what the Lord GOD says: These are the boundaries by which You are to divide the land for an inheritance among the twelve tribes of Israel, with two portions for Joseph."

verses.kjv: And ye shall inherit it, one as well as another: concerning the which I lifted up mine hand to give it unto your fathers: and this land shall fall unto you for inheritance.
verses.modern: "You are to divide it equally among them. Because I swore with uplifted hand to give it to Your ancestors, this land will become Your inheritance."

verses.kjv: And this shall be the border of the land toward the north side, from the great sea, the way of Hethlon, as men go to Zedad;
verses.modern: "This is to be the boundary of the land: On the north side it will run from the Mediterranean Sea by the Hethlon road past Lebo Hamath to Zedad —"

verses.kjv: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath; Hazarhatticon, which is by the coast of Hauran.
verses.modern: "Berothah and Sibraim, which lie on the border between Damascus and Hamath, to Hazer Hatticon, which is on the border of Hauran."

verses.kjv: And the border from the sea shall be Hazarenan, the border of Damascus, and the north northward, and the border of Hamath. And this is the north side.
verses.modern: "The boundary will extend from the sea to Hazar Enan, along the northern border of Damascus, with the border of Hamath to the north. This will be the northern boundary."

verses.kjv: And the east side ye shall measure from Hauran, and from Damascus, and from Gilead, and from the land of Israel by Jordan, from the border unto the east sea. And this is the east side.
verses.modern: "On the east side the boundary will run between Hauran and Damascus, along the Jordan between Gilead and the land of Israel, to the eastern sea and as far as Tamar. This will be the eastern boundary."

verses.kjv: And the south side southward, from Tamar even to the waters of strife in Kadesh, the river to the great sea. And this is the south side southward.
verses.modern: "On the south side it will run from Tamar to the waters of Meribah Kadesh, then along the Wadi of Egypt to the Mediterranean Sea. This will be the southern boundary."

verses.kjv: The west side also shall be the great sea from the border, till a man come over against Hamath. This is the west side.
verses.modern: "On the west side, the Mediterranean Sea will be the boundary to a point opposite Lebo Hamath. This will be the western boundary."

verses.kjv: So shall ye divide this land unto you according to the tribes of Israel.
verses.modern: "You are to distribute this land among yourselves according to the tribes of Israel."

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that ye shall divide it by lot for an inheritance unto you, and to the strangers that sojourn among you, which shall beget children among you: and they shall be unto you as born in the country among the children of Israel; they shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.
verses.modern: "You are to allot it as an inheritance for yourselves and for the foreigners residing among You and who have children. You are to consider them as native-born Israelites. Along with You they are to be allotted an inheritance among the tribes of Israel."

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that in what tribe the stranger sojourneth, there shall ye give him his inheritance, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "In whatever tribe a foreigner resides, there You are to give them their inheritance, declares the Lord GOD."

chapters.summary: Ezekiel sees water flowing from under the threshold of the temple toward the east, growing from ankle-deep to knee-deep to a river that cannot be crossed. Wherever the river flows, everything will live — even the Dead Sea will be healed and filled with fish. The boundaries of the restored land are set for the twelve tribes, and strangers who dwell among them will receive an inheritance.

verses.kjv: Now these are the names of the tribes. From the north end to the coast of the way of Hethlon, as one goeth to Hamath, Hazarenan, the border of Damascus northward, to the coast of Hamath; for these are his sides east and west; a portion for Dan.
verses.modern: These are the tribes, listed by name: At the northern end, Dan will have one portion. It will follow the Hethlon road to Lebo Hamath — Hazar Enan and the northern border of Damascus next to Hamath, extending from east to west.

verses.kjv: And by the border of Dan, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Asher.
verses.modern: Adjoining the territory of Dan from east to west will be a portion for Asher.

verses.kjv: And by the border of Asher, from the east side even unto the west side, a portion for Naphtali.
verses.modern: Adjoining the territory of Asher from east to west will be a portion for Naphtali.

verses.kjv: And by the border of Naphtali, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Manasseh.
verses.modern: Adjoining the territory of Naphtali from east to west will be a portion for Manasseh.

verses.kjv: And by the border of Manasseh, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Ephraim.
verses.modern: Adjoining the territory of Manasseh from east to west will be a portion for Ephraim.

verses.kjv: And by the border of Ephraim, from the east side even unto the west side, a portion for Reuben.
verses.modern: Adjoining the territory of Ephraim from east to west will be a portion for Reuben.

verses.kjv: And by the border of Reuben, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Judah.
verses.modern: Adjoining the territory of Reuben from east to west will be a portion for Judah.

verses.kjv: And by the border of Judah, from the east side unto the west side, shall be the offering which ye shall offer of five and twenty thousand reeds in breadth, and in length as one of the other parts, from the east side unto the west side: and the sanctuary shall be in the midst of it.
verses.modern: "Adjoining the territory of Judah from east to west will be the special gift you are to present — twenty-five thousand cubits wide and as long as any of the tribal portions from east to west — with the sanctuary in the center."

verses.kjv: The oblation that ye shall offer unto the LORD shall be of five and twenty thousand in length, and of ten thousand in breadth.
verses.modern: "The special portion You offer to the LORD will be twenty-five thousand cubits long and ten thousand cubits wide."

verses.kjv: And for them, even for the priests, shall be this holy oblation; toward the north five and twenty thousand in length, and toward the west ten thousand in breadth, and toward the east ten thousand in breadth, and toward the south five and twenty thousand in length: and the sanctuary of the LORD shall be in the midst thereof.
verses.modern: "This will be the sacred portion for the priests. It will be twenty-five thousand cubits on the north side, ten thousand cubits wide on the west side, ten thousand cubits wide on the east side, and twenty-five thousand cubits on the south side. The LORD's sanctuary will be in the center."

verses.kjv: It shall be for the priests that are sanctified of the sons of Zadok; which have kept my charge, which went not astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.
verses.modern: "This will be for the consecrated priests — the sons of Zadok — who kept My charge and did not go astray when the Israelites went astray, as the Levites did."

verses.kjv: And this oblation of the land that is offered shall be unto them a thing most holy by the border of the Levites.
verses.modern: "It will be a special gift to them from the sacred portion of the land, a most holy portion, bordering the territory of the Levites."

verses.kjv: And over against the border of the priests the Levites shall have five and twenty thousand in length, and ten thousand in breadth: all the length shall be five and twenty thousand, and the breadth ten thousand.
verses.modern: "Alongside the territory of the priests, the Levites will have an allotment twenty-five thousand cubits long and ten thousand cubits wide. Its total length will be twenty-five thousand cubits and its width ten thousand cubits."

verses.kjv: And they shall not sell of it, neither exchange, nor alienate the firstfruits of the land: for it is holy unto the LORD.
verses.modern: "They must not sell or exchange any of it. This is the best of the land and must not pass into other hands, because it is holy to the LORD."

verses.kjv: And the five thousand, that are left in the breadth over against the five and twenty thousand, shall be a profane place for the city, for dwelling, and for suburbs: and the city shall be in the midst thereof.
verses.modern: "The remaining area — five thousand cubits wide and twenty-five thousand cubits long — will be for the common use of the city, for houses and for open land. The city will be in the center."

verses.kjv: And these shall be the measures thereof; the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.
verses.modern: "These will be its measurements: the north side 4,500 cubits, the south side 4,500, the east side 4,500, and the west side 4,500."

verses.kjv: And the suburbs of the city shall be toward the north two hundred and fifty, and toward the south two hundred and fifty, and toward the east two hundred and fifty, and toward the west two hundred and fifty.
verses.modern: "The open land surrounding the city will be 250 cubits on the north, 250 on the south, 250 on the east, and 250 on the west."

verses.kjv: And the residue in length over against the oblation of the holy portion shall be ten thousand eastward, and ten thousand westward: and it shall be over against the oblation of the holy portion; and the produce thereof shall be for food unto them that serve the city.
verses.modern: "What remains of the special portion will be ten thousand cubits to the east and ten thousand to the west, adjoining the sacred portion. Its produce will supply food for the workers of the city."

verses.kjv: And they that serve the city shall serve it out of all the tribes of Israel.
verses.modern: "The workers from the city who farm it will come from all the tribes of Israel."

verses.kjv: All the oblation shall be five and twenty thousand by five and twenty thousand: ye shall offer the holy oblation foursquare, with the possession of the city.
verses.modern: "The entire special portion will be a square, twenty-five thousand cubits on each side. Set it apart as the sacred portion, along with the property of the city."

verses.kjv: And the residue shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy oblation, and of the possession of the city, over against the five and twenty thousand of the oblation toward the east border, and westward over against the five and twenty thousand toward the west border, over against the portions for the prince: and it shall be the holy oblation; and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the midst thereof.
verses.modern: "What remains on both sides of the sacred portion and the city property will belong to the prince. It will extend eastward from the twenty-five thousand cubits of the sacred portion to the eastern border, and westward from the twenty-five thousand cubits to the western border. Both of these areas running the length of the tribal portions will belong to the prince, and the sacred portion with the temple sanctuary will be in the center."

verses.kjv: Moreover from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, being in the midst of that which is the prince's, between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the prince.
verses.modern: "So the property of the Levites and the property of the city will lie in the center of the area that belongs to the prince. The area belonging to the prince will lie between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin."

verses.kjv: As for the rest of the tribes, from the east side unto the west side, Benjamin shall have a portion.
verses.modern: "As for the rest of the tribes: Benjamin will have one portion from the east side to the west side."

verses.kjv: And by the border of Benjamin, from the east side unto the west side, Simeon shall have a portion.
verses.modern: "Adjoining the territory of Benjamin from east to west, Simeon will have one portion."

verses.kjv: And by the border of Simeon, from the east side unto the west side, Issachar a portion.
verses.modern: "Adjoining the territory of Simeon from east to west, Issachar will have one portion."

verses.kjv: And by the border of Issachar, from the east side unto the west side, Zebulun a portion.
verses.modern: "Adjoining the territory of Issachar from east to west, Zebulun will have one portion."

verses.kjv: And by the border of Zebulun, from the east side unto the west side, Gad a portion.
verses.modern: "Adjoining the territory of Zebulun from east to west, Gad will have one portion."

verses.kjv: And by the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar unto the waters of strife in Kadesh, and to the river toward the great sea.
verses.modern: "The southern boundary of Gad will run south from Tamar to the waters of Meribah Kadesh, then along the Wadi of Egypt to the Mediterranean Sea."

verses.kjv: This is the land which ye shall divide by lot unto the tribes of Israel, and these are their portions, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: "This is the land You are to allot as an inheritance to the tribes of Israel, and these are their portions, declares the Lord GOD."

verses.kjv: And these are the goings out of the city on the north side, four thousand and five hundred measures.
verses.modern: "These are the exits of the city: Beginning on the north side, which is 4,500 cubits long —"

verses.kjv: And the gates of the city shall be after the names of the tribes of Israel: three gates northward; the gate of Reuben, one; the gate of Judah, one; the gate of Levi, one.
verses.modern: "the three gates on the north side will be named after the tribes of Israel: the gate of Reuben, the gate of Judah, and the gate of Levi."

verses.kjv: And at the east side four thousand and five hundred: and three gates; and one gate of Joseph, one gate of Benjamin, one gate of Dan.
verses.modern: "On the east side, which is 4,500 cubits long, will be three gates: the gate of Joseph, the gate of Benjamin, and the gate of Dan."

verses.kjv: And at the south side four thousand and five hundred measures: and three gates; one gate of Simeon, one gate of Issachar, one gate of Zebulun.
verses.modern: "On the south side, which is 4,500 cubits long, will be three gates: the gate of Simeon, the gate of Issachar, and the gate of Zebulun."

verses.kjv: At the west side four thousand and five hundred, with their three gates; one gate of Gad, one gate of Asher, one gate of Naphtali.
verses.modern: "On the west side, which is 4,500 cubits long, will be three gates: the gate of Gad, the gate of Asher, and the gate of Naphtali."

verses.kjv: It was round about eighteen thousand measures: and the name of the city from that day shall be, The LORD is there.
verses.modern: "The total circumference of the city will be 18,000 cubits. And the name of the city from that time on will be: THE LORD IS THERE."

chapters.summary: The land is divided among the twelve tribes from north to south, with the holy portion in the center containing the sanctuary, the priestly and Levitical territories, and the city. The city has twelve gates named after the twelve tribes of Israel. The name of the city from that day forward shall be "The LORD is there."
